explanation: "Where counsellors with different opinions hold on to their individual opinions that pleases them and are not for the outcome of a unanimous decision, such a counsel is said to be bad."
hindi: ‘जहाँ भिन्न-भिन्न बुद्धिका आश्रय ले सब ओर से स्पर्धापूर्वक भाषण किया जाय और एकमत होने पर भी जिससे कल्याण की सम्भावना न हो, वह मन्त्र या निश्चय अधम कहलाता है

shloka_text: तस्मात्सुमन्त्रितं साधु भवन्तो मतिसत्तमा: ।।6.6.15।। कार्यं सम्प्रतिपद्यन्तामेतत्कृत्यं मतं मम ।
translation: तस्मात् on account of that, मतिसत्तामाः wise ones, भवन्तः your, सुमन्त्रितम् thinking over well, साधु: rightly, कार्यम् task, सम्प्रतिपद्यन्ताम् that which has to be done, एतत् all that, मम: to me, कृत्यम् required action, मतम् I need.
explanation: "On account of that, O wise ones Think over very well, rightly of the task to be done and determine the action required by me now."
hindi: ‘आप सब लोग परम बुद्धिमान् हैं; इसलिये अच्छी तरह सलाह करके कोई एक कार्य निश्चित करें। उसी को मैं अपना कर्तव्य समशृंगा

shloka_text: वानराणां हि धीराणां सहस्रैः परिवारितः ।।6.6.16।। रामोऽभ्येति पुरी लङ्कामस्माकमुपरोधकः ।
translation: रामः Rama, धीराणाम् valorous, वानराणाम् Vanaras, सहस्रैः thousands, परिवारितः to besiege, अस्माकम् us, उपरोधकः is approaching, लङ्कांपुरीम् city of Lanka, अभ्येति: reaching.
explanation: Accompanied by thousands of Vanaras, Rama is approaching to besiege us and reaching the city of Lanka.
hindi: ‘(ऐसे निश्चय की आवश्यकता इसलिये पड़ी है कि) राम सहस्रों धीरवीर वानरों के साथ हमारी लङ्कापुरी पर चढ़ाई करने के लिये आ रहे हैं

shloka_text: तरिष्यति च सुव्यक्तं राघवस्सागरं सुखम् ।।6.6.17।। तरसा युक्तरूपेण सानुजस्सबलानुगः ।
translation: राघवः Rama, युक्तरूपेण: worthy of his might, तरसा: speedily, सानुजः his brother, सबलानुगः and his army, सागरम् ocean, सुव्यक्तम् it is clear, सुखम् easily, तरिष्यतिच: will be able to cross.
explanation: "Rama who is worthy of his might, accompanied by his brother and army will be able to cross the ocean speedily and easily."
hindi: ‘यह बात भी भलीभाँति स्पष्ट हो चुकी है कि वे रघुवंशी राम अपने समुचित बल के द्वारा भाई, सेना और सेवकोंसहित सुखपूर्वक समुद्र को पार कर लेंगे

shloka_text: समुद्रमुच्छोषयति वीर्येणान्यत्करोति वा ।।6.6.18।। अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये विरुद्धे वानरैस्सह । हितं पुरे च सैन्ये च सर्व सम्मन्त्रयतां मम ।।6.6.19।।
translation: समुद्रम् ocean, उच्चोषयति: dry up, वीर्येण: out of his power, अन्यद्वा: or something else, करोति: will do, वानरैः Vanara, सह: with, विरुद्धे: encounters, अस्मिन् when his army, एवंगते: has set out that way, कार्ये: task, मम: me, पुरे: for the city, सैन्ये: army, हितम् benefiting, सर्वम् for all, सम्मन्त्रयताम् advise me a plan
explanation: Rama may dry up the ocean or do something else out of his power. If Vanaras come and encounter us, we will clash with him. When his army has set out that way, you may advise me of a plan that benefits the army and city of Lanka." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषष्ठमस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
hindi: ‘वे या तो समुद्र को ही सुखा डालेंगे या अपने पराक्रम से कोई दूसरा ही उपाय करेंगे। ऐसी स्थिति में वानरों से विरोध आ पड़ने पर नगर और सेना के लिये जो भी हितकर हो, वैसी सलाह आपलोग दीजिये

shloka_text: इत्युक्ता राक्षसेन्द्रेण राक्षसास्ते महाबलाः । ऊचुः प्रान्जलयः सर्वे रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ।।6.7.1।।
translation: राक्षसेन्द्रेण: to the leader of Rakshasas, सर्वे: all Rakshasas, महाबलाः of mighty strength, प्रान्जलयः greeting with folded hand s, राक्षसास्ते: the Rakshasas, राक्षसेश्वरम्: Lord of Rakshasas, रावणं: to Ravana, ऊचुः having heard, इत्युक्ता: thus spoke.
explanation: All the Rakshasas of mighty strength, having heard the Lord of Rakshasas, thus spoke to their leader, greeting with folded hands.
comments: All the Rakshasas praise their might and inspire confidence in Ravana.
hindi: राक्षसों को न तो नीति का ज्ञान था और न वे शत्रुपक्ष के बलाबल को ही समझते थे। वे बलवान् तो बहुत थे; किंतु नीति की दृष्टि से महामूर्ख थे। इसलिये जब राक्षसराज रावण ने उनसे पूर्वोक्त बातें कहीं, तब वे सब-के-सब हाथ जोड़कर उससे बोले-

shloka_text: द्विषत्पक्षमविज्ञाय नीतिबाह्यास्त्वबुद्धयः । राजन्परिघशक्त्यृष्टिशूलपट्टिशकुन्तलम् ।।6.7.2।।
translation: राजन्: o king, परिघ: iron bars, शक्त्यृष्टि: javelins, शूलपट्टि: arrows and swords, शकुन्तलम्: sharp edged spears, द्विषत्पक्षम: double edged swords, अविज्ञाय: not  knowing, नीतिबाह्या: political intelligence, स्त्वबुद्धयः submitted by themselves.
explanation: "O King The ogres are not having political intelligence. They have submitted themselves, even though they are mighty and are having iron bars, javelins, sharp edged spears, and doubleedged swords."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 7.1 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: इत्युक्ता राक्षसेन्द्रेण राक्षसास्ते महाबलाः । ऊचुः प्रान्जलयः सर्वे रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ।।6.7.3।। द्विषत्पक्षमविज्ञाय नीतिबाह्यास्त्वबुद्धयः ।
translation: इत्युक्ता: having spoken thus, राक्षसेन्द्रेण: by the Lord of Rakshasas, राक्षसास्ते    (तेराक्षसा ): those Rakshasa, महाबलाः who were very strong, द्विषत्पक्षं: the enemy's side अविज्ञाय: ignorant about, नीतिबाह्या: without having political wisdom,  (नीतिबाह्यास्त्वबुद्धयःनीतिबाह्या:  तु  अबुद्धय:) अबुद्धय: not intelligent, ऊचुः told, प्रान्जलयः with folded hands, रावणं: to Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरम्: the king of Rakshasas.
explanation: The Lord of Rakshasas having spoken like that, to the Rakshasas, who were very strong, but ignorant about the enemy's strength and who were not endowed with political wisdom, spoke to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, the following words with folded hands.

shloka_text: राजन्परिघशक्त्यृष्टिशूलपट्टिशकुन्तलम् ।।6.7.4।।
translation: राजन्: Oh king, परिघ: iron bars, शक्ति: javelins, ऋष्टि: double edged swords, शूल: spear, पट्टिश: spear with a sharp edge or some other weapon with three points, कुन्तलम्: ploughs.
explanation: "Oh king, (our army is equipped with) iron bars, javelins, double edged swords, spears, three pointed weapons, ploughs etc."
hindi: ‘राजन्! हमारे पास परिघ, शक्ति, ऋष्टि, शूल, पट्टिश और भालों से लैस बहुत बड़ी सेना मौजूद है; फिर आप विषाद क्यों करते हैं

shloka_text: सुमहन्नो बलं कस्माद्विषादं भजते भवान् । त्वया भोगवतीं गत्वा निर्जिताः पन्नगा युधि ।।6.7.5।।
translation: सुमहन्नोबलं: mighty army strength, कस्माद्: why, विषादं: despondent, भजते: give way, भवान्: you, त्वया: by you, पन्नगा: Nagas, युधि: in war, भोगवतीं: Bhogavathi, गत्वा: going, निर्जिताः subdued
explanation: "Why are you despondent? You have huge and mighty army strength. When you went to Bhogavathi, the Nagas were subdued in war by your mighty army."
hindi: ‘आपने तो भोगवतीपुरी में जाकर नागों को भी युद्ध में परास्त कर दिया था। बहुसंख्यक यक्षों से घिरे हुए कैलासशिखर के निवासी कुबेर को भी युद्ध में भारी मार-काट मचाकर वश में कर लिया था

shloka_text: कैलासशिखरावासी यक्षैर्बहुभिरावृतः । सुमहत्कदनं कृत्वा वश्यस्ते धनदः कृतः ।।6.7.6।।
translation: कैलासशिखरावासी: he who lives on the peak of mount Kailas:, बहुभि: numerous, यक्षै: Yakshas, (बहुभि:  आवृत:  बाहुभिरावृत:) आवृतः surrounded by, सुमहत: great, कदनं: sorrow, कृत्वा: being caused, वश्यस्ते: surrendered to you, धनदः bestow er of wealth (Kubera), कृतः remained.
explanation: "He who dwells on the peak of mount Kailasa, surrounded by numerous yakshas, wrought great sorrow —"
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 7.5 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: स महेश्वरसख्येन श्लाघमानस्त्वया विभो । निर्जितः समरे रोषाल्लोकपालो महाबलः ।।6.7.7।।
translation: स: that, महेश्वरसख्येन: by the friendship of Maheswara (Siva), श्लाघमान: priding, महाबलः strong, ल्लोकपालो: ruler of the world, स्त्वया: by you might, विभो: O king, निर्जितः subdued, समरे: in conflict.
explanation: "O King Proud of his friendship with Lord Maheshwara (Siva), that mighty ruler of the world Kubera was subdued by you in the conflict."
hindi: ‘प्रभो! महाबली लोकपाल कुबेर महादेवजी के साथ मित्रता होने के कारण आपके साथ बड़ी स्पर्धा रखते थे; परंतु आपने समराङ्गण में रोषपूर्वक उन्हें हरा दिया

shloka_text: विनिहत्य च यक्षौघान्विक्षोभ्य चविनिगृह्य च । त्वया कैलासशिखराद्विमानमिदमाहृतम् ।।6.7.8।।
translation: त्वया: by you, यक्षौघान्: hordes of yaksha, विनिहत्य: taking as prisoners, विक्षोभ्यच: causing disturbance by stirring and, विनिगृह्यच: and taking away, कैलासशिखराद्: from mount Kailas, विमानमिदमाहृतम्: brought this great aerial chariot.
explanation: "Causing terrific disturbance to the hordes of Yakshas and taking them as prisoners, you have brought the great aerial chariot from mount Kailas."
hindi: ‘यक्षों की सेना को विचलित करके बंदी बना लिया और कितनों को धराशायी करके कैलासशिखर से आप उनका यह विमान छीन लाये थे

shloka_text: मयेन दानवेन्द्रेण त्वद्भयात्सख्यमिच्छता । दुहिता तव भार्यार्थे दत्ता राक्षसपुङ्गव ।।6.7.9।।
translation: राक्षसपुङ्गव: leader of Rakshasas, दानवेन्द्रेण: ruler of Danavas, मयेन: by Maya, त्वद्भयात्: out of fear of you, मिच्छता: sought, सख्य: alliance, दत्ता: given, तव: to you, भार्यार्थे: wife, दुहिता: daughter.
explanation: "Maya, the ruler of Danavas has given his daughter (Mandodari) to you as a wife out of fear of you, O leader of Rakshasas"
hindi: ‘राक्षसशिरोमणे! दानवराज मय ने आपसे भयभीत होकर ही आपको अपना मित्र बना लेने की इच्छा की और इसी उद्देश्य से आपको धर्मपत्नी के रूप में अपनी पुत्री समर्पित कर दी

shloka_text: दानवेन्द्रो मधुर्नाम वीर्योत्सिक्तो दुरासदः । विगृह्य वशमानीतः कुम्भीनस्याः सुखावहः ।।6.7.10।।
translation: दुरासदः difficult to approach, वीर्योत्सिक्तो: proud of his valour, कुम्भीनस्याः Kumbhinasi (your sister), सुखावहः who brings joy to her (who is husband of), दानवेन्द्रो: ruler of Danavas, मधुर्नाम: called as Madhu, विगृह्य: offering to fight and win, वशमानीतः subjugated to you.
explanation: "Madhu, another ruler of Danavas who was proud of his valour and difficult to approach, the husband of Kumbhinasi was subjugated by you by your offering to fight with him."
hindi: ‘महाबाहो! अपने पराक्रम का घमंड रखने वाले दुर्जय दानवराज मधु को भी, जो आपकी बहिन कुम्भीनसी को सुख देने वाला उसका पति है, आपने युद्ध छेड़कर वश में कर लिया

shloka_text: निर्जितास्ते महाबाहो नागा गत्वा रसातलम् । वासुकिस्तक्षकः शङखो जटी च वशमाहृताः ।।6.7.11।।
translation: महाबाहो: mighty armed, स्ते: you, गत्वा: going to, रसातलम्: subterranean region, वासुकि:: Vasuki, तक्षकः Takshaka, शङखो: Shanka, जटीच: and Jati, नागा: serpent demons, र्जिता: winning over, वशमाहृताः made them submit to you.
explanation: "O mighty armed king Going to the subterranean world, you won over the serpent demons Vasuki, Takshaka, Shanka and Jati and made them submit to you."
hindi: ‘विशालबाहु वीर! आपने रसातल पर चढ़ाई करके वासुकि, तक्षक, शङ्ख और जटी आदि नागों को युद्ध में जीता और अपने अधीन कर लिया

shloka_text: अक्षया बलवन्तश्च शूरा लब्धवराः पुनः । त्वया संवत्सरं युद्ध्वा समरे दानवा विभो ।।6.7.12।।
translation: अक्षया: imperishable, बलवन्तश्च: strong and mighty, शूरा: warriors, लब्धवराः who had obtained boon, त्वया: by you, संवत्सरं: one year, युद्ध्वा: fighting, पुनः again, समरे: in war, दानवा: Danavas, विभो: Oh Lord.
explanation: "The mighty and strong Danava warriors who had obtained boon were made to fight a war by you for one year."
hindi: ‘प्रभो! शत्रुदमन राक्षसराज! दानवलोग बड़े ही बलवान्, किसी से नष्ट न होने वाले, शूरवीर तथा वर पाकर अद्भुत शक्ति से सम्पन्न हो गये थे; परंतु आपने समराङ्गण में एक वर्षतक युद्ध करके अपने ही बल के भरोसे उन सबको अपने अधीन कर लिया और वहाँ उनसे बहुत-सी मायाएँ भी प्राप्त कीं

shloka_text: स्वबलं समुपाश्रित्य नीता वशमरिन्दम । मायाश्चाधिगतास्तत्र बह्व्यो वै राक्षसाधिप ।।6.7.13।।
translation: राक्षसाधिप: king of Rakshasas, स्वबलं: your own strength, समुपाश्रित्य: resorting to, मायाश्च: deceitful tricks, अधिगता: learned, तत्र: there, बह्वो: many, नीता: reduced to, वशम: sub mission, अरिन्दम: subduer of enemies.
explanation: "O king of Rakshasas (Those Danavas) were reduced to sub mission by resorting to your own strength. Oh subduer of enemies, many deceitful tricks were learned from them."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 7.12 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: शूराश्च बलवन्तश्च वरुणस्य सुता रणे । निर्जितास्ते महाभाग चतुर्विधबलानुगाः ।।6.7.14।।
translation: महाभाग: blessed one, चतुर्विधबलानुगाः four kinds of army, शूराश्च: capable heroes, बलवन्तश्च: mighty strong, वरुणस्य: Varuna's, सुता: sons, रणे: in war, निर्जिता: have won, ते: by you.
explanation: "O blessed king Mighty strong sons of Varuna, heroes capable of war and of all the four kinds of army have been won by you."
hindi: ‘महाभाग! आपने वरुण के शूरवीर और बलवान् पुत्रों को भी उनकी चतुरंगिणी सेनासहित युद्ध में परास्त कर दिया था

shloka_text: मृत्युदण्डमहाग्राहं शाल्मलिद्रुममण्डितम् । कालपाशमहावीचिं यमकिंकरपन्नगम् ।।6.7.15।।
translation: मृत्युदण्ड: Yama's rod of death, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, शाल्मलिद्रुममण्डितम्: adorned with Salmali trees (bristling with thorns to be used as weapons), कालपाश: noose of time (Kala), महावीचिं: hugely turbulent wave, यमकिंकरपन्नगम्: Lord of death 's attendants as serpents, महाज्वरेण: on account of mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), दुर्धर्षं: unassailable, यमलोकमहार्णवम्: ocean in the shape of Yama's realm, अवगाह्य: plunging into., त्वया: by you, राजन्: Oh King, यमस्य: realm of death, बलसागरम्: ocean of army, जयश्च: victory, विपुल: great, प्राप्तो: obtained, मृत्युश्च: and death, प्रतिषेधितः warded off, सुयुद्धेनच: and by good battle, ते: your, सर्वे: all, लोका: people (of that world), तत्र: there, सुतोषिताः were delighted.
explanation: "Oh King Plunging into the ocean, which was in the shape of Yama's realm, with an enormous alligator in the form of rod of death, adorned with Salmali trees, turbulent with a huge wave in the form of Death 's noose, infested with Lord of  Death's attendants as serpents, unassailable on account of the mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), you have obtained a great victory over the Lord of Death 's great army and the army was warded off. By your good battle all the people (of the world) were delighted.
hindi: ‘राजन्! मृत्यु का दण्ड ही जिसमें महान् ग्राह के समान है, जो यम-यातना-सम्बन्धी शाल्मलि आदि वृक्षों से मण्डित है, कालपाशरूपी उत्ताल तरङ्गे जिसकी शोभा बढ़ाती हैं, यमदूतरूपी सर्प जिसमें निवास करते हैं तथा जो महान् ज्वर के कारण दुर्जय है, उस यमलोकरूपी महासागर में प्रवेश करके आपनेयमराज की सागर-जैसी सेना को मथ डाला, मृत्यु को रोक दिया और महान् विजय प्राप्त की। यही नहीं, युद्ध की उत्तम कला से आपने वहाँ के सब लोगों को पूर्ण संतुष्ट कर दिया था

shloka_text: महाज्वरेण दुर्धर्षं यमलोकमहार्णवम् । अवगाह्य त्वया राजन्यमस्य बलसागरम् ।।6.7.16।।
translation: मृत्युदण्ड: Yama's rod of death, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, शाल्मलिद्रुममण्डितम्: adorned with Salmali trees (bristling with thorns to be used as weapons), कालपाश: noose of time (Kala), महावीचिं: hugely turbulent wave, यमकिंकरपन्नगम्: Lord of death 's attendants as serpents, महाज्वरेण: on account of mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), दुर्धर्षं: unassailable, यमलोकमहार्णवम्: ocean in the shape of Yama's realm, अवगाह्य: plunging into., त्वया: by you, राजन्: Oh King, यमस्य: realm of death, बलसागरम्: ocean of army, जयश्च: victory, विपुल: great, प्राप्तो: obtained, मृत्युश्च: and death, प्रतिषेधितः warded off, सुयुद्धेनच: and by good battle, ते: your, सर्वे: all, लोका: people (of that world), तत्र: there, सुतोषिताः were delighted.
explanation: "Oh King Plunging into the ocean, which was in the shape of Yama's realm, with an enormous alligator in the form of rod of death, adorned with Salmali trees, turbulent with a huge wave in the form of Death 's noose, infested with Lord of  Death's attendants as serpents, unassailable on account of the mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), you have obtained a great victory over the Lord of Death 's great army and the army was warded off. By your good battle all the people (of the world) were delighted.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 7.15 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: जयश्च विपुलः प्राप्तो मृत्युश्च प्रतिषेधितः । सुयुद्धेन च ते सर्वे लोकास्तत्र सुतोषिताः ।।6.7.17।।
translation: मृत्युदण्ड: Yama's rod of death, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, शाल्मलिद्रुममण्डितम्: adorned with Salmali trees (bristling with thorns to be used as weapons), कालपाश: noose of time (Kala), महावीचिं: hugely turbulent wave, यमकिंकरपन्नगम्: Lord of death 's attendants as serpents, महाज्वरेण: on account of mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), दुर्धर्षं: unassailable, यमलोकमहार्णवम्: ocean in the shape of Yama's realm, अवगाह्य: plunging into., त्वया: by you, राजन्: Oh King, यमस्य: realm of death, बलसागरम्: ocean of army, जयश्च: victory, विपुल: great, प्राप्तो: obtained, मृत्युश्च: and death, प्रतिषेधितः warded off, सुयुद्धेनच: and by good battle, ते: your, सर्वे: all, लोका: people (of that world), तत्र: there, सुतोषिताः were delighted.
explanation: "Oh King Plunging into the ocean, which was in the shape of Yama's realm, with an enormous alligator in the form of rod of death, adorned with Salmali trees, turbulent with a huge wave in the form of Death 's noose, infested with Lord of  Death's attendants as serpents, unassailable on account of the mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), you have obtained a great victory over the Lord of Death 's great army and the army was warded off. By your good battle all the people (of the world) were delighted.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 7.15 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: क्षत्रियैर्बहुभिर्वीरैः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः । आसीद्वसुमती पूर्णा महद्भिरिव पादपैः ।।6.7.18।।
translation: क्षत्रियैर्: warriors, आसीद: was, बहुभि: many, र्वीरैः strong, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः with courage equal to Indra, आसीद्: was, वसुमती: Earth, पूर्णा: fully, महद्भिरिव: like great, पादपैः trees
explanation: "The earth was fully filled with Kshatriya heroes of great prowess, equal to Indra in war who stood like trees on earth."
hindi: ‘पहले यह पृथ्वी विशाल वृक्षों की भाँति इन्द्रतुल्य पराक्रमी बहुसंख्यक क्षत्रिय वीरों से भरी हुई थी

shloka_text: तेषां वीर्यगुणोत्साहैर्न समो राघवो रणे । प्रसह्य ते त्वया राजन्हताः समरदुर्जयाः ।।6.7.19।।
translation: तेषाम्: to them, वीर्यगुणोत्साहै: valour excellence and energy, न: not, समो: equal, राघवो: Raghava, प्रसह्य: were overpowered, त्वया: by you, राजन्: King, हता: Killed, समरदुर्जयाः who were difficult to be overpowered.
explanation: "Raghava is not equal to them in valour, excellence and energy. Those warriors who were difficult to overcome by battle were overpowered and killed by you."
hindi: ‘उन वीरों में जो पराक्रम, गुण और उत्साह थे, उनकी दृष्टि से राम रणभूमि में उनके समान कदापि नहीं है; राजन्! जब आपने उन समरदुर्जय वीरों को भी बलपूर्वक मार डाला, तब रामपर विजय पाना आपके लिये कौन बड़ी बात है ?

shloka_text: तिष्ठ वा किं महाराज श्रमे ण तव वानरान् । अयमेको महाबाहुरिन्द्रजित्क्षपयिष्यति ।।6.7.20।।
translation: तिष्ठ: you stay, किम्: why, महाराज: Oh great king, तव: your, श्रमेण: by exertion, वानरान्: the monkeys, अयम्: this, एको: alone, महाबाहु: strong armed, इन्द्रजित्: Indrajith (Elder son of Ravana), क्षपयिष्यति: can destroy.
explanation: "Oh great king, you stay here calmly. Why exert yourself? This strong armed Indrajith alone can destroy those Vanaras."
hindi: ‘अथवा महाराज! आप चुपचाप यहीं बैठे रहें। आपको परिश्रम करने की क्या आवश्यकता है। अकेले ये महाबाहु इन्द्रजित् ही सब वानरों का संहार कर डालेंगे

shloka_text: अनेन हि महाराज महेश्वरमनुत्तमम् । इष्ट्वा यज्ञं वरो लब्धो लोके परमदुर्लभः ।।6.7.21।।
translation: अनेन: by him, महाराज: great king, महेश्वर: Lord Maheshwara (Siva), अनुत्तमम्: supreme, इष्ट्वायज्ञं: performing sacrifice, लब्धो: obtained, लोके: in the world, परमदुर्लभः very difficult, वरो: boon.
explanation: "Oh Great King By performing supreme sacrifices, Indrajith obtained boons from Lord Maheswara, which are very difficult to get."
hindi: ‘महाराज! इन्होंने परम उत्तम माहेश्वर यज्ञ का अनुष्ठान करके वह वर प्राप्त किया है, जो संसार में दूसरे के लिये अत्यन्त दुर्लभ है

shloka_text: शक्तितोमरमीनं च विनिकीर्णान्त्रशैवलम् । गजकछपसम्बाधमश्वमण्डूकसंकुलम् ।।6.7.22।।
translation: शक्ति: a powerful weapon like spear, तोमर: javelin, मीनंच: and fish, विनिकीर्णान्त्र: throwing entrails, शैवलम्: mossa water plant, गज: elephants, कछप: tortoises, सम्बाध: connected, अश्व: horses, मण्डूक: frogs, संकुलम्: filled with, रुद्रा: Rudras, आदित्य: Adityas, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, मरुद्व: Marudas, सुमहोरगम्: huge serpents, रथश्व: Chariots tied to horses, गज: elephants, तोयौघं: volume of water, पदाति: footsoldiers, पुलिनं: sand beaches, महत्: large, अनेनहि: by him, समासाद्य: encountered, देवानां: of Devas, बलसागरम्: great ocean of army, गृहीतो: captured, दैवतपति: Lord of Devas (Indra), लङ्काच: in Lanka, प्रवेशितः entered.
explanation: Spears and javelins were the fish in it, scattered entrails the moss, elephants and tortoises were joined together in it, and horses —
hindi: ‘देवताओं की सेना समुद्र के समान थी। शक्ति और तोमर ही उसमें मत्स्य थे। निकालकर फेंकी हुई आँतें सेवार का काम देती थीं। हाथी ही उस सैन्य-सागर में कछुओं के समान भरे थे। घोड़े मेढकों के समान उसमें सब ओर व्याप्त थे। रुद्रगण और आदित्यगण उस सेनारूपी समुद्र के बड़े-बड़े ग्राह थे। मरुद्गण और वसुगण वहाँ के विशाल नाग थे। रथ, हाथी और घोड़े जलराशि के समान थे और पैदल सैनिक उसके विशाल तट थे; परंतु इस इन्द्रजित् ने देवताओं के उस सैन्य-समुद्र में घुसकर देवराज इन्द्र को कैद कर लिया और उन्हें लङ्कापुरी में लाकर बंद कर दिया

shloka_text: रुद्रादित्यमहाग्राहं मरुद्वसुमहोरगम् । रथश्वगजतोयौघं पदातिपुलिनं महत् ।।6.7.23।।
translation: शक्ति: a powerful weapon like spear, तोमर: javelin, मीनंच: and fish, विनिकीर्णान्त्र: throwing entrails, शैवलम्: mossa water plant, गज: elephants, कछप: tortoises, सम्बाध: connected, अश्व: horses, मण्डूक: frogs, संकुलम्: filled with, रुद्रा: Rudras, आदित्य: Adityas, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, मरुद्व: Marudas, सुमहोरगम्: huge serpents, रथश्व: Chariots tied to horses, गज: elephants, तोयौघं: volume of water, पदाति: footsoldiers, पुलिनं: sand beaches, महत्: large, अनेनहि: by him, समासाद्य: encountered, देवानां: of Devas, बलसागरम्: great ocean of army, गृहीतो: captured, दैवतपति: Lord of Devas (Indra), लङ्काच: in Lanka, प्रवेशितः entered.
explanation: — were its whirlpools; the ornaments of the slain were its foam, and the flesh and blood of warriors its mire;
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 7.22 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: अनेन हि समासाद्य देवानां बलसागरम् । गृहीतो दैवतपतिर्लङ्कां चापि प्रवेशितः ।।6.7.24।।
translation: शक्ति: a powerful weapon like spear, तोमर: javelin, मीनंच: and fish, विनिकीर्णान्त्र: throwing entrails, शैवलम्: mossa water plant, गज: elephants, कछप: tortoises, सम्बाध: connected, अश्व: horses, मण्डूक: frogs, संकुलम्: filled with, रुद्रा: Rudras, आदित्य: Adityas, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, मरुद्व: Marudas, सुमहोरगम्: huge serpents, रथश्व: Chariots tied to horses, गज: elephants, तोयौघं: volume of water, पदाति: footsoldiers, पुलिनं: sand beaches, महत्: large, अनेनहि: by him, समासाद्य: encountered, देवानां: of Devas, बलसागरम्: great ocean of army, गृहीतो: captured, दैवतपति: Lord of Devas (Indra), लङ्काच: in Lanka, प्रवेशितः entered.
explanation: — such was the river of battle that flowed there, dreadful and impassable to the fearful.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 7.22 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: पितामहनियोगाच्च मुक्तः शम्बरवृत्रहा । गतस्त्रिविष्टपम्राजन्सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः ।।6.7.25।।
translation: राजन्: king, पितामहनियोगाच्च: ordered by creator Brahma, मुक्तः liberated, शम्बरवृत्रहा: the destroyer of Sambara and Vrtra (Indra):, सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः adored by all Devas., गतस्त्रिविष्ट: returned to heaven.
explanation: "Liberated by the command of creator Brahma, Indra the destroyer of Sambara and Vrtra entered heaven was adorned and greeted by all Devas."
hindi: ‘राजन्! फिर ब्रह्माजी के कहने से इन्होंने शम्बर और वृत्रासुर को मारने वाले सर्वदेववन्दित इन्द्र को मुक्त किया। तब वे स्वर्गलोक में गये

shloka_text: तमेव त्वं महाराज विसृजेन्द्रजितं सुतम् । यावद् वानरसेनां तां सरामां नयति क्षयम् ।।6.7.26।।
translation: महाराज O great king, त्वम् you, तम् एव that very, सुतम् son, इन्द्रजितम् Indrajit, विसृज send forth, यावत् so that, सरामाम् along with Rama, ताम् that, वानरसेनाम् vanara army, क्षयम् to destruction, नयति he may lead
explanation: "Send forth that very son of yours, Indrajit, O great king, that he may lead that vanara army with Rama to destruction."
hindi: ‘अतः महाराज! इस काम के लिये आप राजकुमार इन्द्रजित् को ही भेजिये, जिससे ये रामसहित वानरसेना का यहाँ आने से पहले ही संहार कर डालें

shloka_text: राजन्नापदयुक्तेयमागता प्राकृताज्जनात् । हृदि नैव त्वया कार्या त्वं वधिष्यसि राघवम् ।।6.7.27।।
translation: राजन् O king, इयम् this, आपत् calamity, प्राकृतात् from common, जनात् folk, युक्ता joined, आगता has come, त्वया by you, हृदि in the heart, न एव कार्या it should not be taken at all, त्वम् you, राघवम् Raghava, वधिष्यसि shall slay
explanation: "This calamity, O king, has come upon you from common folk; it should not be taken to heart at all. You shall slay Raghava."
hindi: ‘राजन् ! साधारण नर और वानरों से प्राप्त हुई इस आपत्ति के विषय में चिन्ता करना आपके लिये उचित नहीं है। आपको तो अपने हृदय में इसे स्थान ही नहीं देना चाहिये। आप अवश्य ही राम का वध कर डालेंगे’

shloka_text: ततो नीलाम्बुदनिभ: प्रहस्तो नाम राक्षसः । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं शूरस्सेनापतिस्तदा ।।6.8.1।।
translation: ततः then, शूरः hero, सेनापतिः chief of army, नीलाम्बुदनिभ: one whose body is like dark cloud, प्रहस्तोनाम: called Prahastha, राक्षसः Rakshasa, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, वाक्यम् these words., अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Then a Rakshasa whose body was like a dark cloud, called Prahastha, the heroic chief of the army, spoke these words with folded palms.
comments: Prahastha and others assure Ravana that they will kill Rama and others.
hindi: इसके बाद नील मेघ के समान श्यामवर्णवाले शूर सेनापति प्रहस्त नामक राक्षस ने हाथ जोड़कर कहा

shloka_text: देवदानवगन्धर्वाः पिशाचपतगोरगाः । नत्वां धर्षयितुं शक्याः किं पुनर्वानरा रणे ।।6.8.2।।
translation: देवदानवगन्धर्वाः Devas Danavas Gandharvas, पिशाचपतगोरगाः Devils birds and even serpents, सर्वे: all, रणे: in war, धर्षयितुम् to face you, नशक्याः not possible, वानरा: Vanaras, किंपुनः What to say.
explanation: "Even Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Devils, birds, and serpents, cannot face you in war. What to say of Vanaras?"
hindi: ‘महाराज! हमलोग देवता, दानव, गन्धर्व, पिशाच, पक्षी और सर्प सभी को पराजित कर सकते हैं; फिर उन दो मनुष्यों को रणभूमि में हराना कौन बड़ी बात है

shloka_text: सर्वे प्रमत्ता विश्वस्ता वञ्चितास्स्म हनूमता । नहि मे जीवतो गच्छेज्जीवन् स वनगोचरः ।।6.8.3।।
translation: अप्रमत्ता: inattentive, विश्वस्ताः confident, सर्वे: all of us, हनूमता: Hanuman, वञ्चिताःस्म: cheated us, मे: when I, जीवतः living, सः he, वनगोचरः wanderer of woods, जीवन् with life, नगच्छेत् हि: will not go.
explanation: All of us were inattentive and confident (of our ability) while Hanuman cheated us. When I am alive how will the wanderer of woods (Hanuman) go with life?
hindi: ‘पहले हमलोग असावधान थे। हमारे मन में शत्रुओं की ओर से कोई खटका नहीं था। इसीलिये हम निश्चिन्त बैठे थे। यही कारण है कि हनुमान् हमें धोखा दे गया। नहीं तो मेरे जीते-जी वह वानर यहाँ से जीता-जागता नहीं जा सकता था

shloka_text: सर्वां सागरपर्यन्तां सशैलवनकाननाम् । करोम्यवानरां भूमिमाज्ञापयतु मां भवान् ।।6.8.4।।
translation: सागरपर्यन्ताम् all over the ocean, सशैलवनकाननाम् in the mountains and forests, सर्वाम् entire, भूमिम् the earth, अवानराम् rid of Vanaras, करोमि: will do, भवान् your, माम् me, आज्ञापयतु: if you order
explanation: "I will make all the oceans, mountains, forests or even the entire earth rid of Vanaras if you order me."
hindi: ‘यदि आपकी आज्ञा हो तो पर्वत, वन और काननोंसहित समुद्रतक की सारी भूमि को मैं वानरों से सूनी कर दूँ

shloka_text: रक्षां चैव विधास्यामि वानराद्रजनीचर । नागमिष्यति ते दुःखं किञ्चिदात्मापराधजम् ।।6.8.5।।
translation: रजनीचर: O night ranger (Ravana), वानरात् by these Vanaras, रक्षांचैव: will protect, विधास्यामि: I will arrange, ते: by you, आत्मापराधजम् your own wrong action, दुःखम् grief, किञ्चित् even a little, नागमिष्यति: not undergo
explanation: "O night ranger (Ravana) I will arrange the protection (of this Lanka) from these Vanaras. For your own wrong action (of abducting Sita) you cannot undergo suffering."
hindi: ‘राक्षसराज! मैं वानरमात्र से आपकी रक्षा करूँगा, अतः अपने द्वारा किये गये सीताहरणरूपी अपराध के कारण कोई दुःख आप पर नहीं आने पायेगा’

shloka_text: अब्रवीच्च सुसङ्कृद्धो दुर्मुखो नाम राक्षसः । इदं न क्षमणीयं हि सर्वेषां नः प्रधर्षणम् ।।6.8.6।।
translation: दुर्मुखोनाम: called Durmukha, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सुसङ्कृद्ध: feeling very angry, च: and, अब्रवीत् said, नः nay, सर्वेषाम् for all of us, इदम् this, प्रधर्षणम् shame, नक्षमणीयंहि: not deserve to be excused.
explanation: Feeling very angry, a Rakshasa called Durmukha said, "He who has caused shame for all of us does not deserve to be excused."
hindi: तत्पश्चात् दुर्मुख नामक राक्षस ने अत्यन्त कुपित होकर कहा—’यह क्षमा करने योग्य अपराध नहीं है, क्योंकि इसके द्वारा हम सब लोगों का तिरस्कार हुआ है

shloka_text: अयं परिभवो भूयः पुरस्यान्तःपुरस्य च । श्रीमतो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वानरेण प्रधर्षणम् ।।6.8.7।।
translation: पुरस्य: to Lanka, अन्तःपुरस्यच: and to the royal residence, अयम् this, परिभवः despising, श्रीमतः one who is prosperous, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य: to the Lord of Rakshasas, वानरेण: by Vanara, प्रधर्षणम् assaulting, भूयः Furthermore.
explanation: "Furthermore, this assault by a Vanara on Lanka, to the royal residence, and to the prosperous Lord of Rakshasas is despising."
hindi: ‘वानर के द्वारा हमलोगों पर जो आक्रमण हुआ है, यह समस्त लङ्कापुरी का, महाराज के अन्तःपुर का और श्रीमान् राक्षसराज रावण का भी भारी पराभव है

shloka_text: अस्मिन् मुहूर्ते गत्वैको निवर्तिष्यामि वानरान् । प्रविष्टान् सागरं भीममम्बरं वा रसातलम् ।।6.8.8।।
translation: अस्मिन् this, मुहूर्ते: very minute, एकः alone, गत्व: going, सागरम् ocean, भीमम् terrific, रसातलम् the underworld, अम्बरंवा: or the upper world, प्रविष्टान् entering, वानरान् the monkey, निवर्तिष्यामि: I will put an end.
explanation: At this very minute I will go alone into the terrific ocean, to the underworld or the upper world and on entering put an end to the monkey.
hindi: ‘मैं अभी इसी मुहूर्त में अकेला ही जाकर सारे वानरों को मार भगाऊँगा। भले ही वे भयंकर समुद्र में, आकाश में अथवा रसातल में ही क्यों न घुस गये हों

shloka_text: ततोऽब्रवीत्सुसङ्कृद्धो वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाबलः । प्रगृह्य परिघं घोरं मांसशोणितरूषितम् ।।6.8.9।।
translation: ततः then, महाबल: mighty, वज्रदंष्ट्रः one who has diamond like strong teeth, सुसङ्कृद्ध: highly enraged, मांसशोणितरूषितम् stained with flesh and blood, घोरम् dreadful, परिघम् iron bludgeon, प्रगृह्य: clasping, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Then a mighty strong one who was endowed with diamond like teeth highly enraged, clasping a dreadful iron bludgeon stained with flesh and blood spoke.
hindi: इतने ही में महाबली वज्रदंष्ट्र अत्यन्त क्रोध से भरकर रक्त, मांस से सने हुए भयानक परिघ को हाथ में लिये हुए बोला-

shloka_text: किं वो हनुमता कार्यं कृपणेन तपस्विना । रामे तिष्ठति दुर्धर्षे ससुग्रीवेऽपि सलक्ष्मणे ।।6.8.10।।
translation: दुर्धर्षे: one who is unassailable, रामे: while Rama, सलक्ष्मणे: along with Lakshmana, ससुग्रीवेऽपि: and also Sugriva, तिष्ठति: is there, कृपणेन: pitiable, तपस्विना: helpless, हनुमता: with Hanuman, व: for us, कार्यम् work, किम् what.
explanation: "While unassailable Rama is there, along with Lakshmana and Sugriva, what have we to do with miserable, pitiable and helpless Hanuman?"
hindi: ‘दुर्जय वीर राम, सुग्रीव और लक्ष्मण के रहते हुए हमें उस बेचारे तपस्वी हनुमान् से क्या काम है?

shloka_text: अद्य रामं ससुग्रीवं परिघेण सलक्ष्मणम् । आगमिष्यामि हत्वैको विक्षोभ्य हरिवाहिनीम् ।।6.8.11।।
translation: अद्य: now, एकः alone, परिघेण: by the iron crow bar, ससुग्रीववम् that Sugriva, सलक्ष्मणम् and that Lakshmana, रामम् and Rama also, हत्वा: killing, हरिवाहिनीम् Vanara troops, विक्षोभ्य: after shattering, आगमिष्यामि: would return.
explanation: "Now I would go alone and with the iron crowbar, kill Sugriva Lakshmana and Rama and return after shattering the Vanara troops."
hindi: ‘आज मैं अकेला ही वानर-सेना में तहल का मचा दूंगा और इस परिघ से सुग्रीव तथा लक्ष्मणसहित राम का भी काम तमाम करके लौट आऊँगा

shloka_text: इदं ममापरं वाक्यं शृणु राजन् यदीच्छसि । उपायकुशलो ह्येव जयेच्छत्रूनतन्द्रितः ।।6.8.12।।
translation: राजन् O king, यदिइच्छसि: if you like, मम: my, अपरम् another, इदंवाक्यम् this statement, शृणु: you listen, उपायकुशलःएव: only one who is cunning, अतन्द्रितः one who is vigilant, शत्रून् enemy, जयेत् हि: would win.
explanation: "O King If you like, listen to my other statement: One who is cunning and is vigilant would win over an enemy."
hindi: ‘राजन् ! यदि आपकी इच्छा हो तो आप यह मेरी दूसरी बात सुनें। उपायकुशल पुरुष ही यदि आलस्य छोड़कर प्रयत्न करे तो वह शत्रुओं पर विजय पा सकता है

shloka_text: कामरूपधराश्शूरास्सुभीमा भीमदर्शनाः । राक्षसा वै सहस्राणि राक्षसाधिप निश्चिताः ।।6.8.13।।
translation: राक्षसाधिप: Lord of Rakshasas, कामरूपधराः one who is capable of assuming any form at free will, शूराः hero, सुभीमाः very fearful, भीमदर्शनाः of frightful appearance, सहस्राणि: thousands of, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, निश्चिताः determined, मानुषम् human, वपुः body, बिभ्रतः wearing, काकुत्स्थम् of Kakutstha dynasty, उपसङ्गम्य: going near, सर्वे: all, असम्भ्रमाः without any agitation, रघुसत्तमम् the foremost of Raghu dynasty, ब्रुवन्तु: should tell.
explanation: "O Lord of Rakshasas Thousands of fearful Rakshasas capable of assuming any form at free will, heroic ones of frightful appearance should tell Rama the foremost of Raghus, quietly going near him in human form."
hindi: ‘अतः राक्षसराज! मेरी दूसरी राय यह है कि इच्छानुसार रूप धारण करने वाले, अत्यन्त भयानक तथा भयंकर दृष्टिवाले सहस्रों शूरवीर राक्षस एक निश्चित विचार करके मनुष्य का रूप धारण कर श्रीराम के पास जायँ और सब लोग बिना किसी घबराहट के उन रघुवंशशिरोमणि से कहें कि हम आपके सैनिक हैं। हमें आपके छोटे भाई भरत ने भेजा है। इतना सुनते ही वे वानर-सेना को उठाकर तुरंत लङ्का पर आक्रमण करने के लिये वहाँ से चल देंगे

shloka_text: काकुत्स्थमुपसङ्गम्य बिभ्रतो मानुषं वपुः । सर्वे ह्यसम्भ्रमा भूत्वा ब्रुवन्तु रघुसत्तमम् ।।6.8.14।।
translation: राक्षसाधिप: Lord of Rakshasas, कामरूपधराः one who is capable of assuming any form at free will, शूराः hero, सुभीमाः very fearful, भीमदर्शनाः of frightful appearance, सहस्राणि: thousands of, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, निश्चिताः determined, मानुषम् human, वपुः body, बिभ्रतः wearing, काकुत्स्थम् of Kakutstha dynasty, उपसङ्गम्य: going near, सर्वे: all, असम्भ्रमाः without any agitation, रघुसत्तमम् the foremost of Raghu dynasty, ब्रुवन्तु: should tell.
explanation: "O Lord of Rakshasas Thousands of fearful Rakshasas capable of assuming any form at free will, heroic ones of frightful appearance should tell Rama the foremost of Raghus, quietly going near him in human form."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 8.13 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: प्रेषिता भरतेनैव भ्रात्रा तव यवीयसा । स हि सेनां समुत्थाप्य क्षिप्रमेवोपयास्यति ।।6.8.15।।
translation: तव: your, यवीयसा: younger, भ्रात्रा: brother, भरतेनैव: by Bharata, प्रेषिताः sent by, सः he, सेनाम् army, समुत्थाप्य: taking, क्षिप्रमेव: very soon, उपस्थास्यति: is coming.
explanation: "'We have been sent by your younger brother Bharata and he is coming here very soon with the army."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 8.13 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: ततो वयमितस्तूर्णं शूलशक्तिगदाधराः । चापबाणासिहस्ताश्च त्वरितास्तत्र यामहे ।।6.8.16।।
translation: ततः then, वयम् we, शूलशक्तिगदाधराः tridents javelins and maces, चापबाणासि: swords and arrows, हस्ताश्च: wielding, इतः from here, तूर्णम् soon, तत्र: there, त्वरिताः quickly, यामहे: will go.
explanation: "Then from here we will go there wielding tridents, javelins, maces, swords and arrows."
hindi: ‘तत्पश्चात् हमलोग यहाँ से शूल, शक्ति, गदा, धनुष, बाण और खड्ग धारण किये शीघ्र ही मार्ग में उनके पास जा पहुँचें

shloka_text: आकाशे गणश स्थ्सित्वा हत्वा तां हरिवाहिनीम् । अश्मशस्त्रमहावृष्ट्या प्रापयाम यमक्षयम् ।।6.8.17।।
translation: आकाशे: from the sky, गणशः in groups, स्थित्वा: staying there, ताम् those, हरिवाहिनीम् Vanara troops, अश्मशस्त्रमहावृष्ट्या: astras sastras boulders, हत्वा: killing, यमक्षयम् to the abode of Yama, प्रापयाम: will send
explanation: Staying in the sky in groups, we will rain astras, sastras and boulders on the Vanara troops and on killing them, we shall send them to the abode of God of death.
hindi: ‘फिर आकाश में अनेक यूथ बनाकर खड़े हो जायँ और पत्थरों तथा शस्त्र-समूहों की बड़ी भारी वर्षा करके उस वानर-सेना को यमलोक पहुँचा दें

shloka_text: एवं चेदुपसर्पेतामनयं रामलक्ष्मणौ । अवश्यमपनीतेन जहतामेव जीवितम् ।।6.8.18।।
translation: रामलक्ष्मणौ: Rama and Lakshmana, एवम् that way, अनयम् distressed, उपसर्पेतांयदि: they will succumb, अवश्यमेव: certainly, अपनीतेन: cunning ways, जीवितम्: life, जहतामेव: giving up.
explanation: "When Rama and Lakshmana are distressed that way, they would certainly succumb to our cunning ways and give up life."
hindi: ‘यदि इस प्रकार हमारी बातें सुनकर वे दोनों भाई श्रीराम और लक्ष्मण सेना को कूच करने की आज्ञा दे देंगे और वहाँ से चल देंगे तो उन्हें हमारी अनीति का शिकार होना पड़ेगा; उन्हें हमारे छलपूर्ण प्रहार से पीड़ित होकर अपने प्राणों का परित्याग करना पड़ेगा

shloka_text: कौम्भकर्णिस्ततो वीरो निकुम्भो नाम वीर्यवान् । अब्रवीत्परमक्रुद्धो रावणं लोकरावणम् ।।6.8.19।।
translation: ततः thereafter, कौम्भकर्णिः Son of Kumbhakarna, वीरः hero, वीर्यवान् valiant, निकुम्भोनाम: called Nikumbha, परमक्रुद्ध: highly enraged, लोकरावणम् one who makes the world cry, रावणम् Ravana, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Thereafter the enraged heroic and valiant son of Kumbhakarna called Nikumbha said to Ravana, who made the world cry.
hindi: तदनन्तर पराक्रमी वीर कुम्भकर्णकुमार निकुम्भ ने अत्यन्त कुपित होकर समस्त लोकों को रुलाने वाले रावण से कहा-

shloka_text: सर्वे भवन्तस्तिष्ठन्तु महाराजेन सङ्गताः । अहमेको हनिष्यामि राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.8.20।। सुग्रीव ञ्चहनूमन्तं सर्वांनेवच वानरान् ।
translation: भवन्तः of you, सर्वे: all, महाराजेन: King's, सङ्गताः along with, तिष्ठन्तु: stay here, अहम् I, एकः alone, सहलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, राघवम् that Rama, सहानूमन्तम् and with Hanuman, सुग्रीवंच: Sugriva also, सर्वानेव: everyone, वानरान्: those Vanaras, च also, हनिष्यामि will kill.
explanation: "Let all of you stay here along with the king. Going alone I will kill Rama along with Lakshmana, and Hanuman also Sugriva and all of the Vanaras."
hindi: ‘आप सब लोग यहाँ महाराज के साथ चुपचाप बैठे रहें। मैं अकेला ही राम, लक्ष्मण, सुग्रीव, हनुमान् तथा अन्य सब वानरों को भी यहाँ मौत के घाट उतार दूंगा’

shloka_text: ततो वज्रहनुर्नाम राक्षसः पर्वतोपमः ।।6.8.21।। क्रुद्ध: परिलिहन्सृक्कां जिह्वया वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
translation: ततः then, पर्वतोपमः one of mountain like form, वज्रहनुर्नाम Vajrahanu, राक्षसः Rakshasa, क्रुद्ध: angry, जिह्वया: with tongue, सृक्काम् lips, परिलिहन् licking, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Then a Rakshasa called Vajrahanu, mountain like in form, enraged, licking lips with his tongue said these words.
hindi: तब पर्वत के समान विशालकाय वज्रहनु नामक राक्षस कुपित हो जीभ से अपने जबड़े को चाटता हुआ बोला—

shloka_text: स्वैरं कुर्वन्तु कर्माणि भवन्तो विगतज्वराः ।।6.8.22।।
translation: भवन्तः all of you, विगतज्वराः giving up fear, स्वैरम् freely, कर्माणि: duties, कुर्वन्तु: doing, स्वस्थाः moving happily, क्रीडन्तु: sporting, निश्चिन्ताः without any anxiety, वारुणंमधु: sweet wine, पिबन्तु: drinking, अहम् I, एकः single handed, ताम् them, सर्वाम् all, हरियूथपान् Vanara army, भक्षयिष्यामि: will consume.
explanation: All of you giving up fear, do your duties freely move happily sporting and drinking sweet wine. Single handed, I will consume all the Vanara army.
hindi: ‘आप सब लोग निश्चिन्त होकर इच्छानुसार अपना-अपना काम करें। मैं अकेला ही सारी वानरसेना को खा जाऊँगा

shloka_text: एकोऽहं भक्षयिष्यामि तां सर्वां हरियूथपान् । स्वस्थाः क्रीडन्तु निश्चिन्ताः पिबन्तु मधु वारुणीम् ।।6.8.23।।
translation: भवन्तः all of you, विगतज्वराः giving up fear, स्वैरम् freely, कर्माणि: duties, कुर्वन्तु: doing, स्वस्थाः moving happily, क्रीडन्तु: sporting, निश्चिन्ताः without any anxiety, वारुणंमधु: sweet wine, पिबन्तु: drinking, अहम् I, एकः single handed, ताम् them, सर्वाम् all, हरियूथपान् Vanara army, भक्षयिष्यामि: will consume.
explanation: All of you giving up fear, do your duties freely move happily sporting and drinking sweet wine. Single handed, I will consume all the Vanara army.
hindi: ‘आपलोग स्वस्थ रहकर क्रीड़ा करें और निश्चिन्त हो वारुणी मदिरा को पियें। मैं अकेला ही सुग्रीव, लक्ष्मण, अंगद, हनुमान् और अन्य सब वानरों का भी यहाँ वध कर डालूँगा’

shloka_text: अहमेको वधिष्यामि सुग्रीवं सहलक्ष्मणम् । साङ्गदं च हनूमन्तं रामंचरणकुञ्जरम् ।।6.8.24।।
translation: अहम् I, एकः alone, सहलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, सुग्रीवम् and Sugriva, साङ्गदम् that Angada, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, रणकुञ्जरम् army, रामम् च: and Rama, वधिष्यामि: will kill.
explanation: "I alone will kill that Rama with Lakshmana, Sugriva, that Angada, Hanuman and the Vanara army." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टमस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 8.23 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: ततो निकुम्भो रभसस्सूर्यशत्रुर्महाबलः । सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञहारक्षो महापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।।6.9.1।।
translation: ततः then, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, रभसः Rshaba, महाबलः mighty strong, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, सुप्तघ्नः Supthagna, यज्ञहरक्षो: Yagna raksha, महापार्शो: Mahaparsva, महोदरौ: Mahodara, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च: Agnikethu, रश्मिकेतुश्च: Rasmikethu, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, ततः Further, बलवन् powerful, रावणात्मजः Ravana's own son, महाबलः powerful, इन्द्रजिच्च: and Indrajith, प्रहस्तोऽथ: Prahastha, विरूपाक्षो: Virupaksha, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraaksha, अथ: and also, दुर्मुखश्चैव: Durmukha also, राक्षसः Rakshasas, पट्टिशान् iron bars, शूलान् tridents, प्रासान् battle axes, शक्ति: power, परश्वथान् and axes, सुबाणानि: good arrows, चापानि: bows, विपुलान्शितान् very sharp, खङ्गांश्च: swords, प्रगृह्य: wielding, परमक्रुद्धा: highly enraged, तेजसा: bright, प्रदीप्ताः glowing like fire, व: those, सर्वे: all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, समुत्पत्य: rising up, रावणम् at Ravana, अब्रुवन् said.
explanation: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.
comments: Vibheeshana begins to advise the Rakshasas and Ravana.
hindi: तत्पश्चात् निकुम्भ, रभस, महाबली सूर्यशत्र, सुप्तघ्न, यज्ञकोप, महापार्श्व, महोदर, दुर्जय अग्निकेतु, राक्षस रश्मिकेतु, महातेजस्वी बलवान् रावणकुमार इन्द्रजित् , प्रहस्त, विरूपाक्ष, महाबली वज्रदंष्ट्र, धूम्राक्ष, अतिकाय और निशाचर दुर्मुख—ये सब राक्षस अत्यन्त कुपित हो हाथों में परिघ, पट्टिश, शूल, प्रास, शक्ति, फरसे, धनुष, बाण तथा पैनी धारवाले बड़े-बड़े खड्ग लिये उछलकर रावण के सामने आये और अपने तेज से उद्दीप्त-से होकर वे सब-के-सब उससे बोले-

shloka_text: अग्निकेतुश्च दुर्धर्षो रश्मिकेतुश्च राक्षस: । इन्द्रजिच्च महातेजा बलवान्रावणात्मजः ।।6.9.2।।

shloka_text: अद्य रामं वधिष्यामस्सुग्रीवं सच लक्ष्मणम् । कृपणं च हनूमन्तं लङ्का येन प्रधर्षिता ।।6.9.6।।
translation: रामम् Rama, सहलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, सुग्रीवंच: and Sugriva, येन: on which account, लङ्का: Lanka, प्रधर्षिता: was attacked, कृपणम् vile, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, अद्य: now, वधिष्यामः will kill.
explanation: "Right now, we will kill Rama along with Lakshmana, Sugriva and vile Hanuman, on whose account Lanka was attacked."
hindi: ‘हमलोग आज ही राम, सुग्रीव, लक्ष्मण और उस कायर हनुमान् को भी मार डालेंगे, जिसने लङ्कापुरी जलायी है’

shloka_text: तान्गृहीतायुधान् सर्वान्वारयित्वा विभीषणः । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं पुनः प्रत्युपवेश्य तान् ।।6.9.7।।
translation: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, गृहीतायुधान् wielding arms, तान् सर्वान् all those, वारयित्वा: stopping, तान् those, प्रत्युपवेश्य: and making them sit, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् addressed.
explanation: With folded hands, Vibheeshana made all the (Rakshasas) wielding arms to stop and sit and addressed these words to Ravana.
hindi: हाथों में अस्त्र-शस्त्र लिये खड़े हुए उन सब राक्षसों को जाने के लिये उद्यत देख विभीषण ने रोका और पुनः उन्हें बिठाकर दोनों हाथ जोड़ रावण से कहा-

shloka_text: अप्युपायैस्त्रिभिस्तात योऽर्थः प्राप्तुं न शक्यते । तस्य विक्रमकालांस्तान्युक्तानाहुर्मनीषिणः ।।6.9.8।।
translation: तात: father, यः one who takes, अर्थः I ask, त्रिभिः of the three (Sama Dana and Bheda), उपायैरपि: means also, प्राप्तम् attained, नशक्यते: not possible, तस्य: his, विक्रमकालान् heroic deed, युक्तान् diligently, मनीषिणः intelligent, आहुः yes.
explanation: "Dear father, intelligent people say that an act which cannot be accomplished by the three means (Sama  Conciliation, Dana  Gift, Bheda  Sowing dissension), should only be accomplished diligently by one's heroic deed. Therefore, we should think of war only after the above three means are employed."
hindi: ‘तात ! जो मनोरथ साम, दान और भेद—इन तीन उपायों से प्राप्त न हो सके, उसी की प्राप्ति के लिये नीतिशास्त्र के ज्ञाता मनीषी विद्वानों ने पराक्रम करने के योग्य अवसर बताये हैं

shloka_text: प्रमत्तेष्यभियुक्तेषु दैवेन प्रहतेषु च । विक्रमास्तात सिध्यन्ति परीक्ष्य विधिना कृताः ।।6.9.9।।
translation: तात: father, प्रमत्तेषु: at those who are not alert, अभियुक्तेषु: at those who are attacked, दैवेन: by fate, प्रहतेषुच: those who are struck, परीक्ष्य: examine, विधिना: according to prescribed method, कृताः one who performed deeds, विक्रमाः of heroic valour, सिध्यन्ति: will succeed.
explanation: "O Dear at those who are not alert, who are attacked by the enemy, and who are struck by fate, if you examine diligently according to prescribed method and perform deeds of heroic valour you will succeed."
hindi: ‘तात ! जो शत्रु असावधान हों, जिन पर दूसरे-दूसरे शत्रुओं ने आक्रमण किया हो तथा जो महारोग आदि से ग्रस्त होने के कारण दैव से मारे गये हों, उन्हीं पर भलीभाँति परीक्षा करके विधिपूर्वक किये गये पराक्रम सफल होते हैं

shloka_text: अप्रमत्तं कथं तं तु विजिगीषुं बले स्थितम् । जितरोषं दुराधर्ष तं प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छथ ।।6.9.10।।
translation: अप्रमत्तम् very attentive, विजिगीषुम् bent on victory, बले: mighty, स्थितम् steadfast, जितरोषम् subdued anger, दुराधर्षम् unassailable, तम् him, कथम् how, प्रधर्षयितुम् to overpower, इच्छथ: desire.
explanation: "How do you wish to overpower, him who is very attentive, bent on victory, mighty, steadfast, has subdued anger and unassailable?"
hindi: ‘श्रीरामचन्द्रजी बेखबर नहीं हैं। वे विजय की इच्छा से आ रहे हैं और उनके साथ सेना भी है। उन्होंने क्रोध को सर्वथा जीत लिया है। अतः वे सर्वथा दुर्जय हैं। ऐसे अजेय वीर को तुमलोग परास्त करना चाहते हो

shloka_text: समुद्रं लङ्घयित्वा तु घोरं नदनदीपतिम् । गतिं हनूमतो लोके को विद्यात्तर्कयेत वा ।।6.9.11।।
translation: नदनदीपतिम् Lord of streams and rivers, घोरम् terrific, समुद्रम् ocean, लङ्घयित्वा: crossed over, हनुमतः Hanuman, गतिम् arrived at, लोके: in the world, कः who can ever, विद्यात् can know, तर्कयेतवा: or think of.
explanation: "Hanuman has crossed over the ocean, a Lord of streams and rivers and arrived. Who can ever know or think of such a task in this world?"
hindi: ‘निशाचरो! नदों और नदियों के स्वामी भयंकर महासागर को जो एक ही छलाँग में लाँघकर यहाँ तक आ पहुँचे थे, उन हनुमान जी की गति को इस संसार में कौन जान सकता है अथवा कौन उसका अनुमान लगा सकता है? शत्रुओं के पास असंख्य सेनाएँ हैं, उनमें असीम बल और पराक्रम है; इस बात को तुमलोग अच्छी तरह जान लो। दूसरों की शक्ति को भुलाकर किसी तरह भी सहसा उनकी अवहेलना नहीं करनी चाहिये

shloka_text: बलान्यपरिमेयानि वीर्याणि च निशाचराः । परेषां सहसाऽवज्ञा न कर्तव्या कथञ्चन ।।6.9.12।।
translation: निशाचराः night ranger, परेषाम् enemy's, बलानि: strength, वीर्याणिच: and valour, अपरिमेयानि: inestimable, कथञ्चन: to relate, सहसा: rashly, अवज्ञा: to disregard, नकर्तव्या: not do.
explanation: "Enemy's strength and valour is inestimable to relate. Do not disregard rashly, O Night ranger"
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 9.11 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: किं च राक्षसराजस्य रामेणापकृतं पुरा । आजहार जनस्थानाद्यस्य भार्यां यशस्विनः ।।6.9.13।।
translation: यशस्विनः glorious, यस्य: his, भार्याम् wife, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, आजहार: abducted, रामेण: Rama's, पुरा: earlier, राक्षसराजस्य: to the Rakshasa king, किम् why, अपकृतम् offence.
explanation: "What offence did Rama do earlier to the Rakshasa king that he abducted the glorious wife of Rama from Janasthana?"
hindi: ‘श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ने पहले राक्षसराज रावण का कौन सा अपराध किया था, जिससे उन यशस्वी महात्मा की पत्नी को ये जनस्थान से हर लाये?

shloka_text: खरो यद्यतिवृत्तस्तु रामेण निहतो रणे । अवश्यं प्राणिनां प्राणा रक्षितव्या यथाबलम् ।।6.9.14।।
translation: अतिवृत्तः acted beyond his limit, खरः Khara, रणे: in war, रामेण: by Rama, हतःयदि has been killed also, प्राणिना: by living beings, यथाबलम् their own strength, प्राणाः life, अवश्यम् certainly, रक्षितव्याः will have to protect.
explanation: "(It is true) Khara was killed by Rama in war as he acted beyond his limit. Certainly, living beings will have to protect their life with their own strength."
hindi: ‘यदि कहें कि उन्होंने खर को मारा था तो यह ठीक नहीं है; क्योंकि खर अत्याचारी था। उसने स्वयं ही उन्हें मार डालने के लिये उन पर आक्रमण किया था। इसलिये श्रीराम ने रणभूमि में उसका वध किया; क्योंकि प्रत्येक प्राणी को यथाशक्ति अपने प्राणों की रक्षा अवश्य करनी चाहिये

shloka_text: एतन्निमित्तं वैदेही भयं नस्सुमहद्भवेत् । आहृता सा परित्याज्या कलहार्थे कृते न किम् ।।6.9.15।।
translation: एतन्निमित्तम् on account of this reason, नः to us, सुमहत् great, वैदेहीभयम् fear from Vaidehi, भवेत् will have, आहृता: brought, सा: that, परित्याज्या: given away, कलहार्थे: cause of strife, कृतेन: by doing so, किम् why.
explanation: "On account of this, we have a great fear of Vaidehi. She, who was brought here, is to be given away. What is the use of doing anything, which may be the cause of strife?"
hindi: ‘यदि इसी कारण से सीता को हरकर लाया गया हो तो उन्हें जल्दी ही लौटा देना चाहिये; अन्यथा हमलोगों पर महान् भय आ सकता है। जिस कर्म का फल केवल कलह है, उसे करने से क्या लाभ?

shloka_text: न तु क्षमं वीर्यवता तेन धर्मानुवर्तिना । वैरं निरर्थकं कर्तुं दीयतामस्य मैथिली ।।6.9.16।।
translation: वीर्यवता: valorous one, धर्मानुवर्तिना: follower of dharma, तेन: his, निरर्थकम् useless, वैरम् enmity, कर्तुम् to have, नतुक्षमम् not good for us, मैथिली: Mythili, अस्य: to him, दीयताम् give away.
explanation: "To have enmity with a valorous one, a follower of dharma, is useless and not good for us. Give away Mythili to him (Rama)."
hindi: ‘श्रीराम बड़े धर्मात्मा और पराक्रमी हैं। उनके साथ व्यर्थ वैर करना उचित नहीं है। मिथिलेशकुमारी सीता को उनके पास लौटा देना चाहिये

shloka_text: यावन्न सगजां साश्वां बहुरत्नसमाकुलाम् । पुरीं दारयते बाणैर्दीयतामस्य मैथिली ।।6.9.17।।
translation: सगजाम् with elephants, साश्वम् horses, बहुरत्नसमाकुलाम् filled with many gems, पुरीम् city, बाणैः arrows, यावत् all over, नदारयते: before tearing, अस्य: his, मैथिली: Mythili, दीयताम् will give.
explanation: "Before Rama comes with elephants and horses and tears with his arrows, this Lanka filled with abundance of gems, give away Mythili."
hindi: ‘जबतक हाथी, घोड़े और अनेकों रत्नों से भरी हुई लङ्कापुरी का श्रीराम अपने बाणों द्वारा विध्वंस नहीं कर डालते, तब तक ही मैथिली को उन्हें लौटा दिया जाय

shloka_text: यावत्सुघोरा महती दुर्धर्षा हरिवाहिनी । नावस्कन्दति नो लङ्कां तावत्सीता प्रदीयताम् ।।6.9.18।।
translation: सुघोरा: highly dreadful, दुर्धर्षा: formidable, महती: huge, हरिवाहिनी: Vanara troops, यावत् total, नः lest, लङ्काम् Lanka, नावस्कन्दति: surrounds, तावत् before doing anything, सीता: Sita, प्रदीयताम् give away.
explanation: "Lest the highly dreadful, formidable and huge Vanara troops surround all over Lanka. Give away Sita."
hindi: ‘जबतक अत्यन्त भयंकर, विशाल और दुर्जय वानर-वाहिनी हमारी लङ्का को पददलित नहीं कर देती, तभी तक सीता को वापस कर दिया जाय

shloka_text: विनश्येद्धि पुरी लङ्का शूरास्सर्वे च राक्षसाः । रामस्य दयिता पत्नी न स्वयं नयदि दीयते ।।6.9.19।।
translation: रामस्य: Rama's, दयिता: dear, स्वयम् his own, पत्नी: wife, नदीयतेयदि: if not given, चलङ्कापुरी: and this Lanka, विनश्येत् हि: will be destroyed, सर्वे: all, राक्षसाश्च: Rakshasas also.
explanation: "If Rama's dear wife is not given, this Lanka will be destroyed and also all Rakshasas."
hindi: ‘यदि श्रीराम की प्राणवल्लभा सीता को हमलोग स्वयं ही नहीं लौटा देते हैं तो यह लङ्कापुरी नष्ट हो जायगी और समस्त शूरवीर राक्षस मार डाले जायेंगे

shloka_text: प्रसादये त्वां बन्धुत्वात्कुरुष्य वचनं मम । हितं तथ्य महं ब्रूमि दीयतामस्य मैथिली ।।6.9.20।।
translation: बन्धुत्वात् relation, त्वाम् your, प्रसादये: requesting you, मम: my, वचनम् words, कुरुष्य: do as I say, अहम् I, हितम् welfare, तथ्यंतु: for your, ब्रूमि: telling, अस्य: his, मैथिली: Mythili, दीयताम् give away.
explanation: "I am requesting you because you are my relation (brother). Do as I said, as I am telling you for your welfare. Give away Sita."
hindi: ‘आप मेरे बड़े भाई हैं। अतः मैं आपको विनयपूर्वक प्रसन्न करना चाहता हूँ। आप मेरी बात मान लें। मैं आपके हित के लिये सच्ची बात कहता हूँ -आप श्रीरामचन्द्रजी को उनकी सीता वापस कर दें

shloka_text: पुरा शरत्सूर्यमरीचिसन्निभान्नवाग्रपुङ्खान् सुदृढान्नृपात्मजः । सृजत्यमोघान्विशिखान्वधाय ते प्रदीयतां दशरधाय मैथिली ।।6.9.21।।
translation: नृपात्मजः son of emperor, शरत्सूर्यमरीचिसन्निभान् shining like the autumnal Sun, नवाग्रपुङ्खान् provided with fresh heads and shafts, सुदृढान् solid, आमोघान् unfailing, विशिखान् arrows, ते for your, वधाय: killing, पुरा: before, सृजति: sends forth, मैथिली: Mythili, दाशरथाय: son of Dasaratha, प्रदीयताम् you may restore.
explanation: "You may restore Rama's Mythili, before the emperor Dasaratha's son sends forth solid unfailing arrows shining like autumnal Sun provided with fresh heads and shafts for killing you."
hindi: ‘राजकुमार श्रीराम जबतक आपके वध के लिये शरत्काल के सूर्य की किरणों के समान तेजस्वी, उज्ज्वल अग्रभाग एवं पंखों से सुशोभित, सुदृढ़ तथा अमोघ बाणों की वर्षा करें, उसके पहले ही आप उन दशरथनन्दन की सेवा में मिथिलेशकुमारी सीता को सौंप दें

shloka_text: त्वजस्व कोपं सुखधर्मनाशनं भजस्व धर्मं रतिकीर्तिवर्धनम् । प्रसीद जीवेम सपुत्रबान्धवाः प्रदीयतां दाशरथाय मैथिली ।।6.9.22।।
translation: सुखधर्मनाशनम् happiness will destroy virtues, कोपम् anger, आशु: that, त्यज: give up, रतिकीर्तिवर्धनम् pleasures that enhance fame, धर्मम् righteousness, भजस्व: seek, प्रसीद: pacified, सपुत्रबान्धवाः with sons and relatives, जीवेम: live, मैथिली: Mythili, दाशरथाय: Dasaratha's son Rama's, प्रदीयताम् restore.
explanation: "Give up that happiness and anger which destroys virtues. Seek pleasures that enhance fame. Be pacified. Live happily with sons and relatives restoring Mythili to Rama, the son of Dasaratha."
hindi: ‘भैया! आप क्रोध को त्याग दें; क्योंकि वह सुख और धर्म का नाश करने वाला है। धर्म का सेवन कीजिये; क्योंकि वह सुख और सुयश को बढ़ाने वाला है। हम पर प्रसन्न होइये, जिससे हम पुत्र और बन्धु बान्धवों सहित जीवित रह सकें। इसी दृष्टि से मेरी प्रार्थना है कि आप दशरथनन्दन श्रीराम के हाथ में मिथिलेशकुमारी सीता को लौटा दें’

shloka_text: विभीषणवच्शुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वराः । विसर्जयित्वा तान्सर्वान्प्रविवेश स्वकं गृहम् ।।6.9.23।।
translation: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, तान् those, सर्वान् everything, विसर्जयित्वा: sending away, स्वकम् he too, गृहम् home, प्रविवेश: entered.
explanation: Having heard everything that was told by Vibheeshana, the Lord of Rakshasas sent away all and entered his palace. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेनवमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
hindi: विभीषण की यह बात सुनकर राक्षसराज रावण उन सब सभासदों को विदा करके अपने महल में चला गया

shloka_text: ततः प्रत्युषसि प्राप्ते प्राप्तधर्मार्थनिश्चयः । राक्षसाधिपतेर्वेश्म भीमकर्मा विभीषणः ।।6.10.1।।
translation: ततः thereafter, प्राप्तधर्मार्थनिश्चयः determined to relate about righteous and material gains, भीमकर्मा: of fierce task, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रत्युषसि: when morning Sun, प्राप्ते: rose, राक्षसाधिपतेः Lord of Rakshasas, वेश्म: residence.
explanation: Thereafter, determined to relate about righteous and material gains, Vibheeshana of fierce tasks got up early in the morning when the Sun rose and set himself to go to the residence of Lord of Rakshasas.
comments: Vibheeshana once again goes to Ravana and appeals to him stating about the evil portents.
hindi: दूसरे दिन सबेरा होते ही धर्म और अर्थ के तत्त्व को जानने वाले भीमकर्मा महातेजस्वी वीर विभीषण अपने बड़े भाई राक्षसराज रावण के घर गये। वह घर अनेक प्रासादों के कारण पर्वतशिखरों के समूह की भाँति शोभा पाता था। उसकी ऊँचाई भी पहाड़ की चोटी को लज्जित करती थी। उसमें अलग-अलग बड़ी-बड़ी कक्षाएँ (ड्योढ़ियाँ) सुन्दर ढंग से बनी हुई थीं। बहुतेरे श्रेष्ठ पुरुषों का वहाँ आना-जाना लगा रहता था। अनेकानेक बुद्धिमान् महामन्त्री, जो राजा के प्रति अनुराग रखने वाले थे, उसमें बैठे थे। विश्वसनीय, हितैषी तथा कार्यसाधन में कुशल बहुसंख्यक राक्षस सब ओर से उस भवन की रक्षा करते थे। वहाँ की वायु मतवाले हाथियों के निःश्वास से मिश्रित हो बवंडर-सी जान पड़ती थी। शङ्खध्वनि के समान राक्षसों का गम्भीर घोष वहाँ गूंजता रहता था। नाना प्रकार के वाद्यों के मनोरम शब्द उस भवन को निनादित करते थे। रूप और यौवन के मद से मतवाली युवतियों की वहाँ भीड-सी लगती रहती थी। वहाँ के बड़े-बड़े मार्ग लोगों के वार्तालाप से मुखरित जान पड़ते थे। उसके फाटक तपाये हुए सुवर्ण के बने हुए थे। उत्तम सजावट की वस्तुओं से वह महल अच्छी तरह सजा हुआ था, अतएव वह गन्धर्वो के आवास और देवताओं के निवासस्थान-सा मनोरम प्रतीत होता था। रत्नराशि से परिपूर्ण होने के कारण वह नागभवन के समान उद्भासित होता था। जैसे तेज से विस्तृत किरणों वाले सूर्य महान् मेघों की घटा में प्रवेश करते हैं, उसी प्रकार तेजस्वी विभीषण ने रावण के उस भवन में पदार्पण किया

shloka_text: शैलाग्रचयसङ्काशं शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् । सुविभक्तमहाकक्षं महाजनपरिग्रहम् ।।6.10.2।।
translation: शैलाग्रचयसङ्काशं: like a lofty mountain top with many peaks, शैलशृङ्गमिव: like a summit of a mountain, उन्नतम् supreme, सुविभक्तमहाकक्षम् divided into many spacious sections, महाजनपरिग्रहम् surrounded by many people.
explanation: Like a lofty mountain top, and like a summit of a mountain, Ravana's palace was a supreme one, divided into many spacious sections and surrounded by many people.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 10.1 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: मतिमद्भिर्महामात्रैरनुरक्तैरधिष्ठितम् । राक्षसैराप्तपर्याप्तैस्सर्वतः परिरक्षितम् ।।6.10.3।।
translation: मतिमद्भि: wise ones, अनुरक्तै: devoted to their Lord, महामात्रैः great ministers, अधिष्ठितम् commanded by, आप्तपर्याप्तै: competent and trustworthy, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, सर्वतः everywhere, परिरक्षितम् well protected.
explanation: The palace was inhabited by wise ones, and devoted to their Lord and ministers,commanded by trustworthy and competent Rakshasas spread everywhere and well protected.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 10.1 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: मत्तमातङ्गनिश्श्वासैर्व्याकुलीकृतमारुतम् । शङ्खघोषमहाघोषं तूर्यनादानुनादितम् ।।6.10.4।।
translation: मत्तमातङ्गनिश्श्वासैः elephants in rut breathing heavily, व्याकुलीकृतमरुतम् filled by tempestuous wind, शङ्खघोषमहाघोषम् echoed by the sound of blowing conchs of the early morning, तूर्यनादानुनादितम् filled with the sounds of drums and trumpets.
explanation: It was filled with elephants in rut breathing heavily, which was like a tempestuous wind around, that echoed by the blowing of conchs of the early morning and filled with the sounds of drums and trumpets.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 10.1 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: प्रमदाजनसम्बाधं प्रजल्पितमहापथम् । तप्तकाञ्चननिर्यूहं भूषणोत्तमभूषितम् ।।6.10.5।।
translation: प्रमदाजनसम्बाधम् filled with women, प्रजल्पितमहापथम् royal path filled with the prattling sounds of gossiping, तप्तकाञ्चननिर्यूहम् shining golden passages, भूषणोत्तमभूषितम् decorated with the best of ornaments.
explanation: (It was) The royal path was filled with women, with prattling sounds of gossiping. It had shining golden passages and decorated with the best of ornaments.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 10.1 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: गन्धर्वाणामिवाऽवासमालयं मरुतामिव । रत्नसञ्चयसम्बाधं भवनं भोगिनामिव ।।6.10.6।।
translation: गन्धर्वाणाम् of Gandharvas, आवासम् इव: like the abode, मरुतामिव: of the wind god, आलयम् abode, रत्नसञ्चयसम्बाधम् abounding in the collection of precious gems, भोगिनाम् indulging in enjoyment like Nagas, भवनम् इव: like mansion.
explanation: (It was) like the abode of Gandharvas (the celestial musicians), like an abode of wind god, abounding in collection of precious gems, like the mansion of Nagas indulging  in enjoyment.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 10.1 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: तं महाभ्रमिवाऽदित्यस्तेजोविस्तृतरश्मिमान् । अग्रजस्यालयं वीरः प्रविवेश महाद्युतिः ।।6.10.7।।
translation: महाद्युतिः one of exceptional splendour, वीरः heroic, तेजो: brilliant, विस्तृतरश्मिमान् one whose radiance was spread widely, आदित्यः Sun, महाभ्रमिव: highly lustrous, अग्रजस्य: brother's, तम् आलयम् that abode, प्रविवेश: entered.
explanation: Heroic (Vibheeshana) of exceptional splendour, whose brilliance spread widely like the radiance of the highly lustrous Sun entered his brother's abode.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 10.1 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: पुण्यान्पुण्याहघोषांश्च वेदविद्भिरुदाहृतान् । शुश्राव सुमहातेजा भ्रातुर्विजयसंश्रितान् ।।6.10.8।।
translation: सुमहातेजाः highly effulgent, भ्रातुः for brother, विजयसंश्रितान् desiring propitious day, वेदविद्भि: who are learned in the Vedas, उदाहृतान् uttering, पुण्यान् sacred, पुण्याहघोषान् sounds of sacred mantras, शुश्रावच: heard.
explanation: Highly effulgent (Vibheeshana) heard sounds of recitation of sacred mantras from Vedas uttered by learned ones desiring a propitious day for his brother.
hindi: वहाँ पहुँचकर उन महातेजस्वी विभीषण ने अपने भाई की विजय के उद्देश्य से वेदवेत्ता ब्राह्मणों द्वारा किये गये पुण्याहवाचन के पवित्र घोष सुने

shloka_text: पूजितान् दधिपात्रैश्च सर्पिर्भिस्सुमनोक्षतैः । मन्त्रवेदविदो विप्रान्ददर्श स महाबलः ।।6.10.9।।
translation: महाबलः mighty, सः he, दधिपात्रैश्च: pots of curd, सर्पिर्भिः clarified butter, सुमनोक्षतैः with yellow rice, पूजितान् worshipped by, मन्त्रवेदविदः learned in vedas and mantras, विप्रान् by brahmins, ददर्श: saw.
explanation: Mighty Vibheeshana saw there, brahmins learned in vedas and mantras, who worshipped with yellow rice, curd, clarified butter and flowers.
hindi: तत्पश्चात् उन महाबली विभीषण ने वेदमन्त्रों के ज्ञाता ब्राह्मणों का दर्शन किया, जिनके हाथों में दही और घी के पात्र थे। फूलों और अक्षतों से उन सबकी पूजा की गयी थी

shloka_text: स पूज्यमानो रक्षोभिद्दीप्यमानस्स्वतेजसा । आसनस्थं महाबाहुर्ववन्दे धनदानुजम् ।।6.10.10।।
translation: रक्षोभिः by Rakshasas, पूज्यमानः one who is revered, महाबाहुः one with broad shoulders, सः that Ravana, स्वतेजसा: self brilliance, दीप्यमानम् shining, आसनस्थम् seated on his chair, धनदानुजम् brother of Kubera, ववन्दे: greeted with folded palms.
explanation: Vibheeshana, of broad shoulders, who is revered by Rakshasas was shining in his own splendour. He greeted with folded palms, the brother of Kubera (Ravana) seated on his chair.
hindi: वहाँ जाने पर राक्षसों ने उनका स्वागत-सत्कार किया। फिर उन महाबाहु विभीषण ने अपने तेज से देदीप्यमान और सिंहासन पर विराजमान कुबेर के छोटे भाई रावण को प्रणाम किया

shloka_text: स राजदृष्टिसम्पन्नमासनं हेमभूषितम् । जगाम समुदाचारं प्रयुज्याचारकोविदः ।।6.10.11।।
translation: आचारकोविदः learned in traditions, सः that Vibheeshana, समुदाचारम् wellversed in the code of conduct, प्रयुज्यराजदृष्टिसम्पन्नम् blessed by the glance of the king, हेमभूषितम् decorated with gold, आसनम् seat, जगाम: reached.
explanation: Vibheeshana who was learned in traditions and wellversed with code of conduct reached a seat decorated with gold blessed by the glance of the king Ravana.
hindi: तदनन्तर शिष्टाचार के ज्ञाता विभीषण ‘विजयतां महाराजः’ (महाराज की जय हो) इत्यादि रूप से राजा के प्रति परम्पराप्राप्त शुभाशंसासूचक वचन का प्रयोग करके राजा के द्वारा दृष्टि के संकेत से बताये गये सुवर्णभूषित सिंहासन पर बैठ गये

shloka_text: स रावणं महात्मानं विजने मन्त्रिसन्निधौ । उवाच हितमत्यर्थं वचनं हेतुनिश्चितम् ।।6.10.12।।
translation: सः he Vibheeshana, विजने: when none were there, मन्त्रिसन्निधौ: in the presence of ministers, महात्मानम् distinguished one, रावणम् at Ravana, हेतुनिश्चितम् wishing the welfare decidedly, अत्यर्थम् meaningful, हितम् advice, वचनम् words, उवाच: spoke.
explanation: When none other than ministers were present, Vibheeshana spoke these meaningful words to the distinguished Ravana, decidedly wishing for welfare.
hindi: विभीषण जगत् की भली-बुरी बातों को अच्छी तरह जानते थे। उन्होंने प्रणाम आदि व्यवहार का यथार्थरूप से निर्वाह करके सान्त्वनापूर्ण वचनों द्वारा अपने बड़े भाई महामना रावण को प्रसन्न किया और उससे एकान्त में मन्त्रियों के निकट देश, काल और प्रयोजन के अनुरूप, युक्तियों द्वारा निश्चित तथा अत्यन्त हितकारक बात कही—

shloka_text: प्रसाद्य भ्रातरं जेष्ठं सान्त्वेनोपस्थितक्रमः । देशकालार्थसंवादि दृष्टलोकपरावरः ।।6.10.13।।
translation: दृष्टलोकपरावरः one who knew good and bad of the world, सान्त्वेन: in appeasing way, ज्येष्ठंभ्रातरं: to elder brother, प्रसाद्य: propitiated, उपस्थितक्रमः observing the customary traditions, देशकालार्थसंवादि: one who knows the time and place of advice.
explanation: Vibheeshana who knew the good and bad of the world and knew to advice in consonance with place and time said to his elder brother in an appeasing manner, propitiating him observing the customary tradition.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 10.12 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: यदाप्रभृति वैदेही सम्प्रास्तेमां पुरींतव । तदाप्रभृति दृश्यन्ते निमित्तान्यशुभानि नः ।।6.10.14।।
translation: इमांपुरीं: this city, वैदेही: Vaidehi, यदाप्रभृतिइह: since she has come here, सम्प्राप्ता: observed, तदाप्रभृति: such signs are observed, नः by us, अशुभानि: inauspicious, निमित्तानि: happenings, दृश्यन्ते: are seen.
explanation: "Since Vaidehi has come to this city, inauspicious happenings are seen by us."
hindi: ‘शत्रुओं को संताप देने वाले महाराज! जबसे विदेहकुमारी सीता यहाँ आयी हैं, तभी से हमलोगों को अनेक प्रकार के अमङ्गलसूचक अपशकुन दिखायी दे रहे हैं

shloka_text: सस्फुलिङ्गस्सधूमार्चिस्सधूमकलुषोदयः । मन्त्रसङ्घहुतोऽप्यग्निर्न सम्यगभिवर्थते ।।6.10.15।।
translation: मन्त्रसङ्घहुतःअपि: even the fire sacrifices, अग्निः fire, सस्फुलिङ्गः with fire particles, सधूमार्चिः with smoke, सधूमकलुषोदयः mixed with smoke, सम्यक् well, नाभिवर्धते: not burning with brilliance.
explanation: "Even from the fire of fire sacrifices, fire particles polluted with smoke are rising and the fire is not burning with brilliance."
hindi: ‘मन्त्रों द्वारा विधिपूर्वक धधकाने पर भी आग अच्छी तरह प्रज्वलित नहीं हो रही है। उससे चिनगारियाँ निकलने लगती हैं। उसकी लपट के साथ धुआँ उठने लगता है और मन्थनकाल में जब अग्नि प्रकट होती है, उस समय भी वह धूएँसे मलिन ही रहती है

shloka_text: अग्निष्ठेष्वग्निशलासु तथा ब्रह्मस्थालीषु च । सरीसृपाणि दृश्यन्ते हन्येषु च पिपीलिकाः ।।6.10.16।।
translation: अग्निष्ठेषु: in cooking fire, अग्निशालासु: in places of fire sacrifice, तथा: so also, ब्रह्मस्थलीषुच: at places where offerings are made into fire, सरीसृपाणि: serpents, दृश्यन्ते: are seen, हव्येषु: in the Havis, पिपीलिकाः ants are seen.
explanation: "In the cooking fire, in places of fire sacrifice, so also at places where offerings are made into fire, serpents are seen. Ants are seen in the Havis."
hindi: ‘रसोई-घरों में, अग्निशालाओं में तथा वेदाध्ययन के स्थानों में भी साँप देखे जाते हैं और हवन-सामग्रियों में चीटियाँ पड़ी दिखायी देती हैं

shloka_text: गवां सयांसि स्कन्नानि विमदा वीरकुञ्जराः । दीनमश्वाः प्रहेषन्ते नचग्रासाभिनन्दिनः ।।6.10.17।।
translation: गवाम् of cows, पयांसि: udder, स्कन्नानि: dried up, वीरकुञ्जराः proud elephants, विमदामः lost their ichor, अश्वाः horses, दीनम् pa the tic, प्रहेषन्ते: neighing, ग्रासाभिनन्दिनः interested in fodder, नच: even not.
explanation: "The udder of cows is dried up, the proud elephants have lost their ichor, the horses are pathetic and neighing. They are not even interested in fodder."
hindi: ‘गायों का दूध सूख गया है, बड़े-बड़े गजराज मदरहित हो गये हैं, घोड़े नये ग्रास से आनन्दित (भोजन से संतुष्ट) होने पर भी दीनतापूर्ण स्वर में हिनहिनाते हैं

shloka_text: खरोष्ट्राश्वतरा राजभन भिन्नरोमास्स्रवन्ति च । न स्वभावेऽवतिष्ठन्ति विधानैरपि चिन्तिताः ।।6.10.18।।
translation: राजन् O king, खरोष्ट्रातराः donkeys and camels, भिन्नरोमाः shed their body hair, स्रवन्तिच: crying, विधानैः different kinds, चिन्तिताःअपि: even though treated for, स्वभावे: natural form, नअवतिष्ठन्ति: not getting to be normal.
explanation: "O King the donkeys and camels have shed their body hair and are crying. Even though they are treated for it in different ways they are not getting to be in normal natural form."
hindi: ‘राजन् ! गधों, ऊँटों और खच्चरों के रोंगटे खड़े हो जाते हैं। उनके नेत्रों से आँसू गिरने लगते हैं। विधिपूर्वक चिकित्सा की जाने पर भी वे पूर्णतः स्वस्थ हो नहीं पाते हैं

shloka_text: वायसाः सङ्घशः क्रूरा व्याहरन्ति समन्ततः । समवेताश्च दृश्यन्ते विमानाग्रेषु सङ्घशः ।।6.10.19।।
translation: क्रूराः wild, वायसाः crows, सङ्घश: in flocks, समन्ततः all over, व्याहरन्ति: sounding harsh, विमानाग्रेषु: on the top of aerial chariot, सङ्घशः gathered, समवेताः in groups, दृश्यन्ते: are seen.
explanation: Wild crows are seen in flocks all over the top of aerial chariot sounding harsh gathered in groups.
hindi: ‘क्रूर कौए झुंड-के-झुंड एकत्र होकर कर्कश स्वर में काँव-काँव करने लगते हैं तथा वे सतमहले मकानोंपर समूह-के-समूह इकट्ठे हुए देखे जाते हैं

shloka_text: गृध्राश्च परिलीयन्ते पुरीमुपरि पिण्डिताः । उपपन्नाश्च स्नध्ये द्वे व्याहऱ्नत्यशिवं शिवाः ।।6.10.20।।
translation: गृध्राश्च: even eagles, पुरीमुपरि: over the houses of the capital, पिण्डिताः collected, परिलीयन्ते: repeatedly standing, शिवाः auspicious, द्वेसन्ध्ये: in both morning and evening twilight time, उपपन्नाः coming together, अशिवम् inauspicious, व्याहरन्ति: sounding.
explanation: "Even the eagles are collecting together and standing over the houses of the capital repeatedly in both the auspicious times of morning and evening and making inauspicious sounds."
hindi: लङ्कापुरी के ऊपर झुंड-के-झुंड गीध उसका स्पर्श करते हुए-से मड़राते रहते हैं। दोनों संध्याओं के समय सियारिने नगर के समीप आकर अमङ्गलसूचक शब्द करती हैं

shloka_text: क्रव्यादानां मृगाणां च पुरीद्वारेषु सङ्घशः । श्रूयन्ते विपुला घोषास्सविस्फूर्जितनिस्स्वनाः ।।6.10.21।।
translation: पुरिद्वारेषु: at the entrance of capital, सङ्घशः collected, क्रव्यादानाम् carnivorous, मृगाणाम् animals, सविस्फूर्जिन्तिस्स्वनाः like thunderous sounds, विपुलाः loud, घोषाः noise, श्रूयन्ते: heard.
explanation: At the entrance of the capital are heard thunderous sounds of carnivorous animals collected together sounding like thunder.
hindi: ‘नगर के सभी फाटकों पर समूह-के-समूह एकत्र हुए मांसभक्षी पशुओं के जोर-जोर से किये जानेवाले चीत्कार बिजली की गड़गड़ाहट के समान सुनायी पड़ते हैं

shloka_text: तदेवं प्रस्तुते कार्ये प्रायश्चित्तमिदं क्षमम् । रोचतेय दि वैदेही राघवाय प्रदीयताम् ।।6.10.22।।
translation: यदि: such being, तत् that, एवम् in that way, प्रस्तुते: commenced, कार्ये: task (of burning Lanka), इदम् this is, क्षमम् appropriate, प्रायश्चित्तम् atonement, रोचते: I have thought, वैदेही: Vaidehi, राघवाय: to Rama, प्रदीयताम् restore.
explanation: "Therefore, the task (of burning Lanka) has commenced. I have thought of this appropriate atonement. Restore Vaidehi to Rama."
hindi: ‘वीरवर ! ऐसी परिस्थिति में मुझे तो यही प्रायश्चित्त अच्छा जान पड़ता है कि विदेहकुमारी सीता श्रीरामचन्द्रजी को लौटा दी जायँ

shloka_text: इदं च यदि वा मोहाल्लोभाद्वा व्याहृतं मया । तत्रापि च महाराज न दोषं कर्तुमर्हसि ।।6.10.23।।
translation: महाराज: O great king, इदम् this is, मयामोहाद्वा: by my delusion, लोभाद्वा: or greed, व्याहृतंयदि: telling like that, तत्रापि: you ought, दोषम् fault, कर्तुम् finding, नार्हसि: you may know.
explanation: "O great king You may know that I am not telling like this out of my delusion or greed. You ought not to find fault with me."
hindi: ‘महाराज! यदि यह बात मैंने मोह या लोभ से कही हो तो भी आपको मुझमें दोषदृष्टि नहीं करनी चाहिये

shloka_text: अयं हि दोषस्सर्वस्य जनस्यास्योपलक्ष्यते । रक्षसां राक्षसीनां च पुरस्यान्तःपुरस्य च ।।6.10.24।।
translation: आयम् This, दोषः offence, रक्षसाम् for all Rakshasas, राक्षसीनांच: for Rakshasa women also, पुरस्य: of the capital, अन्तःपुरस्यच: even those in the harem, अस्य: there, सर्वस्य: to all, जनस्य: common people, उपलक्ष्यतेहि: are aware of.
explanation: All of us, the Rakshasas and Rakshasa women of the capital, even those in the harem, and all the common people are aware of this offence.
hindi: ‘सीता का अपहरण तथा इससे होने वाला अपशकुनरूपी दोष यहाँ की सारी जनता, राक्षसराक्षसी तथा नगर और अन्तःपुर—सभी के लिये उपलक्षित होता है

shloka_text: श्रावणे चास्य मन्त्रस्य निवृत्तास्सर्वमन्त्रिणः । अवश्यं च मया वाच्यं यद्दृष्टमपिवा श्रुतम् ।।6.10.25।। सम्विधाय यथान्यायं तद्भवान् कर्तुमर्हति ।
translation: अस्य: your, मन्त्रस्य: ministers', श्रावणे: in order to make you hear, सर्वमन्त्रिणः all ministers, निवृत्ताः abstained from, यत् that which, दृष्टम् is seen, अपिवा: and also, श्रुतम् that which is heard, मया: my, अवश्यम् necessarily, वाच्यम् these words, तत् that, भवान् to you, यथान्यायम् that which is justifiable, सम्विधाय: determining the propriety, कर्तुम् I submit, अर्हति: is proper for me.
explanation: All your ministers have abstained from telling you out of fear of you. I must necessarily tell you (as brother) this which is seen and heard. You may determine that which is justifiable by determining the propriety. It is proper for me to submit to you.
hindi: ‘यह बात आपके कानों तक पहुँचाने में प्रायः सभी मन्त्री संकोच करते हैं; परंतु जो बात मैंने देखी या सुनी है वह मुझे तो आपके आगे अवश्य निवेदन कर देनी चाहिये; अतः उसपर यथोचित विचार करके आप जैसा उचित समझें, वैसा करें’

shloka_text: इति स्ममन्त्रिणां मध्ये भ्राता भ्रातरमूचिवान् । रावणं राक्षसां श्रेष्ठं पथ्यमेतद्विभीषणः ।।6.10.26।।
translation: भ्राता: brother, विभीषण: Vibheeshana, स्ममन्त्रिणाम् in the presence of his ministers, भ्रातरम् brother, राक्षसां: among Rakshasas, श्रेष्ठम् eminent, रावणम् to Ravana, इति: thus, पथ्यम् beneficial, एतत् all this, ऊचिवान् tendered advice.
explanation: Brother Vibheeshana thus tendered advice to Ravana, the eminent king of Rakshasas in the presence of his ministers.
hindi: इस प्रकार भाई विभीषण ने अपने मन्त्रियों के बीच में बड़े भाई राक्षसराज रावण से ये हितकारी वचन कहे

shloka_text: हितं महार्थं मृदु हेतुसंहितं व्यतीतकालायतिसम्प्रतिक्षमम् । निशम्य तद्वाक्यमुपस्थितज्वरः प्रसङ्गवानुत्तरमेतदब्रवीत् ।।6.10.27।।
translation: प्रसङ्गवान् words of counsel, हितम् welfare, महार्थम् very meaningful, मृदु: gentle, हेतुसंहितम् that which was full of benefit, व्यतीतकालायतिसम्प्रतिक्षमम् that which is beneficial for the past present and future also, तत् such, वाक्यम् statement, निशम्य: foregoing, उपस्थितज्वरः seized with anger, एतत् this manner, उत्तरम् replied, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Foregoing the beneficial, meaningful, and gentle words of counsel of significance in the past, present and future also (given by Vibheeshana), Ravana seized with anger replied in this manner.
hindi: विभीषण की ये हितकर, महान् अर्थ की साधक, कोमल, युक्तिसंगत तथा भूत, भविष्य और वर्तमानकाल में भी कार्यसाधन में समर्थ बातें सुनकर रावण को बुखार चढ़ आया। श्रीराम के साथ वैर बढ़ाने में उसकी आसक्ति हो गयी थी। इसलिये उसने इस प्रकार उत्तर दिया—’विभीषण! मैं तो कहीं से भी कोई भय नहीं देखता। राम मिथिलेशकुमारी सीता को कभी नहीं पा सकते। इन्द्रसहित देवताओं की सहायता प्राप्त कर लेने पर भी लक्ष्मण के बड़े भाई राम मेरे सामने संग्राम में कैसे टिक सकेंगे?’

shloka_text: भयं न पश्यामि कुतश्चिदप्यहं न राघवः प्राप्स्यति जातु मैथिलीम् । सुरैस्सहेन्द्रैरपि सङ्गरे कथं ममाग्रतस्स्थास्यति लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।।6.10.28।।
translation: अहम् I am, कुतश्चिदपि: of anyone, भयम् fear, नपश्यामि: do not perceive, राघवः Rama, जातु: at any time, मैथिलीम् Mythili, नप्राप्स्यति: will not get, सहेन्द्रेः with Indra, सुरैरपि: with Suras, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, सङ्गरे: in battle, मम: with me, अग्रज: elder brother, कथम् how can, स्थास्यति: withstand.
explanation: "I do not perceive fear from anyone. Rama will not be able to get Mythili at any time. How can the elder brother of Lakshmana withstand me even if Indra and Devatas come (to his help) in battle"
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 10.27 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: इत्येवमुक्त्वा सुरसैन्यनाशनो महाबलस्संयति चण्डविक्रमः । दशाननो भ्रातरमाप्तवादिनं विसर्जयामास तदा विभीषणम् ।।6.10.29।।
translation: सुरसैन्यनाशनः one who is a destroyer of Devatas army, महाबलः mighty, संयति in war, चण्डविक्रमः of formidable valour, दशाननः tenheaded, इत्येवम् in this way, उक्त्वा: having spoken, आप्तवादिनम् one who gave good advice, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, तदा: then, विसर्जयामास: sent him away.
explanation: Then mighty tenheaded Ravana of formidable valour, a destroyer of Devatas' army in war, sent away Vibheeshana who had spoken words of good advice in that manner. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेवामलीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेदशमस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the tenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
hindi: ऐसा कहकर देवसेना के नाशक और समराङ्गण में प्रचण्ड पराक्रम प्रकट करने वाले महाबली दशाननने अपने यथार्थवादी भाई विभीषण को तत्काल विदा कर दिया

shloka_text: स बभूव कृशो राजा मैथिलीकाममोहितः । असन्मानाच्च सुहृदां पापं पापेन कर्मणा ।।6.11.1।।
translation: मैथिलीकाममोहितः infatuated with passion towards Mythili, सः that, पापं: sinner, राजा: king, सुहृदाम् those who were dear to him, असन्मानाच्च: disregarded, पापेन: on account of sinful, कर्मणा: actions, कृशः weak, बभूव: became.
explanation: Infatuated with passion towards Mythili, disregarded by his dear ones on account of sinful actions, sinner Ravana became weak.
comments: Ravana enters the royal assembly followed by Vibheeshana, Prahastha and others and holds consultations with his ministers.
hindi: राक्षसों का राजा रावण मिथिलेशकुमारी सीता के प्रति काम से मोहित हो रहा था, उसके हितैषी सुहृद् विभीषण आदि उसका अनादर करने लगे थे—उसके कुकृत्यों की निन्दा करते थे तथा वह सीताहरणरूपी जघन्य पाप-कर्म के कारण पापी घोषित किया गया था—इन सब कारणों से वह अत्यन्त कृश (चिन्तायुक्त एवं दुर्बल) हो गया था

shloka_text: अतीतसमये काले तस्मिन्वै युधि रावणः । अमात्यैश्च सुहृद्भिश्च प्राप्तकालममन्यत ।।6.11.2।।
translation: रावणः Ravana, तस्मिन् on account of, अतीतसमये: elapsed, काले: time, अमात्यैश्च: with ministers, सुहृद्भिश्च: with his friends, युधि: about war, प्राप्तकालम् right time, अमन्यत: considered for consultation.
explanation: Because of the lapse of time, Ravana considered it imminent to consult with his ministers and friends about war.
hindi: वह अत्यन्त काम से पीड़ित होकर बारंबार विदेहकुमारी का चिन्तन करता था, इसलिये युद्ध का अवसर बीत जाने पर भी उसने उस समय मन्त्रियों और सुहृदों के साथ सलाह करके युद्ध को ही समयोचित कर्तव्य माना

shloka_text: स हेमजालविततं मणिविद्रुमभूषितम् । उपगम्य विनीताश्वमारुरोह महारथम् ।।6.11.3।।
translation: सः he (Ravana), हेमजालविततम् overlaid with golden latticework, मणिविद्रुमभूषितम् decked with gems and corals, विनीताश्वम् trained horses,महारथम् magnificent chariot, उपगम्य: having reached, आरुरोह: ascended.
explanation: Ravana, having reached, ascended the magnificent chariot that was overlaid with golden latticework, decked with gems and corals, and yoked to trained horses.
hindi: वह सोने की जाली से आच्छादित तथा मणि एवं मूंगों से विभूषित एक विशाल रथ पर, जिसमें सुशिक्षित घोड़े जुते हुए थे; जा चढ़ा

shloka_text: तमास्थाय रथश्रेष्ठं महामेघसमस्वनम् । प्रययौ रक्षसां श्रेष्ठो दशग्रीवस्सभां प्रति ।।6.11.4।।
translation: रक्षसाम् of Rakshasas, श्रेष्ठः eminent, दशग्रीवः tenheaded Ravana, महामेघसमस्वनम् making sound like the roaring noise of a huge cloud, तम् him, रथश्रेष्ठम् best chariot, आस्थाय: climbed up, सभांप्रति: to assembly, प्रययौ: went.
explanation: The tenheaded Ravana, eminent one among Rakshasas climbed up that best of chariots that was making noise like the roaring sound of a huge cloud and went to assembly.
hindi: महान् मेघों की गर्जना के समान घर्घराहट पैदा करने वाले उस उत्तम रथ पर आरूढ़ हो राक्षसशिरोमणि दशग्रीव सभाभवन की ओर प्रस्थित हुआ

shloka_text: असिचर्मधरा योधास्सर्वायुधधरास्ततः । राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पुरस्तात्सम्प्रतस्थिरे ।।6.11.5।।
translation: ततः then, असिचर्मधराः wielding swords and all kinds of weapons, योधाः soldiers, सर्वायुधधराः different kinds of weapons, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य: Lord of Rakshasas, पुरस्तात् in front, सम्प्रतस्थिरे: stood at that time.
explanation: Then soldiers wielding swords and different kinds of weapons stood in front of the Lord of Rakshasas.
hindi: उस समय राक्षसराज रावण के आगे-आगे ढाल तलवार एवं सब प्रकार के आयुध धारण करने वाले बहुसंख्यक राक्षस योद्धा जा रहे थे

shloka_text: नानाविकृतवेषाश्च नानाभूषणभूषिताः । पार्श्वतस्पृष्ठतश्चैनं परिवार्य ययुस्तत: ।।6.11.6।।
translation: नानाविकृतवेषाश्च: adorned in different kinds of uncouth attire, नानाभरणभूषिताः wearing different kinds of ornaments, तत: thereafter, एनम् by his, पार्श्वतः sides, पष्ठतश्चैव: and also back, परिवार्य: surrounding, ययुः went.
explanation: Further (Rakshasas) adorned in different kinds of uncouth attire, wearing different kinds of ornaments went by his side and also at the back.
