explanation: "If my wings are cut off and my eyes are injured, on account of that inauspicious act you will take on all sins of my life from the night I was born till the night I am dead leaving my original form, even will happen (Suka tells Rama)."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 20.33 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: नाघातयत्तदा रामश्श्रुत्वा तत्परिदेवनम् । वानरानब्रवीद्रामो मुच्यतां दूत आगतः ।।6.20.36।।
translation: तदा: then, रामः Rama, तत् that, परिदेवनम् lamentation, श्रुत्वा: having heard, नाघातयत् do not kill, दूतः envoy, आगतः come, मुच्यताम् set free, वानरान् to Vanaras, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: "Having heard the lamentation, Rama said to the Vanaras" Do not kill him. Set him free as he had come as an envoy." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twentieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
hindi: उस समय उसका वह विलाप सुनकर श्रीराम ने उसका वध नहीं होने दिया। उन्होंने वानरों से कहा —’छोड़ दो। यह दूत होकर ही आया था’

shloka_text: ततस्सागरवेलायां दर्भानास्तीर्य राघवः । अञ्जलिं प्राङ्मुखः कृत्वा प्रतिशिश्ये महोदधेः ।।6.21.1।। बाहुं भुजगभोगाभमुपधायारिसूदनः ।
translation: ततः then, अरिसूदनः one who is a destroyer of his foes, राघवः Raghava, सागरवेलायाम् on the sea shore, दर्भान् on kusa grass, आस्तीर्य spread, महोदधेः great ocean, अञ्जलिम् obeisance, कृत्वा offering, प्राङ्मुखः face turned towards east, भुजगभोगाम् like serpent coiled and resting, बाहुम् shoulders, उपधाय resting upon, प्रतिशिश्ये lay down.
explanation: Then Raghava the destroyer of foes, offered his obeisance turning his face towards east, spread the kusa grass mat on the seashore and lay down resting his head upon his shoulders like a coiled serpent.
comments: When the ocean did not give way, Rama gets angry and resorts to stirring up the ocean with his arrows.
hindi: तदनन्तर श्रीरघुनाथजी समुद्र के तट पर कुशा बिछा महासागर के समक्ष हाथ जोड़ पूर्वाभिमुख हो वहाँ लेट गये

shloka_text: वरकाञ्चनकेयूरमुक्ताप्रवरभूषणैः ।।6.21.2।।
translation: वरकाञ्चनकेयूरमुक्ताप्रवरभूषणैः armlet adorned with best of gold pearls and coral ornaments, परमनारीणाम् by supreme women, भुजैः shoulders, अनेकाथा many times, अभिमृष्टम् besmeared.
explanation: The shoulders that have been adorned with the best of gold, pearl and coral ornaments, were besmeared many times by supreme women.
hindi: उस समय शत्रुसूदन श्रीराम ने सर्प के शरीर की भाँति कोमल और वनवास के पहले सोने के बने हुए सुन्दर आभूषणों से सदा विभूषित रहने वाली अपनी एक (दाहिनी) बाँह को तकिया बना रखा था अयोध्या में रहते समय मातृकोटि की अनेक उत्तम नारियाँ (धायें) मणि और सुवर्ण के बने हुए केयूरों तथा मोती के श्रेष्ठ आभूषणों से विभूषित अपने करकमलों द्वारा नहलाने-धुलाने आदि के समय अनेक बार श्रीराम के उस बाँह को सहलाती और दबाती थीं

shloka_text: भुजैः परमनारीणामभिमृष्टमनेकदा ।।6.21.3।।
translation: वरकाञ्चनकेयूरमुक्ताप्रवरभूषणैः armlet adorned with best of gold pearls and coral ornaments, परमनारीणाम् by supreme women, भुजैः shoulders, अनेकाथा many times, अभिमृष्टम् besmeared.
explanation: The shoulders that have been adorned with the best of gold, pearl and coral ornaments, were besmeared many times by supreme women.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 21.2 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: चन्दनागुरुभिश्चैव पुरस्तादधिवासितम् । बालसूर्यप्रकाशैश्च न्दनैरुपशोभितम् ।।6.21.4।।
translation: पुरस्तात् earlier, चन्दनागुरुभिश्चैव with sandal paste and Agaru, अधिवासितम् emitting, बालसूर्यप्रकाशैः the brilliance of rising Sun, चन्धनैः sandal, उपशोभितम् very charming.
explanation: The very charming shoulders, smeared with sandal paste and Agaru fragrance emitting the brilliance of the rising Sun.
hindi: पहले चन्दन और अगुरु से उस बाँह की सेवा होती थी। प्रातःकाल के सूर्य की-सी कान्तिवाले लाल चन्दन उसकी शोभा बढ़ाते थे

shloka_text: शयने चोत्तमाङ्गेन सीतायाश्शोभितं पुरा । तक्षकस्येव सम्भोग गङ्गाजलनिषेचितम् ।।6.21.5।।
translation: पुरा earlier, शयने while he slept, सीतायाः Sita's, उत्तमाङ्गेन the best of women, शोभितम् graced, गङ्गाजलनिषेवितम् given bath with waters of Ganga, तक्षकस्य Takshaka's, सम्भोगमिव as if united in delight.
explanation: (The shoulders) which resembled the coils of Takshaka (in chubbiness) a principal serpent, was graced by Sita while in bed, was bathed by the best of women with waters of Ganga.
hindi: सीताहरण से पहले शयनकाल में सीता का सिर उस बाँह की शोभा बढ़ाता था और श्वेत शय्या पर स्थित एवं लाल चन्दन से चर्चित हुई वह बाँह गङ्गाजल में निवास करने वाले तक्षक के* शरीर की भाँति सुशोभित होती थी

shloka_text: संयुगे युगसङ्काशं शत्रूणां शोकवर्धनम् । सुहृदा नन्दनं दीर्घं सागरान्तव्यपाश्रयम् ।।6.21.6।।
translation: दीर्घम् long, युगसङ्काशम् like the union of Yuga, संयुगे in war, शत्रूणाम् to the enemies, शोकवर्थनम् that which brings grief, सुहृदाम् to friends, नन्दनम् delightful, सागरान्तव्यपाश्रयम् like the earth bound by the ocean on all sides.
explanation: The shoulders were long like the union of Yugas, which brought grief to the enemies in war and delight to the friends, and like the earth bound by the ocean on all sides.
hindi: युद्धस्थल में जूए के समान वह विशाल भुजा शत्रुओं का शोक बढ़ाने वाली और सुहृदों को दीर्घ काल तक आनन्दित करने वाली थी। समुद्रपर्यन्त अखण्ड भूमण्डल की रक्षा का भार उनकी उसी भुजा पर प्रतिष्ठित था

shloka_text: असत्या च पुनस्सव्यं ज्याघातविगतत्वचम् । दक्षिणो दक्षिणं बाहुं महापरिघसन्निभम् ।।6.21.7।।
translation: महाबाहुः mighty armed, दक्षिणः to left, रामः Rama, अस्यता released, ज्याघातविगतत्वचम् hardened by the large number of arrows released, सव्यम् by it, बाहुम् by the arm, महापरिघसन्निभम् like the iron bar, गोसहस्रप्रदातारम् thousands of cows given as gift, महत् large, दक्षिणम् to the left, भुजम् arm, उपधाय by strokes, अद्य now, मे my, सागरस्य of the ocean, तरणंवा or the crossing over, मरणंवा or death, इति thus, धृतिम् determined, कृत्वा having resolved, अत्र and then, विधिवत् accordingly, प्रयतो self restrained, मुनिः sage, नियतः one who is subdued, महादधिम् great ocean, अधिशिश्ये lay down.
explanation: The mighty armed Rama's arms were hardened like that of iron bars by the large number of arrows received by the left arm and strained by giving thousands of cows as gifts by the right arm. Rama was determined now to cross over the great ocean or meet the sea with death and lay down subdued and restrained like a sage.
hindi: बायीं ओर को बारंबार बाण चलाने के कारण प्रत्यञ्चा के आघात से जिसकी त्वचा पर रगड़ पड़ गयी थी, जो विशाल परिघ के समान सुदृढ़ एवं बलिष्ठ थी तथा जिसके द्वारा उन्होंने सहस्रों गौओं का दान किया था, उस विशाल दाहिनी भुजा का तकिया लगाकर उदारता आदि गुणों से युक्त महाबाहु श्रीराम ‘आज या तो मैं समुद्र के पार जाऊँगा या मेरे द्वारा समुद्र का संहार होगा’ ऐसा निश्चय करके मौन हो मन, वाणी और शरीर को संयम में रखकर महासागर को अनुकूल करने के उद्देश्य से विधिपूर्वक धरना देते हुए उस कुशासन पर सो गये

shloka_text: गोसहस्रप्रदारं मुपधाय महत्भुज म् । अद्य मे मरणं वा दतरणं सागरस्य वा ।।6.21.8।।
translation: महाबाहुः mighty armed, दक्षिणः to left, रामः Rama, अस्यता released, ज्याघातविगतत्वचम् hardened by the large number of arrows released, सव्यम् by it, बाहुम् by the arm, महापरिघसन्निभम् like the iron bar, गोसहस्रप्रदातारम् thousands of cows given as gift, महत् large, दक्षिणम् to the left, भुजम् arm, उपधाय by strokes, अद्य now, मे my, सागरस्य of the ocean, तरणंवा or the crossing over, मरणंवा or death, इति thus, धृतिम् determined, कृत्वा having resolved, अत्र and then, विधिवत् accordingly, प्रयतो self restrained, मुनिः sage, नियतः one who is subdued, महादधिम् great ocean, अधिशिश्ये lay down.
explanation: The mighty armed Rama's arms were hardened like that of iron bars by the large number of arrows received by the left arm and strained by giving thousands of cows as gifts by the right arm. Rama was determined now to cross over the great ocean or meet the sea with death and lay down subdued and restrained like a sage.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 21.7 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: ति रामो मतिं कृत्वा महाबाहुर्महोदधिम् । अधिशिश्ये च विधिवत्प्रयतो नियतो मुनिः ।।6.21.9।।
translation: महाबाहुः mighty armed, दक्षिणः to left, रामः Rama, अस्यता released, ज्याघातविगतत्वचम् hardened by the large number of arrows released, सव्यम् by it, बाहुम् by the arm, महापरिघसन्निभम् like the iron bar, गोसहस्रप्रदातारम् thousands of cows given as gift, महत् large, दक्षिणम् to the left, भुजम् arm, उपधाय by strokes, अद्य now, मे my, सागरस्य of the ocean, तरणंवा or the crossing over, मरणंवा or death, इति thus, धृतिम् determined, कृत्वा having resolved, अत्र and then, विधिवत् accordingly, प्रयतो self restrained, मुनिः sage, नियतः one who is subdued, महादधिम् great ocean, अधिशिश्ये lay down.
explanation: The mighty armed Rama's arms were hardened like that of iron bars by the large number of arrows received by the left arm and strained by giving thousands of cows as gifts by the right arm. Rama was determined now to cross over the great ocean or meet the sea with death and lay down subdued and restrained like a sage.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 21.7 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: तस्य रामस्य सुप्तस्य कुशास्तीर्णे महीतले । नियमादप्रमत्तस्य निशास्तिस्रोऽतिचक्रमुः ।।6.21.10।।
translation: नियमात् with vow, अप्रमत्तस्य kept himself alert, तस्य his, रामस्य Rama's, कुशास्तीर्णे on the kusa grass mat, महीतले on the ground, सुप्तस्य lying down, तिस्रः three, निशाः nights, अतिचक्रमुः rolled fast.
explanation: As Rama kept himself alert with a vow and lay on the kusa grass m at spread on the ground, three nights rolled fast.
hindi: कुश बिछी हुई भूमि पर सोकर नियम से असावधान न होते हुए श्रीराम की वहाँ तीन रातें व्यतीत हो गयीं

shloka_text: स त्रिरात्रोषितस्तत्र नयज्ञो धर्मवत्सलः । उपासत तदा रामस्सागरं सरितां पतिम् ।।6.21.11।।
translation: तदा then, तत्र there, नयज्ञः one having political foresight, धर्मवत्सलः lover of dharma, रामः Rama, त्रीरात्रोषितः spent three nights, सरितांपतिम् Lord of rivers, सागरम् the ocean, उपासत waiting upon.
explanation: Rama, a lover of dharma, who had political foresight, spent three nights waiting upon the ocean, the Lord of rivers.
hindi: इस प्रकार उस समय वहाँ तीन रात लेटे रहकर नीति के ज्ञाता, धर्मवत्सल श्रीरामचन्द्रजी सरिताओं के स्वामी समुद्र की उपासना करते रहे; परंतु नियमपूर्वक रहते हुए श्रीराम के द्वारा यथोचित पूजा और सत्कार पाकर भी उस मन्दमति महासागर ने उन्हें अपने आधिदैविक रूप का दर्शन नहीं कराया—वह उनके समक्ष प्रकट नहीं हुआ

shloka_text: न च दर्शयते रूपं मन्दो रामस्य सागरः । प्रयतेनापि रामेण यथार्हमभिपूजितः ।।6.21.12।।
translation: प्रयतेन though selfrestrained, रामेण by Rama, यथार्हम् according to propriety, अभिपूजितः well respected, अपि also, मन्दः dull, सागरः the ocean, रामस्य to Rama, रूपम् real form, नचदर्शयते did not show.
explanation: Though Rama remained selfrestrained and respected the ocean well according to propriety, the ocean was dull and did not show its real form.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 21.11 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: समुद्रस्य ततः क्रुद्धो रामो रक्तान्तलोचनः । समीपस्थमुवाचेदं लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.21.13।।
translation: ततः then, समुद्रस्य at the ocean, क्रुद्ध: enraged, रक्तान्तलोचनः eyes turned red, रामः Rama, समीपस्थम् went near, शुभलक्षणम् possessed of auspicious marks, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इदम् thus, उवाच addressed.
explanation: Enraged at the ocean, Rama's eyes turned red. He went near Lakshmana who was endowed with auspicious marks and thus addressed.
hindi: तब अरुणनेत्र प्रान्तवाले भगवान् श्रीराम समुद्रपर कुपित हो उठे और पास ही खड़े हुए शुभलक्षणयुक्त लक्ष्मण से इस प्रकार बोले-

shloka_text: अवलेपस्समुद्रस्य न दर्शयति यत्स्वयम् । प्रशमश्च क्षमा चैव आर्जवं प्रियवादिता ।।6.21.14।। असामर्थ्यंफल्ना त्येते निर्गुणेषु सतां गुणाः ।
translation: यः who is it, स्वयम् by himself, नदर्शयति does not show up, समुद्रस्य ocean's, अवलेपः pride, प्रशमश्चैव calmness also, क्षमाचैव with forbearance, आर्जवम् straight forwardness, प्रियवादिता politeness of speech, एते all these, सताम् virtues, गुणाः qualities, निर्गुणेषु without attributes, असामर्थ्यफलाःहि construed indeed as incapability.
explanation: "Why is it that the ocean does not show up to me? Indeed, calmness, forbearance, straightforwardness, politeness of speech are all attributes of virtuous qualities and one without these attributes are considered incapable."
hindi: ‘समुद्र को अपने ऊपर बड़ा अहङ्कार है, जिससे वह स्वयं मेरे सामने प्रकट नहीं हो रहा है। शान्ति, क्षमा, सरलता और मधुर भाषण—ये जो सत्पुरुषों के गुण हैं, इनका गुणहीनों के प्रति प्रयोग करने पर यही परिणाम होता है कि वे उस गुणवान् पुरुष को भी असमर्थ समझ लेते हैं

shloka_text: आत्मप्रशंसिनं दृष्टं धृष्टं विपरिथावकम् । सर्वत्रोत्सृष्टदण्डं च लोकस्सत्कुरुते नरम् ।।6.21.15।।
translation: लोकः the world, आत्मप्रशंसिनम् praising one's own self, दुष्टम् wicked ones, धृष्टम् impudent, विपरिथावकम् an unchaste one, सर्वत्र all over, उत्सृष्टदण्डंचनरम् one who goes about with a rod of punishment, सत्कुरुते treat with respect.
explanation: "Indeed, the world treats one with respect, who praises himself, as an impudent one, an unchaste one and one who goes about with a rod of punishment (not the one who is virtuous)."
hindi: ‘जो अपनी प्रशंसा करने वाला, दुष्ट, धृष्ट, सर्वत्र धावा करने वाला और अच्छे-बुरे सभी लोगों पर कठोर दण्ड का प्रयोग करने वाला होता है, उस मनुष्य का सब लोग सत्कार करते हैं

shloka_text: न साम्ना शक्यते कीर्तिर्न साम्ना शक्यते यशः । प्राप्तुं लक्ष्मण लोकेऽस्मिन् ञ्जयो वा रणमूर्धनि ।।6.21.16।।
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अस्मिन् in this, लोके world, साम्ना in front, कीर्तिः popularity, प्राप्तुम् is attained, नशक्यते not possible, यशः fame, न not, रणमूर्धनि in battlefront, जयोवा victorious, न not.
explanation: "O Lakshmana Neither fame nor popularity can win a battle front in this world."
hindi: ‘लक्ष्मण ! सामनीति (शान्ति)-के द्वारा इस लोक में न तो कीर्ति प्राप्त की जा सकती है, न यश का प्रसार हो सकता है और न संग्राम में विजय ही पायी जा सकती है

shloka_text: अद्य मद्बाणनिर्भग्नैर्मकरैर्मकरानिलयम् । निरुद्धतोयं सौमित्रे प्लवभदिः पश्य सर्वतः ।।6.21.17।।
translation: सौमित्रे Saumithri, अद्य now, महद्बाणनिर्भग्नैः shattered by my ruthless arrows, प्लवबदिः jumping and floating, मकरैः crocodiles, सर्वतः all over, निरुद्दतोयम् water splashed all sides, मकरालयम् abode of crocodiles, पश्य witness.
explanation: "Saumithri Witness the crocodiles shattered by my ruthless arrows jumping and floating in the ocean with water splashed on all sides."
hindi: ‘सुमित्रानन्दन! आज मेरे बाणों से खण्ड-खण्ड हो मगर और मत्स्य सब ओर उतराकर बहने लगेंगे और उनकी लाशों से इस मकरालय (समुद्र)-का जल आच्छादित हो जायगा। तुम यह दृश्य आज अपनी आँखों देख लो

shloka_text: महाभोगानि मत्स्यानां करिणां च कराह । भोगिनां पश्य नागानां मया छिन्नानि लक्ष्मण ।।6.21.18।।
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, मया by me, छिन्नानि cut into pieces, भोगिनाम् serpents, नागानां serpents coiled, मत्स्यानाम् fishes, महाभोगानि huge snakes, करिणाम् sea elephants, काराह large, इह now here, पश्य see.
explanation: "Lakshmana See here the coils of serpents, huge snakes, fish and large sea elephants cut into pieces by me."
hindi: ‘लक्ष्मण! तुम देखो कि मैं यहाँ जल में रहने वाले सोके शरीर, मत्स्यों के विशाल कलेवर और जलहस्तियों के शुण्ड-दण्ड के किस तरह टुकड़े-टुकड़े कर डालता हूँ

shloka_text: सशङ्खशुक्तिजालं समीनमकरं तथा । अद्य युद्धेन महता समुद्रं परिशोषये ।।6.21.19।।
translation: सशङ्खशुक्तिकाजालम् water with its shells, conchs, तथा so also, समीनमकरम् with fishes and crocodiles, समुद्रम् ocean, अद्य now, महता, great युद्धेन combat, परिशोषये will make it dry.
explanation: "I shall make the ocean dry up with its shells and conchs, fishes and crocodiles in this great combat."
hindi: ‘आज महान् युद्ध ठानकर शङ्खों और सीपियों के समुदाय तथा मत्स्यों और मगरोंसहित समुद्र को मैं अभी सुखाये देता हूँ

shloka_text: क्षमया हि समायुक्तं मामयं मकरालयः । असमर्थं विजानाति धिक्क्षमामीदृशे जने ।।6.21.20।।
translation: क्षमया tolerance, समायुक्तम् remaining, माम् me, आयम् this, मकरालयः abode of fish, असमर्थम् incapable, विजानाति do not know, ईदृशे endowed with such qualities, जने people, क्षमाम् forbearance, धिक् show.
explanation: "By my being tolerant, this ocean treats me to be incapable. Endowed with such qualities of forbearance, I will show the people (ocean)."
hindi: ‘मगरों का निवासभूत यह समुद्र मुझे क्षमा से युक्त देख असमर्थ समझने लगा है। ऐसे मूों के प्रति की गयी क्षमा को धिक्कार है

shloka_text: न दर्शयति साम्ना मे सागरो रूपमात्मनः ।।6.21.21।।
translation: सागरः ocean's, साम्ना to me, मे I, आत्मानम् its own form, नदर्शयिती not shown, सौमित्रे O Saumithri, चापम् bow, आशीविषोषमान् resembling venomous snake, शरांश्च arrows, आनय get, समुद्रम् ocean, शोषयिष्यामि will make it dry, प्लवङ्गमाः all the Vanaras, पद् ब्याम् by foot, यान्तु go.
explanation: "The ocean has not shown his own form to me. O Lakshmana Get the bow and venomous snake like arrows, I will dry up the ocean and the Vanaras can walk by foot and go."
hindi: ‘सुमित्रानन्दन! सामनीति का आश्रय लेने से यह समुद्र मेरे सामने अपना रूप नहीं प्रकट कर रहा है, इसलिये धनुष तथा विषधर सो के समान भयंकर बाण ले आओ। मैं समुद्र को सुखा डालूँगा; फिर वानर लोग पैदल ही लङ्कापुरी को चलें

shloka_text: चापमानय सौमित्रे शरांश्चाशीविषोपमान् । सागरं शोषयिष्यामि पद् भ्यां यान्तु प्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.21.22।।
translation: सागरः ocean's, साम्ना to me, मे I, आत्मानम् its own form, नदर्शयिती not shown, सौमित्रे O Saumithri, चापम् bow, आशीविषोषमान् resembling venomous snake, शरांश्च arrows, आनय get, समुद्रम् ocean, शोषयिष्यामि will make it dry, प्लवङ्गमाः all the Vanaras, पद् ब्याम् by foot, यान्तु go.
explanation: "The ocean has not shown his own form to me. O Lakshmana Get the bow and venomous snake like arrows, I will dry up the ocean and the Vanaras can walk by foot and go."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 21.21 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: अद्याक्षोभ्यमपि क्रुद्धः क्षोभयिष्यामि सागरम् । वेलासु कृतमर्यादं सहस्रोर्मिसमाकुलम् ।।6.21.23।।
translation: क्रुद्ध: made to be angry, अद्य now, अक्षोभ्यमपि even though imperturbable, सागरम् ocean, क्षोभयिष्यामि will torment, वेलासु thousands, कृतमर्यादम् one who has limits, सहस्रोर्मिसमाकुलम् with thousands of waves, वरुणालयम् the ocean an abode of Lord Varuna, निर्मर्यादम् cross its boundary, सायकैः with arrows, करिष्यामि will make it, महादानवसङ्कुलम् mighty demons, महार्णवम् great ocean, क्षोभयिष्ये will torment.
explanation: "(The ocean) Having made me angry, now I will torment the ocean even though it is imperturbable and has its limits. I will torment the ocean with its thousands of waves and mighty demons by my arrows and make the ocean cross its boundary."
hindi: ‘यद्यपि समुद्र को अक्षोभ्य कहा गया है; फिर भी आज कुपित होकर मैं इसे विक्षुब्ध कर दूंगा। इसमें सहस्रों तरङ् उठती रहती हैं। फिर भी यह सदा अपने तट की मर्यादा (सीमा) में ही रहता है। किंतु अपने बाणों से मारकर मैं इसकी मर्यादा नष्ट कर दूंगा। बड़े बड़े दानवों से भरे हुए इस महासागर में हलचल मचा दूंगा-तूफान ला दूंगा’

shloka_text: निर्मर्यादं करिष्यामि सायायिकैर्वरुणालयम् । महार्णवं क्षोभयिष्ये महादानवसङ्कुलम् ।।6.21.24।।
translation: क्रुद्ध: made to be angry, अद्य now, अक्षोभ्यमपि even though imperturbable, सागरम् ocean, क्षोभयिष्यामि will torment, वेलासु thousands, कृतमर्यादम् one who has limits, सहस्रोर्मिसमाकुलम् with thousands of waves, वरुणालयम् the ocean an abode of Lord Varuna, निर्मर्यादम् cross its boundary, सायकैः with arrows, करिष्यामि will make it, महादानवसङ्कुलम् mighty demons, महार्णवम् great ocean, क्षोभयिष्ये will torment.
explanation: "(The ocean) Having made me angry, now I will torment the ocean even though it is imperturbable and has its limits. I will torment the ocean with its thousands of waves and mighty demons by my arrows and make the ocean cross its boundary."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 21.23 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा धनुष्पाणिः क्रोधविस्फारितेक्षणः । बभूव रामो दुर्धर्षो युगान्तानगिरिव ज्वलन् ।।6.21.25।।
translation: एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, धनुष्पाणिः bows etc., क्रोधविस्फारितेक्षणः with flaming red eyes, रामः Rama, ज्वलन् burning, युगान्तानगिरिव like the flame at the end of the universe, दुर्धर्षः unassailable, बभूव seemed.
explanation: Having spoken like that, Rama with his flaming red eyes seemed like the flame at the end of the universe and unassailable.
hindi: यों कहकर दुर्धर्ष वीर भगवान् श्रीराम ने हाथ में धनुष ले लिया। वे क्रोध से आँखें फाड़-फाड़कर देखने लगे और प्रलयाग्नि के समान प्रज्वलित हो उठे

shloka_text: सम्पीड्य च धनुर्घोरं कम्पयित्वा शरैर्जगत् । मुमोच विशिखानुग्रान्वज्रानिव शतक्रतुः ।।6.21.26।।
translation: घोरम् terrific, धनुः bow, सम्पीड्यच bending, शरैः arrow, जगत् universe, कम्पयित्वा making to tremble, शतक्रतुः one who has performed a hundred sacrifices, वज्रानिव like Indra, उग्रान् frightful, विशिखान् arrows, मुमोच released.
explanation: Bending the terrific bow, he released frightful arrows like Indra (who released thunderbolts) who performed a hundred sacrifices.
hindi: उन्होंने अपने भयंकर धनुष को धीरे से दबाकर उसपर प्रत्यञ्चा चढ़ा दी और उसकी टङ्कार से सारे जगत् को कम्पित करते हुए बड़े भयंकर बाण छोड़े, मानो इन्द्रने बहुत-से वज्रों का प्रहार किया हो

shloka_text: ते ज्वलन्तो महावेगास्तेजसा सायकोत्तमाः । प्रविशन्ति समुद्रस्य सलिलं त्रस्तपन्नगम् ।।6.21.27।।
translation: तेजसा glowing in brilliance, ज्वलन्तः flaming, वेगाः speedily, ते that, सायकोत्तमाः best among the arrows, त्रस्तपन्नगम् like the snakes, समुद्रस्य into the ocean, सलिलम् waters, प्रविशन्ति pierced.
explanation: Glowing in brilliance like flame, the arrows of the best among the arrows pierced like snakes into the water of the ocean.
hindi: तेज से प्रज्वलित होते हुए वे महान् वेगशाली श्रेष्ठ बाण समुद्र के जल में घुस गये। वहाँ रहने वाले सर्प भय से थर्रा उठे

shloka_text: तोयवेगस्समुद्रस्य सनक्रमकरो महान् । स म्बभूव महाघोरस्समारुतरवस्तदा ।।6.21.28।।
translation: समुद्रस्य ocean's, समीनमकरः with fishes and crocodiles, तदा similarly, समारुतरवः with wind, महान् powerful, सः that, तोयवेगः rush of water, महाघोरः terrible, बभूव seemed.
explanation: Then the ocean seemed terrible with the fish and crocodiles rushing out with the speed of water and powerful wind.
hindi: ‘मत्स्यों और मगरोंसहित महासागर के जल का महान् वेग सहसा अत्यन्त भयंकर हो गया। वहाँ तूफान का कोलाहल छा गया

shloka_text: महोर्मिकुलाविततश्शङ्खजालसमावृतः । सधूमः परिवृत्तोर्मिस्सहसासीन्महोदधिः ।।6.21.29।।
translation: सहसा all of a sudden, महोदधिः great ocean, महोर्मिजालचलितः with the movement of the water, शङ्खजालसमावृतः filled with conchs and shells, सधूमः terrific smoke, परिवृत्तोर्मिः whirling round and rising up, आसीत् played around.
explanation: With the movement of the sea water filled with the conchs and shells suddenly terrific smoke whirling round and rising played around.
hindi: बड़ी-बड़ी तरङ्ग-मालाओं से सारा समुद्र व्याप्त हो उठा। शङ्ख और सीपियाँ पानी के ऊपर छा गयीं। वहाँ धुआँ उठने लगा और सारे महासागर में सहसा बड़ी बड़ी लहरें चक्कर काटने लगीं

shloka_text: व्यथिताः पन्नगाश्चासदनीप्तास्या दीप्तलोचनाः । दानवाश्च महावीर्याः पाताळतलवासिनः ।।6.21.30।।
translation: दीप्तास्याः those blazing, दीप्तलोचनाः ones with glowing eyes, पन्नगाः snakes, पाताळतलवासिनः those who reside in underworld, महावीर्याः highly valiant ones, दानवाश्च and the demons, व्यथित्याः oppressed, आसन् became.
explanation: Those snakes with blazing hoods and glowing eyes residing in the underworld and the demons became oppressed.
hindi: चमकीले फन और दीप्तिशाली नेत्रोंवाले सर्प व्यथित हो उठे तथा पाताल में रहने वाले महापराक्रमी दानव भी व्याकुल हो गये

shloka_text: ऊर्मयस्सिन्धुराजस्य सनक्रमकरास्तथा । विन्द्यमन्दरसङ्काशास्समुत्पेतुस्सहस्रशः ।।6.21.31।।
translation: तथा so also, सिन्दुराजस्य king of rivers, सनक्रमकराः which were like, विन्द्यमन्दरसङ्काशाः Vindhya and Mandara mountain peaks, ऊर्मयः waves, सहस्रशः in thousands, समुत्पेतुः rose up.
explanation: Thousands of waves of the ocean rose like the peaks of Vindhya and Mandara mountains.
hindi: सिन्धुराज की सहस्रों लहरें जो विन्ध्याचल और मन्दराचल के समान विशाल एवं विस्तृत थीं, नाकों और मकरों को साथ लिये ऊपर को उठने लगीं

shloka_text: आघूर्णिततरङ्गौघस्सम्भ्रान्तोरगराक्षसः । उद्वर्तितमहाग्राहस्संवृत्तस्सलिलाशयः ।।6.21.32।।
translation: आघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः the waves tossing and whirling about, सम्भ्रान्तोरगराक्षसः the agitated Nagas and Rakshasas, उद्वर्तितमहाग्राहः thrown up highly disturbed, सलिलाशयः from the waters, सघोषः made great sound.
explanation: The waves rose up tossing and whirling about. The agitated Nagas and Rakshasas were thrown up by a highly disturbed ocean that produced a great sound.
hindi: सागर की उत्ताल तरङ्ग-मालाएँ झूमने और चक्कर काटने लगीं। वहाँ निवास करने वाले नाग और राक्षस घबरा गये। बड़े-बड़े ग्राह ऊपर को उछलने लगे तथा वरुण के निवासभूत उस समुद्र में सब ओर भारी कोलाहल मच गया

shloka_text: ततस्तु तं राघवमुग्रवेगं प्रकर्षमाणं धनुरप्रमेयम् । सौमित्रिरुत्पत्य समुच्छवसन्तं मामेति चोक्त्वा दनुराललम्बे ।।6.21.33।।
translation: ततः then, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, उत्पत्य got up, उग्रवेगम् at high speed, अप्रमेयम् immeasurably great, धनुः bow, प्रकर्षमाणम् was stretching exceedingly, विनिश्श्वनन्तम् breathing hard in anger, राघवम् at Rama, मामाइति that is enough that is enough, उक्त्वा saying, धनुः bow, आललम्बे seized.
explanation: Then Saumithri got up and rushed very fast to Rama who was stretching his bow exceedingly and breathing hard in anger and said, 'no more, no more' and seized the bow. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty first sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
hindi: तदनन्तर श्रीरघुनाथजी रोष से लंबी साँस लेते हुए अपने भयंकर वेगशाली अनुपम धनुष को पुनः खींचने लगे। यह देख सुमित्राकुमार लक्ष्मण उछलकर उनके पास जा पहुँचे और ‘बस, बस, अब नहीं, अब नहीं’ ऐसा कहते हुए उन्होंने उनका धनुष पकड़ लिया

shloka_text: एतद्विनापि ह्युदधेस्तवाद्य सम्पत्स्यते वीरतमस्य कार्यम् । भवद्विधाः क्रोधवशं न यान्ति दीर्घ भवान् पश्यतु साधुवृत्तम् ।।6.21.34।।
translation: वीरतमस्य of you the most heroic, तव your, कार्यम् purpose, उदधेः of the ocean, विना अपि even without it, अद्य today, सम्पत्स्यते shall be accomplished, भवद्विधाः those like you, क्रोधवशम् into the power of wrath, न यान्ति go not, भवान् your honour, दीर्घम् far ahead, साधुवृत्तम् the conduct of the good, पश्यतु let him look to
explanation: "Your purpose, most heroic one, shall be accomplished today even without the ocean. Those like you do not go into the power of wrath; let your honour look far ahead to the conduct of the good."
hindi: (फिर वे बोले-) भैया! आप वीर-शिरोमणि हैं। इस समुद्र को नष्ट किये बिना भी आपका कार्य सम्पन्न हो जायगा। आप-जैसे महापुरुष क्रोध के अधीन नहीं होते हैं। अब आप सुदीर्घकाल तक उपयोग में लाये जाने वाले किसी अच्छे उपायपर दृष्टि डालें—कोई दूसरी उत्तम युक्ति सोचें’

shloka_text: अन्तर्हितैश्चापि तथान्तरिक्षे ब्रह्मर्षिभिश्चैव सुरर्षिभिश्च । शब्दः कृतः कष्टमिति ब्रुवद्भिर्मामेति चोक्त्वा महता स्वरेण ।।6.21.35।।
translation: अन्तर्हितैः by the unseen, ब्रह्मर्षिभिश्चैव and by brahmin sages, सुरर्षिभिश्च and by divine sages, तथा likewise, अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, कष्टम् alas, इति thus, ब्रुवद्भिः as they cried, महता with a great, स्वरेण voice, मा alas, इति च and thus, उक्त्वा having said, शब्दः a cry, कृतः was raised
explanation: By unseen brahmin sages and divine sages in the sky a cry was raised, as they cried "Alas!" and "Do not!" with a great voice.
hindi: इसी समय अन्तरिक्ष में अव्यक्तरूप से स्थित महर्षियों और देवर्षियों ने भी ‘हाय! यह तो बड़े कष्टकी बात है’ ऐसा कहते हुए ‘अब नहीं, अब नहीं’ कहकर बड़े जोर से कोलाहल किया

shloka_text: अथोवाच रघुश्रेष्टस्सागरं दारुणं वचः । अद्य त्वां शोषयिष्यामि सपाताळं महार्णव: ।।6.22.1।।
translation: अथ and thereafter, रघुश्रेष्ट the best one among Raghu's, सागरम् to ocean, दारुणम् terrific, वचः words, उवाच uttered, महार्णव ocean, अद्य now, सपाताळम् that under world, त्वाम् you, शोषयिष्यामि will make it dry.
explanation: Thereafter, Rama uttered, "I shall make you dry up to the underworld", to the ocean that made his terrific presence.
comments: The Sun god appears before Rama and sustains the construction of the bridge by Nila. Rama crosses the ocean accompanied by Lakshmana and the army.
hindi: तब रघुकुलतिलक श्रीराम ने समुद्र से कठोर शब्दों में  कहा—’महासागर! आज मैं पातालसहित तुझे सुखा डालूँगा’

shloka_text: शरनिर्दग्धतोयस्य परिशुष्कस्य सागर : । मया शोषितसत्त्वस्य पांसुरुत्पद्यते महान् ।।6.22.2।।
translation: सागर O ocean, मया by me, शरनिर्दग्दतोयस्य water dried up by the arrows, परिशुष्कस्य when it is dried up, शोषितसत्त्वस्य dried up to the core, महान् huge, सांसुः sand, उत्पद्यते will appear.
explanation: "O Ocean When your water is dried up to the core by my arrows, huge sand will appear."
hindi: ‘सागर! मेरे बाणों से तुम्हारी सारी जलराशि दग्ध हो जायगी, तू सूख जायगा और तेरे भीतर रहने वाले सब जीव नष्ट हो जायँगे। उस दशा में तेरे यहाँ जल के स्थान में विशाल बालुकाराशि पैदा हो जायगी

shloka_text: मत्कार्मुकविसृष्टेव शरवर्षेण सागर । पारं तेऽद्य गमिष्यन्ति पदभिरेव प्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.22.3।।
translation: सागर O Ocean, मत्कार्मुकविसृष्टेन all the creatures inhabiting you, शरवर्षेण by the rain of arrows, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, पदभिरेव to the other side of the shore, परंअद्य now to the other, गमिष्यन्ति will go.
explanation: "O Ocean, now the monkeys will go to the other side of the shore on your drying up with all the creatures inhabiting you by the rain of arrows showered by me."
hindi: ‘समुद्र! मेरे धनुष द्वारा की गयी बाण-वर्षा से जब तेरी ऐसी दशा हो जायगी, तब वानर लोग पैदल ही चलकर तेरे उस पार पहुँच जायेंगे

shloka_text: विचिन्वन्नाभिजानासि पौरुषं नापि विक्रमम् । दानवालय सन्तापं मत्तो नाधि गमिष्यसि ।।6.22.4।।
translation: दानवालय abode of demons, विचिन्वन् abode, पौरुषम् valour, नाभिजानासि, not known, विक्रममपि even prowess, न not, मत्तः mine, सन्तापम् sorrow, गमिष्यसिनाम will face from me.
explanation: "You, who are the abode of demons are not aware of my valour and prowess. You are not aware of the sorrow that you will face from me."
hindi: ‘दानवों के निवासस्थान! तू केवल चारों ओर से बहकर आयी हुई जलराशि का संग्रह करता है। तुझे मेरे बल और पराक्रम का पता नहीं हैं। किंतु याद रख, (इस उपेक्षा के कारण) तुझे मुझसे भारी संताप प्राप्त होगा’

shloka_text: ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेण संयोज्य ब्रह्मदण्डनिभम् शरम् । संयोज्य धनुषि श्रेष्ठ विचकर्ष महाबलः ।।6.22.5।।
translation: महाबलः strong, ब्रह्मदण्डनिभम् resembling the rod of punishment of the creator Brahma, शरम् arrow, ब्राह्मेणअस्त्रेण energized by Brahma, संयोज्य stretched, श्रेष्ठे best one, धनुषि by the bow, संयोज्य stretched, विचकर्ष released.
explanation: Rama proceeded to stretch the mighty bow that resembled the rod of punishment of Brahma energized by Brahma and released that best of bows.
hindi: यों कहकर महाबली श्रीराम ने एक ब्रह्मदण्ड के समान भयंकर बाण को ब्रह्मास्त्र से अभिमन्त्रित करके अपने श्रेष्ठ धनुष पर चढ़ाकर खींचा

shloka_text: तस्मिन्विविकृष्टे सहसा राघवेण शरासने । रोदसी सम्पफालेव पर्वताश्च चकम्पिरे ।।6.22.6।।
translation: तस्मिन् by that, शरासने arrows from the bow, राघवेण by Rama, विकृष्टे pulled out, सहसा at once, रोदसी from the sky, सम्पफालेन to the earth, पर्वताश्च even mountains, चकम्पिरे trembled.
explanation: When Rama released the arrows from the bow, at once the sky to the earth including mountains trembled.
hindi: श्रीरघुनाथजी के द्वारा सहसा उस धनुष के खींचे जाते ही पृथ्वी और आकाश मानो फटने लगे और पर्वत डगमगा उठे

shloka_text: तमश्च लोकमाव्रते दिशश्च व चकाशिरे । प्रतिचुक्षुभिरे चाशु सरांसि सरितस्तथा ।।6.22.7।।
translation: तदा then, तमश्च by darkness, लोकम् world, अव्रते engulfed, दिशश्च even the directions, नचकाशिरे not noticeable, चाशसरांसिसरितः Furthermore rivers, प्रतिचुक्षुभिरे got agitated.
explanation: Then darkness engulfed the world, the directions were not noticeable and further the rivers were agitated.
hindi: सारे संसार में अन्धकार छा गया। किसी को दिशाओं का ज्ञान न रहा। सरिताओं और सरोवरों में तत्काल हलचल पैदा हो गयी

shloka_text: तिर्यक्च सहानेक्षत्रै स्सङ्गतौ चन्द्रभास्करौ । भास्करांशुभिरादीप्तं तमसा च समावृतम् ।।6.22.8।।
translation: चन्द्रभास्करौ the Sun and moon, नक्षत्रेःसह with stars, तिर्यक् obliquely, सङ्गतौ moved, भास्करांशुभिः even the Sun light, आदीप्तम् not shining, तमसाच on account of darkness, समावृतम् engulfed all over, तत् then, आकाशम् sky, उल्काशत by the meteors, विदीपितम् again lighted, प्रचकाशे shone, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, अतुलस्वनाः unparalleled, निर्घाताः thunder, निर्जग्मुः shot forth.
explanation: The Sun and moon moved obliquely (from south to North) along with the stars. On account of the darkness that covered even the sun was not shining. The sky lighted by the meteors shone and unparalleled thunder shot forth.
hindi: चन्द्रमा और सूर्य नक्षत्रों के साथ तिर्यक्-गति से चलने लगे। सूर्य की किरणों से प्रकाशित होने पर भी आकाश में अन्धकार छा गया

shloka_text: चकाशे तदाकाशमुल्काशतविदीपितम् । अन्तरिक्षाच्च निर्घाता निर्जग्मुरतुलस्वनाः ।।6.22.9।।
translation: चन्द्रभास्करौ the Sun and moon, नक्षत्रेःसह with stars, तिर्यक् obliquely, सङ्गतौ moved, भास्करांशुभिः even the Sun light, आदीप्तम् not shining, तमसाच on account of darkness, समावृतम् engulfed all over, तत् then, आकाशम् sky, उल्काशत by the meteors, विदीपितम् again lighted, प्रचकाशे shone, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, अतुलस्वनाः unparalleled, निर्घाताः thunder, निर्जग्मुः shot forth.
explanation: The Sun and moon moved obliquely (from south to North) along with the stars. On account of the darkness that covered even the sun was not shining. The sky lighted by the meteors shone and unparalleled thunder shot forth.
hindi: उस समय आकाश में सैकड़ों उल्काएँ प्रज्वलित होकर उसे प्रकाशित करने लगीं तथा अन्तरिक्ष से अनुपम एवं भारी गड़गड़ाहट के साथ वज्रपात होने लगे

shloka_text: वपुस्फुरुश्च घनादिव्यादिवि मारुतपङ् ख्कयः । बभञ्ज च तदा वृक्षान् जलदानुद्वहन्नपिः ।।6.22.10।।
translation: दिव्यमारुतपङ् ख्कयः terrific wind blew, वपुस्फुरुश्चघनादिव्यादि breaking forth the clouds, तदा then, जलदान् abode of cold water, उद्वहन् taking away in upward direction, अपिः even, वृक्षान् trees, बभञ्जच broke into.
explanation: Then terrific wind blew breaking forth the clouds, which is an abode of cold water, taking them away in upward direction breaking trees.
hindi: परिवह आदि वायुभेदों का समूह बड़े वेग से बहने लगा। वह मेघों की घटा को उड़ाता हुआ बारंबार वृक्षों को तोड़ने, बड़े-बड़े पर्वतों से टकराने और उनके शिखरों को खण्डित करके गिराने लगा

shloka_text: अरुजंश्चैन शैलाग्राशनिखराणि बभञ्ज नः । दिवि स्पृशोमहमेघास्सङ्गतास्समहास्वनाः ।।6.22.11।। मुमुचुर्वैद्युताननगींस्ते महाशनयस्तदा ।
translation: शैलाग्रान् mountain peaks, अरुजन् च sounding, शिखराणि tops, बभञ्जच breaking, महामेधा huge cloud, दिवि sky, संगताः collecting together, महास्वनाः having extraordinary speed, वैद्युतान् fire of lightning, अनगीन् from the sky, मुमुचुः clouds, तदा then, ते those, महाशनयः loud sound.
explanation: Huge clouds collected were moving at extraordinary speed in the sky breaking mountain peaks. Those clouds in the sky sent forth fire of lightning making a loud sound.
hindi: आकाश में महान् वेगशाली विशाल वज्र भारी गड़गड़ाहट के साथ टकराकर उस समय वैद्युत अग्नि की वर्षा करने लगे। जो प्राणी दिखायी दे रहे थे और जो नहीं दिखायी देते थे, वे सब बिजली की कड़क के समान भयंकर शब्द करने लगे

shloka_text: यानि भूतानि दृश्यानि चुक्रुशुश्चाशने समम् ।।6.22.12।।
translation: दृश्यानि that which could be seen, यानि those, भूतानि creatures, आशनेसमम् remained still, चुकुश्रुः suffering pain, अदृश्यानि that which are seen, भूतानिच beings also, भैरवस्वन् like the devils and ghosts, मुमुचुः clouds, अभिभूतानि few other creatures, सन्त्रस्तानि from their place, उद्विजन्तिच came to appear, शिशियरेच even though cold, सम्प्रविव्यथिरेचापि although were together, भयात् in fear, नचपस्पन्दिरे were even thrown off.
explanation: The creatures like humans etc. That could be seen and those that could not be seen like devils and ghosts remained still out of fear. Few other creatures came out of their place even though it was cold. Some were thrown off from their habitation in fear although they were together.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 22.11 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: अदृश्यानि च भूतानि मुमुचुर्भैरवस्वनम् । शिशियरे चाभिभूतानि सन्त्रस्ताम्यद्विजन्ति च ।।6.22.13।।
translation: दृश्यानि that which could be seen, यानि those, भूतानि creatures, आशनेसमम् remained still, चुकुश्रुः suffering pain, अदृश्यानि that which are seen, भूतानिच beings also, भैरवस्वन् like the devils and ghosts, मुमुचुः clouds, अभिभूतानि few other creatures, सन्त्रस्तानि from their place, उद्विजन्तिच came to appear, शिशियरेच even though cold, सम्प्रविव्यथिरेचापि although were together, भयात् in fear, नचपस्पन्दिरे were even thrown off.
explanation: The creatures like humans etc. That could be seen and those that could not be seen like devils and ghosts remained still out of fear. Few other creatures came out of their place even though it was cold. Some were thrown off from their habitation in fear although they were together.
hindi: उनमें से कितने ही अभिभूत होकर धराशायी हो गये। कितने ही भयभीत और उद्विग्न हो उठे। कोई व्यथा से व्याकुल हो गये और कितने ही भय के मारे जडवत् हो गये

shloka_text: सहाभूतैस्सतोयोर्मिस्सनागस्सहराक्षसः ।।6.22.14।।
translation: ततः thereafter, सतोयोर्मिः those waves of water, सहाभूतै with its creatures, सनागः with serpents, सहराक्षसः with the demons, महोदधि great ocean, सहसा at once, भीमवेगः at terrific speed, अभूत् unprecedented, वेगात् speed, सम्ल्पवात् thrown out, अन्यत्रवेलाम् by the other tides, योजनम् one yojana, व्यतिचक्राम was thrown.
explanation: There after those waves of water with its creatures, serpents and demons were at once thrown off at terrific speed that was unprecedented. They were thrown beyond a yojana by the high tides.
hindi: समुद्र अपने भीतर रहने वाले प्राणियों, तरङ्गों,सो और राक्षसोंसहित सहसा भयानक वेग से युक्त हो गया और प्रलयकाल के बिना ही तीव्रगति से अपनी मर्यादा लाँघकर एक-एक योजन आगे बढ़ गया

shloka_text: सहसाऽभूत्ततो वेगाबदीमवेगो महोदधिः । योजनं व्यतिचक्राम वेलामन्यत्र सम्ल्पवात् ।।6.22.15।।
translation: ततः thereafter, सतोयोर्मिः those waves of water, सहाभूतै with its creatures, सनागः with serpents, सहराक्षसः with the demons, महोदधि great ocean, सहसा at once, भीमवेगः at terrific speed, अभूत् unprecedented, वेगात् speed, सम्ल्पवात् thrown out, अन्यत्रवेलाम् by the other tides, योजनम् one yojana, व्यतिचक्राम was thrown.
explanation: There after those waves of water with its creatures, serpents and demons were at once thrown off at terrific speed that was unprecedented. They were thrown beyond a yojana by the high tides.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 22.14 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: तं तदा समतिक्रान्तं नातिचक्राम राघवः । समुद्धतममित्रघ्नो रामो नदनदीपतिम् ।।6.22.16।।
translation: राघवः Rama, अमित्रघ्नः destroyer of foes, रामः Rama, तदा then, समतिक्रान्तम् transgressing, समुद्धतम् overweening, तम् them, नदनदीपतिम् Lord of rivers, नातिचक्राम not go far.
explanation: Rama the destroyer of foes did not attempt at the ocean that went far from the boundary, which was transgressing and overweening.
hindi: इस प्रकार नदों और नदियों के स्वामी उस उद्धत समुद्र के मर्यादा लाँघकर बढ़ जाने पर भी शत्रुसूदन श्रीरामचन्द्रजी अपने स्थान से पीछे नहीं हटे

shloka_text: ततो मथ्यात्समुद्रस्य सागरस्स्वयमुत्थितः । उदयन् हिमहाशैलान्मेरोरिव दिवाकरः ।।6.22.17।।
translation: ततः then, महामेरोः over the mighty Meru, उदयं rising, दिवाकरःइव like the Sun, सागरः Lord of ocean, समुद्रस्य ocean's, मध्यात् middle, स्वयम् himself, उत्थितः risen.
explanation: Then Sagara, the Lord of the ocean himself rising like the Sun over the mighty Meru Mountain rose from the middle of the ocean.
hindi: तब समुद्र के बीच से सागर स्वयं मूर्तिमान् होकर प्रकट हुआ, मानो महाशैल मेरुपर्वत के अङ्गभूत उदयाचल से सूर्यदेव उदित हुए हों

shloka_text: पन्नगैस्सह दीप्तास्यैस्समुद्रः प्रत्यदृश्यत । स्निग्धवैढूर्यसङ्काशो जाम्बूनदविभूषणः ।।6.22.18।।
translation: स्निग्धवैदूर्यसङ्काशः bright like Vaidurya stone, जम्बूनदविभूषणः decked in pure gold, समुद्रः Lord of the ocean, दीप्तास्यैः as though blazing, पन्नगैरक्तमाल्यास्सह with serpents, प्रदृश्यत appeared.
explanation: Then the Lord of the Ocean shining like the Vaidurya stone decked in pure gold as if blazing appeared along with serpents.
hindi: चमकीले मुखवाले सो के साथ समुद्र का दर्शन हुआ। उसका वर्ण स्निग्ध वैदूर्यमणि के समान श्याम था। उसने जाम्बूनद नामक सुवर्ण के बने हुए आभूषण पहन रखे थे

shloka_text: रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरः पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः । सर्वपुष्पमयीं दिव्यां शिरसा धारयन् स्रजम् ।।6.22.19।।
translation: रत्क्तमाल्याम्बरधरः clad in red coloured robes, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः whose eyes were like lotus petals, शिरसा on the head, सर्वपुष्पमयीम् wearing different kinds of flowers, दिव्याम् wonderful, प्रजम् wreath, धारयन् wearing, जातरूपमयैश्चैव of polished gold, तपनीयविभूषणैः decked in shining ornaments, आत्मजानाम् from his own territory, रत्नानाम् precious gems, भूषणोत्तमैः best of ornaments, भूषितः decked, मण्डितः with different kinds of minerals, हिमनान् शैलःइव resembled the Himalaya mountain, एकावलीमध्यगतम् in the midst of pearl necklace on his bosom, पाण्डरप्रभम् shedding white lustre, कौस्तुभस्यसहोदरम् resembling Kausthuba (a precious jewel with emerald gem worn by Lord Vishnu), तरलम् hanging necklace, विपुलेन broad, उपसा near, बिभ्रत् moving, अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः with several tides rising up, कालिकानिलसङ्कुलः with multitude of tides touching the of clouds, देवतानाम् goddesses, सरूपाभि forms also, नानारूपाभिः of diverse forms, गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधानाभिः Ganga and Sindhu such important rivers, आपगाभिः coming near, समावृतः surrounded by, ईश्वरः Lord, वीर्यवान् valiant one, सागरः Sagara, समुपक्रम्य all coming near, पूर्वम् first, आम्नत्यर greeting, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, शरपाणिनम् one who held the arrow, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Clad in red coloured robes, endowed with lotus petal like eyes having a wonderful wreath of diverse flowers on head, decked in shining ornaments of polished gold encrusted with precious gems from his own territory, he resembled the Himalayan Mountain with minerals. He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.
hindi: लाल रंग के फूलों की माला तथा लाल ही वस्त्र धारण किये थे। उसके नेत्र प्रफुल्ल कमलदल के समान सुन्दर थे। उसने सिर पर एक दिव्य पुष्पमाला धारण कर रखी थी, जो सब प्रकार के फूलों से बनायी गयी थी

shloka_text: जातरूपमयैश्चैव तपनीयविभूषितैः । आत्मजानां च रत्नानां भूषितो भूषणोत्तमैः ।।6.22.20।।
translation: रत्क्तमाल्याम्बरधरः clad in red coloured robes, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः whose eyes were like lotus petals, शिरसा on the head, सर्वपुष्पमयीम् wearing different kinds of flowers, दिव्याम् wonderful, प्रजम् wreath, धारयन् wearing, जातरूपमयैश्चैव of polished gold, तपनीयविभूषणैः decked in shining ornaments, आत्मजानाम् from his own territory, रत्नानाम् precious gems, भूषणोत्तमैः best of ornaments, भूषितः decked, मण्डितः with different kinds of minerals, हिमनान् शैलःइव resembled the Himalaya mountain, एकावलीमध्यगतम् in the midst of pearl necklace on his bosom, पाण्डरप्रभम् shedding white lustre, कौस्तुभस्यसहोदरम् resembling Kausthuba (a precious jewel with emerald gem worn by Lord Vishnu), तरलम् hanging necklace, विपुलेन broad, उपसा near, बिभ्रत् moving, अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः with several tides rising up, कालिकानिलसङ्कुलः with multitude of tides touching the of clouds, देवतानाम् goddesses, सरूपाभि forms also, नानारूपाभिः of diverse forms, गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधानाभिः Ganga and Sindhu such important rivers, आपगाभिः coming near, समावृतः surrounded by, ईश्वरः Lord, वीर्यवान् valiant one, सागरः Sagara, समुपक्रम्य all coming near, पूर्वम् first, आम्नत्यर greeting, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, शरपाणिनम् one who held the arrow, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Clad in red coloured robes, endowed with lotus petal like eyes having a wonderful wreath of diverse flowers on head, decked in shining ornaments of polished gold encrusted with precious gems from his own territory, he resembled the Himalayan Mountain with minerals. He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.
hindi: सुवर्ण और तपे हुए काञ्चन के आभूषण उसकी शोभा बढ़ाते थे। वह अपने ही भीतर उत्पन्न हुए रत्नों के उत्तम आभूषणों से विभूषित था

shloka_text: धातुभिर्मण्डितश्शैलो विविधैर्हिमवानिव । एकावलीमध्यगतं तरलं पाटलप्रभम् ।।6.22.21।।
translation: रत्क्तमाल्याम्बरधरः clad in red coloured robes, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः whose eyes were like lotus petals, शिरसा on the head, सर्वपुष्पमयीम् wearing different kinds of flowers, दिव्याम् wonderful, प्रजम् wreath, धारयन् wearing, जातरूपमयैश्चैव of polished gold, तपनीयविभूषणैः decked in shining ornaments, आत्मजानाम् from his own territory, रत्नानाम् precious gems, भूषणोत्तमैः best of ornaments, भूषितः decked, मण्डितः with different kinds of minerals, हिमनान् शैलःइव resembled the Himalaya mountain, एकावलीमध्यगतम् in the midst of pearl necklace on his bosom, पाण्डरप्रभम् shedding white lustre, कौस्तुभस्यसहोदरम् resembling Kausthuba (a precious jewel with emerald gem worn by Lord Vishnu), तरलम् hanging necklace, विपुलेन broad, उपसा near, बिभ्रत् moving, अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः with several tides rising up, कालिकानिलसङ्कुलः with multitude of tides touching the of clouds, देवतानाम् goddesses, सरूपाभि forms also, नानारूपाभिः of diverse forms, गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधानाभिः Ganga and Sindhu such important rivers, आपगाभिः coming near, समावृतः surrounded by, ईश्वरः Lord, वीर्यवान् valiant one, सागरः Sagara, समुपक्रम्य all coming near, पूर्वम् first, आम्नत्यर greeting, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, शरपाणिनम् one who held the arrow, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Clad in red coloured robes, endowed with lotus petal like eyes having a wonderful wreath of diverse flowers on head, decked in shining ornaments of polished gold encrusted with precious gems from his own territory, he resembled the Himalayan Mountain with minerals. He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.
hindi: इसीलिये नाना प्रकार के धातुओं से  अलंकृत हिमवान् पर्वत के समान शोभा पाता था। वह अपने विशाल वक्षःस्थल पर कौस्तुभ मणि के सहोदर (सदृश) एक श्वेत प्रभा से युक्त मुख्य रत्न धारण किये हुए था, जो मोतियों की इकहरी माला के मध्यभाग में प्रकाशित हो रहा था

shloka_text: विपुलेनोरसा बिभ्रत्कौस्तुभस्य सहोदरम् । अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः कालिकानिलसङ्गुलः ।।6.22.22।।
translation: रत्क्तमाल्याम्बरधरः clad in red coloured robes, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः whose eyes were like lotus petals, शिरसा on the head, सर्वपुष्पमयीम् wearing different kinds of flowers, दिव्याम् wonderful, प्रजम् wreath, धारयन् wearing, जातरूपमयैश्चैव of polished gold, तपनीयविभूषणैः decked in shining ornaments, आत्मजानाम् from his own territory, रत्नानाम् precious gems, भूषणोत्तमैः best of ornaments, भूषितः decked, मण्डितः with different kinds of minerals, हिमनान् शैलःइव resembled the Himalaya mountain, एकावलीमध्यगतम् in the midst of pearl necklace on his bosom, पाण्डरप्रभम् shedding white lustre, कौस्तुभस्यसहोदरम् resembling Kausthuba (a precious jewel with emerald gem worn by Lord Vishnu), तरलम् hanging necklace, विपुलेन broad, उपसा near, बिभ्रत् moving, अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः with several tides rising up, कालिकानिलसङ्कुलः with multitude of tides touching the of clouds, देवतानाम् goddesses, सरूपाभि forms also, नानारूपाभिः of diverse forms, गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधानाभिः Ganga and Sindhu such important rivers, आपगाभिः coming near, समावृतः surrounded by, ईश्वरः Lord, वीर्यवान् valiant one, सागरः Sagara, समुपक्रम्य all coming near, पूर्वम् first, आम्नत्यर greeting, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, शरपाणिनम् one who held the arrow, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.
hindi: चञ्चल तरङ्गे उसे घेरे हुए थीं। मेघमाला और वायु से वह व्याप्त था तथा गङ्गा और सिन्धु आदि नदियाँ उसे सब ओर से घेरकर खड़ी थीं

shloka_text: गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधाननाभिरापगाभिस्समावृतः । देवतानां सरूपाभिर्नानारूपाभिरीश्वरः ।।6.22.23।।
translation: रत्क्तमाल्याम्बरधरः clad in red coloured robes, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः whose eyes were like lotus petals, शिरसा on the head, सर्वपुष्पमयीम् wearing different kinds of flowers, दिव्याम् wonderful, प्रजम् wreath, धारयन् wearing, जातरूपमयैश्चैव of polished gold, तपनीयविभूषणैः decked in shining ornaments, आत्मजानाम् from his own territory, रत्नानाम् precious gems, भूषणोत्तमैः best of ornaments, भूषितः decked, मण्डितः with different kinds of minerals, हिमनान् शैलःइव resembled the Himalaya mountain, एकावलीमध्यगतम् in the midst of pearl necklace on his bosom, पाण्डरप्रभम् shedding white lustre, कौस्तुभस्यसहोदरम् resembling Kausthuba (a precious jewel with emerald gem worn by Lord Vishnu), तरलम् hanging necklace, विपुलेन broad, उपसा near, बिभ्रत् moving, अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः with several tides rising up, कालिकानिलसङ्कुलः with multitude of tides touching the of clouds, देवतानाम् goddesses, सरूपाभि forms also, नानारूपाभिः of diverse forms, गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधानाभिः Ganga and Sindhu such important rivers, आपगाभिः coming near, समावृतः surrounded by, ईश्वरः Lord, वीर्यवान् valiant one, सागरः Sagara, समुपक्रम्य all coming near, पूर्वम् first, आम्नत्यर greeting, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, शरपाणिनम् one who held the arrow, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Clad in red coloured robes, endowed with lotus petal like eyes having a wonderful wreath of diverse flowers on head, decked in shining ornaments of polished gold encrusted with precious gems from his own territory, he resembled the Himalayan Mountain with minerals. He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.
hindi: उसके भीतर बड़े-बड़े ग्राह उद्भान्त हो रहे थे, नाग और राक्षस घबराये हुए थे। देवताओं के समान सुन्दर रूप धारण करके आयी हुई विभिन्न रूपवाली नदियों के साथ शक्तिशाली नदीपति समुद्र ने निकट आकर पहले धनुर्धर श्रीरघुनाथजी को सम्बोधित किया और फिर हाथ जोड़कर कहा-

shloka_text: सागरस्समुपक्रम्य पूर्वमाम्नत्यर वीर्यवान् । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं राघवं शरपाणिनम् ।।6.22.24।।
translation: रत्क्तमाल्याम्बरधरः clad in red coloured robes, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः whose eyes were like lotus petals, शिरसा on the head, सर्वपुष्पमयीम् wearing different kinds of flowers, दिव्याम् wonderful, प्रजम् wreath, धारयन् wearing, जातरूपमयैश्चैव of polished gold, तपनीयविभूषणैः decked in shining ornaments, आत्मजानाम् from his own territory, रत्नानाम् precious gems, भूषणोत्तमैः best of ornaments, भूषितः decked, मण्डितः with different kinds of minerals, हिमनान् शैलःइव resembled the Himalaya mountain, एकावलीमध्यगतम् in the midst of pearl necklace on his bosom, पाण्डरप्रभम् shedding white lustre, कौस्तुभस्यसहोदरम् resembling Kausthuba (a precious jewel with emerald gem worn by Lord Vishnu), तरलम् hanging necklace, विपुलेन broad, उपसा near, बिभ्रत् moving, अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः with several tides rising up, कालिकानिलसङ्कुलः with multitude of tides touching the of clouds, देवतानाम् goddesses, सरूपाभि forms also, नानारूपाभिः of diverse forms, गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधानाभिः Ganga and Sindhu such important rivers, आपगाभिः coming near, समावृतः surrounded by, ईश्वरः Lord, वीर्यवान् valiant one, सागरः Sagara, समुपक्रम्य all coming near, पूर्वम् first, आम्नत्यर greeting, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, शरपाणिनम् one who held the arrow, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 22.23 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च राघव : । स्वभावे सौम्य तिष्ठन्ति शाश्वतं मार्गमाश्रिताः ।।6.22.25।।
translation: सौम्य noble, राघव Rama, पृथिवी earth, वायुः wind, आकाशम् space, आपः water, ज्योतिश्च fire, शाश्वतम् permanent, मार्गम् path, आश्रिताः following, स्वभावे its nature, तिष्ठन्ति remain.
explanation: "Noble Rama Earth, wind, space, water, and fire, the five elements remain in their path strictly following their nature."
hindi: ‘सौम्य रघुनन्दन! पृथ्वी, वायु, आकाश, जल और तेज—ये सर्वदा अपने स्वभाव में स्थित रहते हैं। अपने सनातन मार्ग को कभी नहीं छोड़ते—सदा उसी के आश्रित रहते हैं

shloka_text: तत्स्वभावो ममाप्येष यदगाधोऽहमप्लवः । विकारस्तु भवेद्गाध एतत्ते प्रवदाम्यहम् ।।6.22.26।।
translation: तत् that, अहम् I, अगाधः fathomless, अप्लवःइतयत् as such not capable of swimming out, एषः so, ममापि mine too, स्वभावः nature, गाधःतु fording, विकारः deviation, भवेत् will be, एतत् as such, ते to you, प्रवदामि I proclaim
explanation: "I am fathomless and as such not capable of being swum across as it is my nature too. My fording will be a deviation. I proclaim to you (how you can cross)."
hindi: ‘मेरा भी यह स्वभाव ही है जो मैं अगाध और अथाह हूँ-कोई मेरे पार नहीं जा सकता। यदि मेरी थाह मिल जाय तो यह विकार—मेरे स्वभाव का व्यतिक्रम ही होगा। इसलिये मैं आपसे पार होने का यह उपाय बताता हूँ

shloka_text: न कामान्न च लोभाद्वा न भयातत्सापार्थिवात्मज : । ग्राहनकाकुलजलं स्तम्बयेयं कथञ्जन ।।6.22.27।।
translation: पार्थिवात्मज O Lord of the land, ग्राहनकाकुलजलम् infested by poisonous animals, कामात् out of desire, कथंचन in any case, स्तम्बयेयम् solidify water, लोभाद्वा out of covetousness, भयात् out of fear, न not.
explanation: "O Lord of the land Out of desire or covetousness or even out of fear I will not be able to solidify the water infested with poisonous animals."
hindi: ‘राजकुमार! मैं मगर और नाक आदि से भरे हुए अपने जल को किसी कामना से, लोभ से अथवा भय से किसी तरह स्तम्भित नहीं होने दूंगा

shloka_text: विधास्येराम: येनापिविषहिष्येह्यहंतथा । नग्राहाप्रहरिष्यन्तियावत्सेनातरिष्यति ।।6.22.28।। हरीणांतरणेरामकरिष्यामियथास्थलम् ।
translation: राम O Rama, अहम् I, येनापि by means of which, तथा so also, विधास्ये in such a mode, हरीणाम् by the Vanaras, तरणे to cross over, स्थलम् base, यत्रा passage, करिष्यामि I will do, तथा and similarly, विषहिष्ये the poisonous creatures, सेना army, यावत् total, तरष्यति crosses over, ग्राहाः seizing, नप्रहरिष्यन्ति will not be of aggressive nature.
explanation: "O Rama I shall arrange a base in such a mode, by means of which the entire army of Vanaras can cross over the passage and I will also be seizing the poisonous animals and not be aggressive."
hindi: ‘श्रीराम! मैं ऐसा उपाय बताऊँगा, जिससे आप मेरे पार चले जायँगे, ग्राह वानरों को कष्ट नहीं देंगे, सारी सेना पार उतर जायगी और मुझे भी खेद नहीं होगा। मैं आसानी से सब कुछ सह लूँगा। वानरों के पार जाने के लिये जिस प्रकार पुल बन जाय, वैसा प्रयत्न मैं करूँगा’

shloka_text: तमब्रवीत्तदा रामः उद्यतोहिनदीपते । अमोघोऽयं महाबाणः कस्मिन् देशे निपात्यताम् ।।6.22.29।।
translation: तदा then, रामः Rama, तम् , अब्रवीत् said, वरुणालया abode of Varuna, मे my, शृणु listen, अमोघः unfailing, आयम् this, महाबाणः mighty arrow, कस्मिन् in which, देशे location, निपात्यताम् should it be allowed to descend down.
explanation: Then Rama said, "O abode of Varuna, listen to me. In which location should I allow this unfailing mighty arrow to descend?"
hindi: तब श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ने उससे कहा—’वरुणालय! मेरी बात सुनो। मेरा यह विशाल बाण अमोघ है। बताओ, इसे किस स्थान पर छोड़ा जाय’

shloka_text: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा तं च दृष्टवा महाशरम् । महोदधिर्महातेजा राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.22.30।।
translation: महातेजाः brilliant one, महोदधिः great ocean, रामस्य Rama's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, तम् his, महाशरम् mighty arrow, दृष्टवाच seeing at, राघवम् Rama, वाक्यम् this words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: On hearing the question of Rama, the mighty ocean seeing the brilliant arrow spoke these words to him.
hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्रजी का यह वचन सुनकर और उस महान् बाण को देखकर महातेजस्वी महासागर ने रघुनाथजी से कहा-

shloka_text: उत्तरेणावकाशोऽस्ति कश्चित्पुण्यतमो मम । द्रुमकुल्य इति ख्यातो लोके यथा भवान् ।।6.22.31।।
translation: भवान् you, यथा like, लोके region, ख्यातः famous, द्रुमकुल्यःइति called Drumakulya, पुण्यतरः a holy place, कश्चित् a little, अवकाशः there is scope for you, मम to my, उत्तरेण north, अस्ति will be.
explanation: "To my north there is a holy place called Drumakulya, famous like you, and you have scope to act there (to descend the arrow)."
hindi: ‘प्रभो! जैसे जगत् में आप सर्वत्र विख्यात एवं पुण्यात्मा हैं, उसी प्रकार मेरे उत्तर की ओर द्रुमकुल्य नाम से विख्यात एक बड़ा ही पवित्र देश है

shloka_text: उग्रदर्शनकर्माणो बहवस्तत्र दस्यवः । आभीरप्रमुखाः पापाः पिबन्ति सलिलं मम ।।6.22.32।।
translation: तत्र there, उग्रदर्शनकर्माणः marauders of terrific action, पापाः sinful, आभीरप्रमुखाः chief of Abhiras, बहवः many, दस्यवः enemies of gods, मम my, सलिलम् waters, पिबन्ति drinking.
explanation: "Marauders of terrific action, who are enemies of gods whose chief is Abhiras, live there drinking my (ocean) water performing sinful acts."
hindi: ‘वहाँ आभीर आदि जातियों के बहुत-से मनुष्य निवास करते हैं, जिनके रूप और कर्म बड़े ही भयानक हैं। वे सब-के-सब पापी और लुटेरे हैं। वे लोग मेरा जल पीते हैं

shloka_text: तैस्तुसंस्पर्शनं पापैर्न सहे पापकर्मभिः । अमोघः क्रियतां राम : तत्र तेषुशरोत्तमः ।।6.22.33।।
translation: राम Rama, पापकर्मभिः sinful actions also, तैः those, पापैः sinners, तत् that, स्पर्शनम् their touch, नसहेयम् I do not tolerate, शरोत्तमः mighty arrow, तत्र there, तेषु by that, अमोघः unfailing, क्रियताम् can be released on them.
explanation: "Rama I cannot tolerate the touch of ones who are sinful in action. Therefore your (of descending this arrow down) mighty unfailing arrow can be released on them."
hindi: ‘उन पापाचारियों का स्पर्श मुझे प्राप्त होता रहता है, इस पाप को मैं नहीं सह सकता। श्रीराम! आप अपने इस उत्तम बाण को वहीं सफल कीजिये’

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सागरस्य राघवः । मुमोच तं शरं दीप्तं वीरस्सागरदर्शनात् ।।6.22.34।।
translation: महात्मनः great self, तस्यसागरस्य that Sagara's, तत् those, वचनम् words of request, श्रुत्वा hearing, सागरदर्शनात् on account of seeing the Sagara, दीप्तम् glowing, परम् supreme, तंशरम् that arrow, मुमोच let off.
explanation: On hearing the words of the request of Sagara and on account of seeing him, Rama let off the supreme arrow glowing (on the marauders).
hindi: महामना समुद्र का यह वचन सुनकर सागर के दिखाये अनुसार उसी देश में श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ने वह अत्यन्त प्रज्वलित बाण छोड़ दिया

shloka_text: तेन तन्मरुकान्तारं पृथिव्या खलुविश्रुतम् । निपातितश्शरो यत्र वज्राशनिसमप्रभः ।।6.22.35।।
translation: तेन by the, वज्राशनिसमप्रभः like that of Indra's glow, शरः dart, यत्र there, निपातितः let down, तत् that, पृथिव्याम् region of land, मरुकान्तारम् Marakantaram, विश्रुतंखलु indeed was known as popularly.
explanation: By the letting down of the dart that resembled the glow of Indra that part of the land was indeed popularly known as Marakantara (Marwar and Bikaner region of Rajasthan).
hindi: वह वज्र और अशनि के समान तेजस्वी बाण जिस स्थान पर गिरा था, वह स्थान उस बाण के कारण ही पृथ्वी में दुर्गम मरुभूमि के नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुआ

shloka_text: ननाद च तदा तत्र वसुधा शल्यपीडिता । तस्माद्ब्राणमुखात्तोयमुत्पपात रसातलात् ।।6.22.36।।
translation: तदा then, तत्र there, शल्यपीडिता crevice by the dart, वसुधा earth, ननाद popularly known, तस्मात् therefore, बाणमुखात् by the piercing of the dart, रसातलात् from the underworld, तोयम् water, उत्पपात came out.
explanation: At that part of the earth that was creviced by the piercing of the dart, water came out from the underworld.
hindi: उस बाण से पीड़ित होकर उस समय वसुधा आर्तनाद कर उठी। उसकी चोट से जो छेद हुआ, उसमें होकर रसातल का जल ऊपर को उछलने लगा

shloka_text: स बभूव तदा कूपो व्रण इत्येभि विश्रुतः । सततं चोत्थितं तोयं समुद्रस्येन दृश्यते ।।6.22.37।।
translation: तदा then, सः that, कूपः well, व्रणःइत्येन as Vrana, विश्रुतः popularly, बभूव came to be known, समुद्रस्येव like the water of the ocean, तईयम् water, सततम् always, उत्थितम् springs out, दृश्यते seen.
explanation: That well (hole created by the dart) came to be known as Vrana. The water springing out of it forever is like sea water.
hindi: वह छिद्र कुएँ के समान हो गया और व्रण के नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुआ। उस कुएँ से सदा निकलता हुआ जल समुद्र के जल की भाँति ही दिखायी देता है

shloka_text: अवधारणशब्दश्च दारुणस्समपद्यत । तस्मात्तद्बाणनिपातेन त्वपः कुक्षिष्वशोषयत् ।।6.22.38।।
translation: तस्मात् from that, दारुणः terrific, अवधारणशब्दः the sound that was produced, समपद्यत crack caused, तद्बाणनिपातेन by the act of letting off the dart, कुक्षिषु in the cavities, त्वपः water, अशोषयत् dried up.
explanation: A crack caused in the ground by letting off the dart produced terrific sound and by that, the water in the cavities of the ground dried up.
hindi: उस समय वहाँ भूमि के विदीर्ण होने का भयंकर शब्द सुनायी पड़ा। उस बाण को गिराकर वहाँ के भूतल की कुक्षि में (तालाब-पोखरे आदि में) वर्तमान जल को श्रीराम ने सुखा दिया

shloka_text: विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु मधुकान्तारमेव तत् ।।6.22.39।।
translation: मरुकान्तारम् Marukantaram, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, विख्यातम् very famous, दशरथात्मजः Dasaratha's son, विद्वान् learned, अमरविक्रमः one who has the valour of gods, रामः Rama, तम् those, कुक्षिम् cavities, शोषयित्वा making dry, तस्मैमरवे for that Marukantaram, वरवे boon, ददौ: gave.
explanation: Marukantaram is famous in the three worlds. Dasaratha's Rama, who is learned and has the valour of gods made the cavities dry and gave a boon.
hindi: तबसे वह स्थान तीनों लोकों में मरुकान्तार के नाम से  ही विख्यात हो गया। जो पहले समुद्र का कुक्षिप्रदेश था, उसे सुखाकर देवोपम पराक्रमी विद्वान् दशरथनन्दन श्रीराम ने उस मरुभूमि को वरदान दिया

shloka_text: मोक्षयित्वा त तः कुक्षिं रामो दशरथात्मजः । वरं तस्मै ददौ विद्वान्मरवेऽमरविक्रमः ।।6.22.40।।
translation: मरुकान्तारम् Marukantaram, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, विख्यातम् very famous, दशरथात्मजः Dasaratha's son, विद्वान् learned, अमरविक्रमः one who has the valour of gods, रामः Rama, तम् those, कुक्षिम् cavities, शोषयित्वा making dry, तस्मैमरवे for that Marukantaram, वरवे boon, ददौ: gave.
explanation: Marukantaram is famous in the three worlds. Dasaratha's Rama, who is learned and has the valour of gods made the cavities dry and gave a boon.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 22.39 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: पशव्यश्चाल्परोगश्च फलमूलरसायुतः । बहुस्नेहो बहुक्षीरस्सुगधनिर्विविधौषधः ।।6.22.41।।
translation: मरुः Maru, रामस्य Rama's, वरदानात् by virtue of the boon, पशव्यश्च tender grass for cows, अल्परोगश्च with less diseases, फलमूलरसायुतः with fruits and roots and honey, बहुस्नेहः very ideal, बहुक्षीरः plenty of milk, सुगधनिः fragrant, विविधौषधिः diverse kinds of medicinal herbs, एवम् in that way, युक्तः suitable, एतैः all these, गुणैः qualities, संयुतः endowed with, शिवः auspicious, पन्थाः holy, बभूव became.
explanation: By virtue of Rama's boon Maru became a beautiful land with tender grass for cows, with less diseases, very ideal for fruits, roots, and juicy foods, for plenty of milk, and suitable for fragrance, diverse kinds of medicinal herbs. Endowed with these virtues it became a holy and auspicious place.
hindi: ‘यह मरुभूमि पशुओं के लिये हितकारी होगी। यहाँ रोग कम होंगे। यह भूमि फल, मूल और रसों से सम्पन्न होगी। यहाँ घी आदि चिकने पदार्थ अधिक सुलभ होंगे, दूध की भी बहुतायत होगी। यहाँ सुगन्ध छायी रहेगी और अनेक प्रकार की ओषधियाँ उत्पन्न होंगी’

shloka_text: एवमेतैर्गुणैरुक्तो बहुभिस्संयुतो मरुः । रामस्य वरदानाच्च शिवः पन्था बभूव ह ।।6.22.42।।
translation: मरुः Maru, रामस्य Rama's, वरदानात् by virtue of the boon, पशव्यश्च tender grass for cows, अल्परोगश्च with less diseases, फलमूलरसायुतः with fruits and roots and honey, बहुस्नेहः very ideal, बहुक्षीरः plenty of milk, सुगधनिः fragrant, विविधौषधिः diverse kinds of medicinal herbs, एवम् in that way, युक्तः suitable, एतैः all these, गुणैः qualities, संयुतः endowed with, शिवः auspicious, पन्थाः holy, बभूव became.
explanation: By virtue of Rama's boon Maru became a beautiful land with tender grass for cows, with less diseases, very ideal for fruits, roots, and juicy foods, for plenty of milk, and suitable for fragrance, diverse kinds of medicinal herbs. Endowed with these virtues it became a holy and auspicious place.
hindi: इस प्रकार भगवान् श्रीराम के वरदान से वह मरुप्रदेश इस तरह के बहुसंख्यक गुणों से सम्पन्न हो सबके लिये मङ्गलकारी मार्ग बन गया

shloka_text: तस्मिन् दग्धे तदा कुक्षौ समुद्रस्सरितां पतिः । राघवं सर्वशास्त्रज्ञमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.22.43।।
translation: तदा then, तस्मिन् that, कुक्षौ land, दग्धे burnt, सरितांपति Lord of rivers, समुद्रः ocean, सर्वशास्त्रज्ञम् learned in all sastras, राघवम् Rama, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken.
explanation: Thereafter when that land of Drumakulyam was burnt (by Rama's arrow) the Lord of rivers looked at Rama who was learned in all sastras spoke these words.
hindi: उस कुक्षिस्थान के दग्ध हो जाने पर सरिताओं के स्वामी समुद्र ने सम्पूर्ण शास्त्रों के ज्ञाता श्रीरघुनाथजी से कहा—

shloka_text: अयं सौम्य : नलो नाम तनयो विश्वकर्मणः । पित्रा दत्तवर शीमान्प्रतिमो विश्वकर्मणाः ।।6.22.44।।
translation: सौम्य noble one, श्रीमान् prosperous one, नलोनाम named Nala, अयम् this, विश्वकर्मणः by Vishwakarma's, तनयः son, पित्रा father, दत्तवरः obtained boons, विश्वकर्मणः in architecture, प्रतिमः equal to father.
explanation: "Noble Rama This prosperous one named Nala is the son of Vishwakarma. Since he has obtained boons from his father, he is equal to his father in architecture."
hindi: ‘सौम्य! आपकी सेना में जो यह नल नामक कान्तिमान् वानर है, साक्षात् विश्वकर्मा का पुत्र है। इसे इसके पिता ने यह वर दिया है कि ‘तुम मेरे ही समान समस्त शिल्पकला में निपुण हो ओगे।’ प्रभो! आप भी तो इस विश्व के स्रष्टा विश्वकर्मा हैं। इस नल के हृदय में आपके प्रति बड़ा प्रेम है

shloka_text: एष सेतुं महोत्साहः करोतु मयि वानरः । तमहं धारयिष्यामि यथा ह्येष पिता तथा ।।6.22.45।।
translation: महोत्साहः full of zeal, एषःवानरः this Vanara, मयि over me, सेतुम् bridge, करोतु will built, तम् him, अहम् I, धारयिष्यामि will bear, पिता father, यथा that way, एषः he is, तथा like him.
explanation: "This monkey is full of zeal. He will build a bridge over me, and I will bear it. In that way he is like his father."
hindi: ‘यह महान् उत्साही वानर अपने पिता के समान ही शिल्पकर्म में समर्थ है, अतः यह मेरे ऊपर पुल का निर्माण करे। मैं उस पुल को धारण करूँगा’

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वोदधिर्नष्टस्समुत्थाय नलस्तदा । अब्रवीद्वानरश्रेष्ठो वाक्यं रामं महाबलः ।।6.22.46।।
translation: उदधिः Sea God, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, नष्टः disappeared, तदा thereafter, वानरश्रेष्ठः foremost of Vanaras, नलः Nala, समुत्थाय getting up, महाबलः mighty, रामम् at Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having spoken in that way, the Sea God disappeared. Nala, the foremost of vanaras, got up there after and spoke these words to mighty Rama.
hindi: यों कहकर समुद्र अदृश्य हो गया। तब वानरश्रेष्ठ नल उठकर महाबली भगवान् श्रीराम से बोला—

shloka_text: अहं सेतुं करिष्यामि विस्तीर्णे वरुणालये । पितुस्सामर्थ्यमास्थाय तत्त्वमहा महोदधिः ।।6.22.47।।
translation: अहम् I, पितुः father, सामर्थ्यम् skill, आस्थाय adopting, विस्तीर्णे broad, वरुणालये on the abode of Varuna, सेतुम् bridge, करिष्यामि will build, महोदधिः ocean god, तत्त्वम् truth, आह has spoken.
explanation: "Adopting my father's skill, I shall build a bridge over the broad abode of Varuna." And the ocean god spoke the truth to him.
hindi: ‘प्रभो! मैं पिता की दी हुई शक्ति को पाकर इस विस्तृत समुद्रपर सेतु का निर्माण करूँगा। महासागर ने ठीक कहा है ‘संसार में पुरुष के लिये अकृतज्ञों के प्रति दण्डनीति का प्रयोग ही सबसे बड़ा अर्थसाधक है, ऐसा मेरा विश्वास है। वैसे लोगों के प्रति क्षमा, सान्त्वना और दाननीति के प्रयोग को धिक्कार है

shloka_text: दण्ड एव वरो लोके पुरुषस्येति मे मतिः । धिक् क्षमामकृतज्ञेषु सान्त्वं दानमथापि वा ।।6.22.47.1।।
translation: लोके in the world, पुरुषस्य for a man, दण्डः एव the rod alone, वरः is best, इति thus, मे my, मतिः is the opinion, अकृतज्ञेषु toward the ungrateful, क्षमाम् forbearance, धिक् fie upon, सान्त्वम् conciliation, दानम् अथापि वा or even gift
explanation: "In this world the rod alone is best for a man: such is my opinion. Fie upon forbearance toward the ungrateful, or conciliation, or gift."

shloka_text: अयं हि सागरो भीमस्सेतुकर्मदिदृक्ष्याः । ददौ दण्डभयाद्गाधं राघवाय महोदधिः ।।6.22.48।।
translation: भीमः fearsome, अयंहि I also, सागरः ocean, महोदधिः mighty ocean, दण्डभयात् fear of punishment, सेतुकर्मदिदृक्ष्या to witness the building of a bridge, राघवाय to Rama, गाधम् place, ददौ allowed a passage.
explanation: This fearsome ocean of mighty Sagara (dug by Sagara) then allowed a passage for Rama, out of fear of punishment and also to witness the building of a bridge.
hindi: ‘इस भयानक समुद्र को राजा सगर के पुत्रों ने ही बढ़ाया है। फिर भी इसने कृतज्ञता से नहीं, दण्ड के भय से ही सेतुकर्म देखने की इच्छा मन में लाकर श्रीरघुनाथजी को अपनी थाह दी है

shloka_text: मममातुर्वरोदत्तोमन्दरेविश्वकर्मणा । औरसस्तस्यपुत्रोऽहंसदृशोविश्वकर्मणा ।।6.22.49।।
translation: मन्दरे on Mandara mountain, विश्वकर्मणा Vishwakarmana, मममातुः my mother, वरः boon, दत्तः has given, अहम् I, तस्य her, औरसःपुत्रः born out of her body, विश्वकर्मणा Vishwakarma, सदृशः I am like him, एतेन by that, स्मारितःअस्मि I have put in my memory, महोदधिः great ocean, तत्त्वम् nature, आह I am aware, अनुक्तः I have not spoken, अहम् I, आत्मनः myself, गुणान् qualities, वः unless, नप्रब्रूयाम् will not speak, अहम् I, वरुणालये abode of Varuna, सेतुम् bridge, कर्तुम् will build, समर्थश्चापि am capable, कामम् required material, वानरपुङ्गवाः Vanara leaders, अद्यैव right away, सेतुम् for the bridge, बद्नन्तु for building.
explanation: "On the Mandara mountain Vishwakarma gave a boon to my mother. I am that Vishwakarma's own son, and I am like him at work by that cause. I have put in my memory all about the ocean. I am aware of the truth of the ocean. I could not speak of my qualities unless questioned. I can build a bridge over the abode of Varuna.Right away let the Vanara leaders get the material required for building the bridge (said Nala)."
hindi: ‘मन्दराचलपर विश्वकर्माजी ने मेरी माता को यह वर दिया था कि ‘देवि! तुम्हारे गर्भ से मेरे ही समान पुत्र होगा’ ‘इस प्रकार मैं विश्वकर्मा का औरस पुत्र हूँ और शिल्पकर्म में उन्हीं के समान हूँ। इस समुद्र ने आज मुझे इन सब बातों का स्मरण दिला दिया है। महासागर ने जो कुछ कहा है, ठीक है। मैं बिना पूछे आपलोगों से अपने गुणों को नहीं बता सकता था, इसीलिये अबतक चुप था

shloka_text: नचाप्यहमनुक्तोवःप्रब्रूयामात्मनोगुणान् । समर्थश्चाप्यहंसेतुंकर्तुंवैवरुणालये ।।6.22.50।।
translation: मन्दरे on Mandara mountain, विश्वकर्मणा Vishwakarmana, मममातुः my mother, वरः boon, दत्तः has given, अहम् I, तस्य her, औरसःपुत्रः born out of her body, विश्वकर्मणा Vishwakarma, सदृशः I am like him, एतेन by that, स्मारितःअस्मि I have put in my memory, महोदधिः great ocean, तत्त्वम् nature, आह I am aware, अनुक्तः I have not spoken, अहम् I, आत्मनः myself, गुणान् qualities, वः unless, नप्रब्रूयाम् will not speak, अहम् I, वरुणालये abode of Varuna, सेतुम् bridge, कर्तुम् will build, समर्थश्चापि am capable, कामम् required material, वानरपुङ्गवाः Vanara leaders, अद्यैव right away, सेतुम् for the bridge, बद्नन्तु for building.
explanation: "On the Mandara mountain Vishwakarma gave a boon to my mother. I am that Vishwakarma's own son, and I am like him at work by that cause. I have put in my memory all about the ocean. I am aware of the truth of the ocean. I could not speak of my qualities unless questioned. I can build a bridge over the abode of Varuna.Right away let the Vanara leaders get the material required for building the bridge (said Nala)."
hindi: ‘मैं महासागर पर पुल बाँधने में समर्थ हूँ, अतः सब वानर आज ही पुल बाँधने का कार्य आरम्भ कर दें

shloka_text: स्मारितोऽस्म्यहमेतेनतत्त्वमहामहोदधिः । काममद्वैवबध्नन्तुसेतुंवानरपुङ्गवाः ।।6.22.51।।
translation: मन्दरे on Mandara mountain, विश्वकर्मणा Vishwakarmana, मममातुः my mother, वरः boon, दत्तः has given, अहम् I, तस्य her, औरसःपुत्रः born out of her body, विश्वकर्मणा Vishwakarma, सदृशः I am like him, एतेन by that, स्मारितःअस्मि I have put in my memory, महोदधिः great ocean, तत्त्वम् nature, आह I am aware, अनुक्तः I have not spoken, अहम् I, आत्मनः myself, गुणान् qualities, वः unless, नप्रब्रूयाम् will not speak, अहम् I, वरुणालये abode of Varuna, सेतुम् bridge, कर्तुम् will build, समर्थश्चापि am capable, कामम् required material, वानरपुङ्गवाः Vanara leaders, अद्यैव right away, सेतुम् for the bridge, बद्नन्तु for building.
explanation: "On the Mandara mountain Vishwakarma gave a boon to my mother. I am that Vishwakarma's own son, and I am like him at work by that cause. I have put in my memory all about the ocean. I am aware of the truth of the ocean. I could not speak of my qualities unless questioned. I can build a bridge over the abode of Varuna.Right away let the Vanara leaders get the material required for building the bridge (said Nala)."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 22.50 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: ततो विसृष्टा रामेण सर्वतो हरियूथपाः । अभिपेतुर्महारण्यं हृष्टाश्शतसहस्रशः ।।6.22.52।।
translation: ततः then, रामेण by Rama, विसृष्टाः directed, रियूथपाः Vanara troop leaders, हृष्टाः gladly, शतसहस्रशः hundred thousand, महारण्यम् huge forest, सर्वतः all over, अभ्युत्पेतुः sprang up.
explanation: Then directed by Rama the Vanara troop leaders in hundreds and thousands sprang up gladly all over the huge forest.
hindi: तब भगवान् श्रीराम के भेजने से लाखों बड़े-बड़े वानर हर्ष और उत्साह में भरकर सब ओर उछलते हुए गये और बड़े-बड़े जंगलों में घुस गये

shloka_text: ते नगान्नगसङ्काशाश्शाखामृगगणर्षभाः । बभञ्जुः वानरास्तत्र प्रचकर्षुश्च सागरम् ।।6.22.53।।
translation: नगसङ्काशाः mountain like, ते those, शाखामृगगणर्षभाः bulls among Vanaras, तत there upon, नगान् from the mountain, पादपान् roots of trees, बभञ्जुः collected, सागरम् into the sea, प्रचकर्षुश्च started moving.
explanation: Mountain like bodied Vanara bulls there upon started collecting roots of trees from the foot of mountain and moved them into the sea.
hindi: वे पर्वत के समान विशालकाय वानरशिरोमणि पर्वतशिखरों और वृक्षों को तोड़ देते और उन्हें समुद्र तक खींच लाते थे

shloka_text: ते सालैश्चाश्वकर्णैश्च धवैशैश्च वानराः । कुटजैरर्जुनैस्तालैस्तिलकैस्न्तिशैरपि ।।6.22.54।।
translation: वानराः Vanaras, सालैश्च sala trees, अश्वकर्णैश्च as vakarna trees, धवैः dhava trees, वंशैश्च bamboo, कुटजैः kutaja, अर्जुनैः arjuna, तालैः palmira, तिलकैः tilaka, न्तिशैरपि trisaira, बिल्वकैः bilva, सप्तपर्णैश्च and saptaparni, पुष्पितैःकर्णिकारैः karnikara blossoms, चूतैश्च mango, अशोकवृक्षैश्च and ashoka trees, सागरम् into ocean, पर्यपूरयन् brought and dumped.
explanation: The Vanaras brought sala, asvakarna, dhava, bamboo, kutaja arjuna, palmira, tilaka, trisaira, bilva, saptaparni trees karnikara plants with blossoms, mango trees and ashoka trees and dumped into the ocean.
hindi: वे साल, अश्वकर्ण, धव, बाँस, कुटज, अर्जुन, ताल, तिलक, तिनिश, बेल, छितवन, खिले हुए कनेर, आम और अशोक आदि वृक्षों से समुद्र को पाटने लगे

shloka_text: बिल्वकैस्सप्तपर्णैश्च कर्णिकारैश्च सुपुष्पितैः । चूतैश्चाशोकवृक्षैश्च सागरं समपूरयन् ।।6.22.55।।
translation: वानराः Vanaras, सालैश्च sala trees, अश्वकर्णैश्च as vakarna trees, धवैः dhava trees, वंशैश्च bamboo, कुटजैः kutaja, अर्जुनैः arjuna, तालैः palmira, तिलकैः tilaka, न्तिशैरपि trisaira, बिल्वकैः bilva, सप्तपर्णैश्च and saptaparni, पुष्पितैःकर्णिकारैः karnikara blossoms, चूतैश्च mango, अशोकवृक्षैश्च and ashoka trees, सागरम् into ocean, पर्यपूरयन् brought and dumped.
explanation: The Vanaras brought sala, asvakarna, dhava, bamboo, kutaja arjuna, palmira, tilaka, trisaira, bilva, saptaparni trees karnikara plants with blossoms, mango trees and ashoka trees and dumped into the ocean.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 22.54 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: समूलांश्च विमूलांश्च पादपान् हरिसत्तमाः । इन्द्रकेतूनिवोद्यम्य प्रजह्रूर्वानरास्तरून् ।।6.22.56।।
translation: हरिसत्तमाः foremost of the Vanaras, समूलान् च along with the roots, विमूलान् च some without roots, पादपान् trees, इन्द्रकेतूनिव like Indra's flagstaff, उद्यम्य lifting up, प्रजह्रुः hurled, वानरास्तरून् Vanaras thrown down (into the sea)
explanation: Lifting some trees with roots and some without roots like the staff of Indra's flag, Vanaras hurled down the trees into the sea.
hindi: वे श्रेष्ठ वानर वहाँ के वृक्षों को जड़ से उखाड़ लाते या जड़ के ऊपर से भी तोड़ लाते थे। इन्द्रध्वज के समान ऊँचे-ऊँचे वृक्षों को उठाये लिये चले आते थे

shloka_text: ताळान दाडिमगुल्मांश्च नारिकेळन्विभीतकान् । वकुलान्कदिरान्निम्बान्समाजह्रुस्समन्ततः ।।6.22.57।।
translation: ताळान् palmira, दाडिमगुल्मांश्च dadima trees, नारिकेळविभीतकान् coconut trees, करीरान् karira, बकुलान् bakula, निम्बान् nimba, समन्ततः brought all of them, समाजह्रुः and dropped into the ocean.
explanation: They brought palmira, dadima, coconut, karira, bakula and nimba trees and dropped all of them into the ocean.
hindi: ताड़ों, अनार की झाड़ियों, नारियल और बहेड़े के वृक्षों, करीर, बकुल तथा नीम को भी इधर-उधर से तोड़-तोड़कर लाने लगे

shloka_text: हस्तिमतान्महाकायाः पाषाणांश्च महाबलाः । पर्वतांश्च समुत्पाट्य यन्स्सरैः परिवहन्ति च ।।6.22.58।।
translation: महाकायाः of huge body, महाबालाः strong, हस्तिमात्रान् like elephants, पाषाणान् stones, पर्वतांश्च mountains, समुत्पाट्य collecting and lifting up, यन्स्रैः by machines, परिवहन्तिच transported.
explanation: The Vanaras of huge body size and strong like elephants collected stones and mountains, lifted them, and transported into the sea.
hindi: महाकाय महाबली वानर हाथी के समान बड़ी-बड़ी शिलाओं और पर्वतों को उखाड़कर यन्त्रों (विभिन्न साधनों) द्वारा समुद्रतट पर ले आते थे

shloka_text: प्रक्षिप्यमाणैरचलैस्सहसा जलमुद्दृतम् । समुत्ससर्प आकाशमवासर्पत्ततस्ततः ।।6.22.59।।
translation: सहसा at once, प्रक्षिप्यमाणैः thrown up, अचलैः mountains, उद्दृतम् rose up, जलम् water, आकाशम् sky, समुत्ससर्प touched, ततः then, पुनः again, अवासर्पत् spread
explanation: At once the water threw up (by dropping the mountains) rose, touching the sky and spreading.
hindi: शिलाखण्डों को फेंकने से समुद्र का जल सहसा आकाश में उठ जाता और फिर वहाँ से नीचे को गिर जाता था

shloka_text: समुद्रं क्षोभयामासुर्वानराश्चस्समन्ततः । सूत्राण्यन्ये प्रगृह्णान्ति व्यायतं शतयोजनम् ।।6.22.60।।
translation: समन्ततः all over, निपतन्तः on account of throwing, समुद्रम् into the sea, क्षोभयामासुः stirred up, अन्ये others, शतयोजनम् a hundred yojanas, आयतम् breadth, सूत्राणि by rope, प्रगृह्णन्ति held.
explanation: On account of throwing into the sea it got stirred up Others held the rope over a hundred yojanas in breadth (to make it even).
hindi: उन वानरों ने सब ओर पत्थर गिराकर समुद्र में हलचल मचा दी। कुछ दूसरे वानर सौ योजन लंबा सूत पकड़े हुए थे

shloka_text: नलश्चक्रे महासेतुं मध्ये नदनदीपतेः । स तदा क्रियते सेतुर्वानरैर्घोरकर्मभिः ।।6.22.61।।
translation: नलः Nala, नदनदीपतेः Lord of rivers, मध्ये centre, महासेतुम् huge bridge, चक्रे started, तदा then, घोरकर्मभिः terrific task, वानरैः with Vanaras, सेतुः bridge, क्रियते built.
explanation: Nala started the task of building the huge bridge in the centre of the ocean with Vanaras.
hindi: नल नदों और नदियों के स्वामी समुद्र के बीचमें महान् सेतु का निर्माण कर रहे थे। भयंकर कर्म करने वाले वानरों ने  मिल-जुलकर उस समय सेतुनिर्माण का कार्य आरम्भ किया था

shloka_text: दण्डानन्ये प्रगृह्णन्ति विचिन्वन्ति तथापरे ।।6.22.62।।
translation: अन्ये others, दण्डान् sticks, प्रगृह्णन्ति holding, तथा in the same way, अपरे some others, विचिन्वन्ति following, रामस्य of Rama, आज्ञापुरस्सरैः the command in front, शतशः in hundreds, मेघाभिः like clouds, पर्वताग्रैश्च like top of mountains, वानरैः with Vanaras, तृणैः reeds, काष्ठैश्च logs of wood, बबन्धिरे built.
