translation: गजानाम् elephant riders, दशसाहस्रम् ten thousands, तथा similarly, रथानाम् charioteers, अयुतम् ten thousands, हयानाम् horse riders, द्वे, आयुते twenty thousand, रक्षसाम् foot soldiers, साग्रा more than, कोटिश्च one crore, संयुगेषु in wars, विक्रान्ताः valiant warriors, बलवन्तश्च mighty strong, आततायिनः endeavouring to kill, एते all, निशाचराः night rangers, नित्यम् always, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, इष्टाः dear.
explanation: "Elephant army of ten thousand, similarly ten thousand charioteers, horse riders in twenty thousand, more than a crore foot soldiers, mighty strong and valiant warriors, night ranger's beloved to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas were staying close and serving."
hindi: वे सभी बड़े वीर, बल-पराक्रम से सम्पन्न और युद्ध में आततायी हैं। ये सभी निशाचर राक्षसराज रावण को सदा ही प्रिय हैं

shloka_text: एकैकस्यात्र युद्धार्थे राक्षसस्य विशाम्पते । परीवारस्सहस्राणां सहस्रमुपतिष्ठते ।।6.37.18।।
translation: विशाम्पते Lord of men, अत्र there, एकस्य for one, राक्षसस्य Rakshasa, युद्धार्थे to assist in war, सहस्राणाम् thousands of, सहस्रम् thousands, परीवारः at the service, उपतिष्ठते are staying.
explanation: "O! Lord of men! For the sake of assisting one Rakshasa in war ten lakhs of Rakshasas are staying at his service."
hindi: ‘प्रजानाथ! इनमें से एक-एक राक्षस के पास युद्ध के लिये दस-दस लाख का परिवार उपस्थित है’

shloka_text: एतां प्रवृत्तिं लङ्कायां मन्त्रिप्रोक्तां विभीषणः । एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहू राक्षसांस्तानदर्शयत् ।।6.37.19।।
translation: महाबाहुः mighty armed, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, मन्त्रिप्रोक्तम् told by ministers, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, एताम् all this, प्रवृत्तिम् information, एनम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तान् he, राक्षसान् by Rakshasas, अदर्शयत् revealed.
explanation: Mighty armed Vibheeshana revealed to Rama all the information that was told to him by ministers.
hindi: महाबाहु विभीषण ने मन्त्रियों द्वारा बताये गये लङ्काविषयक समाचार को इस प्रकार बताकर उन मन्त्रीस्वरूप राक्षसों को भी श्रीराम से मिलाया और उनके द्वारा लङ्का का सारा वृत्तान्त पुनः उनसे कहलाया

shloka_text: लङ्कायां सचिवैस्सर्वं रामाय प्रत्यवेदयत् । रामं कमलपत्राक्षमिदमुत्तरमब्रवीत् ।।6.37.20।। रावणावरजः श्रीमान् रामप्रियचिकीर्षया ।
translation: श्रीमान् prosperous, रावणावरजः Ravana's brother, लङ्कायाम् about Lanka, सर्वम् everything, सचिवैः ministers, रामाय to Rama, प्रत्यवेदयत् having submitted, कमलपत्राक्षम् lotus eyed, रामम् Rama, रामप्रियचिकीर्षया intending to please Rama, इदम् this, उत्तरम् reply, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Again, Vibheeshana, the prosperous brother of Ravana, spoke to Rama everything about Lanka made known to him by the ministers. Vibheeshana looking at the lotus petal eyed Rama, intending to please Rama, spoke.
hindi: तदनन्तर रावण के छोटे भाई श्रीमान् विभीषण ने कमलनयन श्रीराम से उनका प्रिय करने के लिये स्वयं भी यह उत्तम बात कही—

shloka_text: कुबेरं तु यदा राम रावणः प्रत्ययुध्यत ।।6.37.21।।
translation: राम Rama, रावणः Ravana, यदा like that, कुबेरम् at Kubera, प्रत्ययुध्यत offensive, तदा then, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, षष्टिः sixty, शतसहस्राणि lakh, निर्यान्ति sallied forth, पराक्रमेण in courage, वीर्येण in valour, तेजसा brilliance, सत्त्वगौरवात् with respect, दर्पेण proud, यत्र there, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, सदृशाः befitting.
explanation: "Rama! Earlier when Ravana launched an offensive battle against Kubera, sixty thousand Rakshasas who were equal to him in valour, brilliance, courage, and with respect sallied forth the proud, the evil minded Ravana."
hindi: ‘श्रीराम! जब रावण ने कुबेर के साथ युद्ध किया था, उस समय साठ लाख राक्षस उसके साथ गये थे। वे सब-के-सब बल, पराक्रम, तेज, धैर्य की अधिकता और दर्प की दृष्टि से दुरात्मा रावण के ही समान थे

shloka_text: षष्टिश्शतसहस्राणि तदा निर्यान्ति रक्षसाः । राक्रमेण वीर्येण तेजसा सत्त्वगौरवात् ।।6.37.22।।
translation: राम Rama, रावणः Ravana, यदा like that, कुबेरम् at Kubera, प्रत्ययुध्यत offensive, तदा then, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, षष्टिः sixty, शतसहस्राणि lakh, निर्यान्ति sallied forth, पराक्रमेण in courage, वीर्येण in valour, तेजसा brilliance, सत्त्वगौरवात् with respect, दर्पेण proud, यत्र there, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, सदृशाः befitting.
explanation: "Rama! Earlier when Ravana launched an offensive battle against Kubera, sixty thousand Rakshasas who were equal to him in valour, brilliance, courage, and with respect sallied forth the proud, the evil minded Ravana."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 37.21 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: अत्र मन्युर्न कर्तव्योरोषये त्वां न भीषये ।।6.37.23।। समर्थो ह्यसि वीर्येण सुराणामपि निग्रहे ।
translation: अत्र here in this case, मन्युः indignation, नकर्तव्यः as my duty, त्वाम् to you, रोषये not to cause anger, नभीषये not to cause fear, वीर्येण in valour, सुराणाम् Devatas, निग्रहेऽपिमोल can resist, समर्थः capable, असिहि am telling.
explanation: "Here, in this case do not be angry. I am telling out of my duty and not out of indignation or to cause anger or fear in you. You are capable of resisting even Devatas."
hindi: ‘मैंने जो रावण की शक्ति का वर्णन किया है, इसको लेकर न तो आपको अपने मन में दीनता लानी चाहिये और न मुझ पर रोष ही करना चाहिये। मैं आपको डराता नहीं, शत्रु के प्रति आपके क्रोध को उभाड़ रहा हूँ; क्योंकि आप अपने बलपराक्रम द्वारा देवताओं का भी दमन करने में समर्थ हैं

shloka_text: तद्भवांश्चतुरङ्गेण बलेन महाता वृतः ।।6.37.24।। व्यूह्येदं वानरानीकं निर्मथिष्यति रावणम् ।
translation: तत् and also, भवान् you, इदम् these, वानरानीकम् army of Vanaras, व्यूह्य with, चतुरङ्गेणबलेन four kinds of army force, वृतः surrounded, रावणम् Ravana, निर्मथिष्यति crush.
explanation: "You also have these Vanara armies surrounded by four kinds of army, elephants, chariots, cavalry and foot soldiers."
hindi: ‘इसलिये आप इस वानरसेना का व्यूह बनाकर ही विशाल चतुरङ्गिणी सेना से घिरे हुए रावण का विनाश कर सकेंगे’

shloka_text: रावणावरजे वाक्यमेवं ब्रुवति राघवः ।।6.37.25।। शत्रूणां प्रतिघातार्थमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।
translation: रावणावरजे Ravana's younger brother, इति this way, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवति spoke, इति this, राघवः Raghava, शत्रूणाम् enemies, प्रतिघातार्थम् issued orders to attack, इदम् thus, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् had spoken
explanation: When Ravana's younger brother spoke in that way Raghava instructed the army to attack the enemy.
hindi: विभीषण के ऐसी बात कहने पर भगवान् श्रीराम ने शत्रुओं को परास्त करने के लिये इस प्रकार कहा-

shloka_text: पूर्वद्वारे तु लङ्काया नीलो वानरपुङ्गवः ।।6.37.26।। प्रहस्त प्रतियोद्धा स्याद्वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।
translation: लङ्कायाः at Lanka's, पूर्वद्वारे east gate, वानरपुङ्गवः Vanara leader, नीलः Neela, बहुभिः many more, वानरैः Vanaras, वृतः surrounded, प्रहस्तप्रतियोद्धा to Prahasta give fight, स्यात् with.
explanation: "Let the Vanara leader Neela along with Vanaras stay at the east gate of Lanka and give fight to Prahasta."
hindi: ‘बहुसंख्यक वानरों से घिरे हुए कपिश्रेष्ठ नील पूर्व द्वार पर जाकर प्रहस्त का सामना करें

shloka_text: अङ्गदो वालिपुत्रस्तु बलेन महता वृतः ।।6.37.27।। दक्षिणे बाधतां द्वारे महापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।
translation: वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, महता mighty, बलेन powerful, वृतः along with, दक्षिणेद्वारे south gate, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparsva and Mahodara, बाधताम् crush.
explanation: "Let Vali's son the mighty and powerful Angada along with army crush Mahaparsva and Mahodara at the south gate."
hindi: ‘विशाल वाहिनी से युक्त वालिकुमार अङ्गद दक्षिण द्वार पर स्थित हो महापार्श्व और महोदर के कार्य में बाधा दें

shloka_text: हनुमान्पश्चिमद्वारं निपीड्य पवनात्मजः ।।6.37.28।। प्रविशत्वप्रमेयात्मा बहुभिः कपिभिर्वृतः ।
translation: पवनात्मजः wind god's son, अप्रमेयात्मा of unimaginable prowess, हनुमान् Hanuman, बहुभिः numerous, कपिभिः Vanaras, वृतः surrounded by, पश्चिमद्वारम् west gate, निपीड्य pressing, प्रविशतु enter.
explanation: "Let Hanuman, the wind god's son of unimaginable prowess, enter the west gate along with numerous Vanaras and press against the enemy."
hindi: ‘पवनकुमार हनुमान् अप्रमेय आत्मबल से सम्पन्न हैं। ये बहुत-से वानरों के साथ लङ्का के पश्चिम फाटक में प्रवेश करें

shloka_text: दैत्यदावनसङ्घानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम् ।।6.37.29।।
translation: दैत्यदानवसङ्घानाम् multitude of Daityas and Danavas, महात्मनाम् great self, ऋषीणांच even sages, विप्रकारप्रियः fond of doing harm, क्षुद्रः wicked, वरदानबलान्वितः armed by the boons received, यः he, प्रजाः people, सन्तापयन् oppressing, सर्वान् all, लोकान् people, परिक्रामिति wandering, तस्य, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa leader, वधे destroy, अहम् I, स्वयमेव myself, धृतः determined, अहम् I, सौमित्रिणासह along with Lakshmana, सबलः along with army, रावणः Ravana, यत्र, उत्तरंनगरद्वारम् north gate, निपीड्य persecuting, अभिप्रवेक्ष्यामि force my entry into.
explanation: "That Ravana who is harming Daityas and Danavas, and great souls following wicked practices and armed by the boons is oppressing all people wandering all over. I, with Lakshmana, have determined to persecute and kill him and force my entry to the north gate."
hindi: ‘दैत्यों, दानवसमूहों तथा महात्मा ऋषियों का अपकार करना ही जिसे प्रिय लगता है, जिसका स्वभाव क्षुद्र है, जो वरदान की शक्ति से सम्पन्न है और प्रजाजनों को संताप देता हुआ सम्पूर्ण लोकों में घूमता रहता है, उस राक्षसराज रावण के वध का दृढ़ निश्चय लेकर मैं स्वयं ही सुमित्राकुमार लक्ष्मण के साथ नगर के उत्तर फाटक पर आक्रमण करके उसके भीतर प्रवेश करूँगा, जहाँ सेनासहित रावण विद्यमान है

shloka_text: विप्रकारप्रियः क्षुद्रो वरदानबलान्वितः । परिक्रमति यः सर्वान्लोकान्सन्तापयन्प्रजाः ।।6.37.30।।
translation: दैत्यदानवसङ्घानाम् multitude of Daityas and Danavas, महात्मनाम् great self, ऋषीणांच even sages, विप्रकारप्रियः fond of doing harm, क्षुद्रः wicked, वरदानबलान्वितः armed by the boons received, यः he, प्रजाः people, सन्तापयन् oppressing, सर्वान् all, लोकान् people, परिक्रामिति wandering, तस्य, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa leader, वधे destroy, अहम् I, स्वयमेव myself, धृतः determined, अहम् I, सौमित्रिणासह along with Lakshmana, सबलः along with army, रावणः Ravana, यत्र, उत्तरंनगरद्वारम् north gate, निपीड्य persecuting, अभिप्रवेक्ष्यामि force my entry into.
explanation: "That Ravana who is harming Daityas and Danavas, and great souls following wicked practices and armed by the boons is oppressing all people wandering all over. I, with Lakshmana, have determined to persecute and kill him and force my entry to the north gate."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 37.29 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: तस्याहं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य स्वयमेव वधे धृतः । उत्तरं नगरद्वारमहं सौमित्रिणा सह ।।6.37.31।।
translation: दैत्यदानवसङ्घानाम् multitude of Daityas and Danavas, महात्मनाम् great self, ऋषीणांच even sages, विप्रकारप्रियः fond of doing harm, क्षुद्रः wicked, वरदानबलान्वितः armed by the boons received, यः he, प्रजाः people, सन्तापयन् oppressing, सर्वान् all, लोकान् people, परिक्रामिति wandering, तस्य, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa leader, वधे destroy, अहम् I, स्वयमेव myself, धृतः determined, अहम् I, सौमित्रिणासह along with Lakshmana, सबलः along with army, रावणः Ravana, यत्र, उत्तरंनगरद्वारम् north gate, निपीड्य persecuting, अभिप्रवेक्ष्यामि force my entry into.
explanation: "That Ravana who is harming Daityas and Danavas, and great souls following wicked practices and armed by the boons is oppressing all people wandering all over. I, with Lakshmana, have determined to persecute and kill him and force my entry to the north gate."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 37.29 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: वानरेन्द्रश्च बलवानृक्षराजश्च वीर्यवान् ।।6.37.32।। राक्षसेन्द्रानुजश्चैव गुलो भवतु मध्यम: ।
translation: बलवान् mighty strong, वानरेन्द्रश्च Vanara king, वीर्यवान् valorous, ऋक्षराजश्च Rksharaja Jambavan, राक्षसेन्द्रानुजश्चैव and Ravana's brother, मध्यम: middle, गुलो of city, भवतु will remain.
explanation: "Mighty strong Sugriva, valorous Jambavan, the ruler of Vanaras and Vibheeshana, brother of Ravana will remain at the middle of Lanka and fight."
hindi: ‘बलवान् वानरराज सुग्रीव, रीछों के पराक्रमी राजा जाम्बवान् तथा राक्षसराज रावण के छोटे भाई विभीषण—ये लोग नगर के बीच के मोर्चे पर आक्रमण करें

shloka_text: न चैव मानुषं रूपं कार्यं हरिभिराहवे ।।6.37.33।। एषा भवतु संङञा न् युद्धेऽस्मिन् वानरे बले ।
translation: आहवे in battle, हरिभिः monkeys, मानुषं human, रूपम् form, नचैवम् not have, कार्यम् task, अस्मिन् our, युद्धे war, वानरे Vanaras, बले, एषा in that way, संज्ञा sign, भवतु let it be.
explanation: "In the battle like this at present Vanaras should not be in the semblance of humans. Let this be our sign."
hindi: ‘वानरों को युद्ध में मनुष्य का रूप नहीं धारण करना चाहिये। इस युद्ध में वानरों की सेना का हमारे लिये यही संकेत या चिह्न होगा

shloka_text: वानरा एव नश्चिह्नं स्वजनेऽस्मिन् भविष्यति ।।6.37.34।।
translation: अस्मिन् our, स्वजने own people, वानराःएव even Vanaras, नः not, चिह्नम् recognize, भविष्यति should be able to, महौजसौ very chivalrous, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, एषः similarly, अहम् I, आत्मना my own, पञ्चमः five of us, ममसखा our friends, अयम् our, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वयम् also, सप्तमानुषेणैव seven human forms, परान् enemies, योत्स्यामहे wage war.
explanation: "To know our own people the Vanaras are the sign of recognition Chivalrous Lakshmana, my brother, similarly five of us and our friend Vibheeshana, these seven people alone will wage war in human form."
hindi: ‘इस स्वजनवर्ग में वानर ही हमारे चिह्न होंगे। केवल हम सात व्यक्ति ही मनुष्यरूप में रहकर शत्रुओं के साथ युद्ध करेंगे

shloka_text: वयं तु मानुषेणैव सप्त योत्प्यामहे परान् । अहमे षमम भ्रात्रा लक्ष्मणेन महौजसौ ।।6.37.35।।
translation: अस्मिन् our, स्वजने own people, वानराःएव even Vanaras, नः not, चिह्नम् recognize, भविष्यति should be able to, महौजसौ very chivalrous, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, एषः similarly, अहम् I, आत्मना my own, पञ्चमः five of us, ममसखा our friends, अयम् our, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वयम् also, सप्तमानुषेणैव seven human forms, परान् enemies, योत्स्यामहे wage war.
explanation: "To know our own people the Vanaras are the sign of recognition Chivalrous Lakshmana, my brother, similarly five of us and our friend Vibheeshana, these seven people alone will wage war in human form."
hindi: ‘मैं अपने महातेजस्वी भाई लक्ष्मण के साथ रहूँगा और ये मेरे मित्र विभीषण अपने चार मन्त्रियों के साथ पाँचवें होंगे (इस प्रकार हम सात व्यक्ति मनुष्यरूप में रहकर युद्ध करेंगे)’

shloka_text: स रामः कृत्यसिध्यर्थएवमुक्त्वा विभीषणम् ।।6.37.36।।
translation: मतिमान् wise, मतिम् in mind, सःरामः that Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, सुवेलस्यगिरिः Suvela mountain, रमणीयतरम् beauty, तटम् slopes, दृष्टवा seeing, कृत्यसिध्यर्थम् for accomplishing the task, सुवेलारोहणे climb up, बुद्धिम् thought, चकार and went.
explanation: Wise Rama having spoken like that to Vibheeshana for accomplishing the task, looking at the beauty of Suvela mountain slopes, climbed up and went.
hindi: अपने विजयरूपी प्रयोजन की सिद्धि के लिये विभीषण से ऐसा कहकर बुद्धिमान् भगवान् श्रीराम ने सुवेल पर्वत पर चढ़ने का विचार किया। सुवेल पर्वत का तटप्रान्त बड़ा ही रमणीय था, उसे देखकर उन्हें बड़ी प्रसन्नता हुई

shloka_text: सुवेलारोहणे बुद्धिश्चकार मतिमान्मतिम् । रमणीयतरं दृष्टवा सुवेलस्य गिरेस्तटम् ।।6.37.37।।
translation: मतिमान् wise, मतिम् in mind, सःरामः that Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, सुवेलस्यगिरिः Suvela mountain, रमणीयतरम् beauty, तटम् slopes, दृष्टवा seeing, कृत्यसिध्यर्थम् for accomplishing the task, सुवेलारोहणे climb up, बुद्धिम् thought, चकार and went.
explanation: Wise Rama having spoken like that to Vibheeshana for accomplishing the task, looking at the beauty of Suvela mountain slopes, climbed up and went.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 37.36 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: ततस्तु रामो महता बलेन प्रच्छाद्य सर्वां पृथिवीं महात्मा । प्रहृष्टरूपोऽभिजगाम लङ्कां कृत्वा मतिं सोऽरिवधे महात्मा ।।6.37.38।।
translation: ततः तु and then, महात्मा the great-souled, रामः Rama, महता with his great, बलेन army, सर्वाम् the whole, पृथिवीम् earth, प्रच्छाद्य having covered, अरिवधे upon the slaying of his foe, मतिम् his mind, कृत्वा having set, प्रहृष्टरूपः joyful in aspect, सः he, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभिजगाम advanced upon
explanation: Then the great-souled Rama, having covered the whole earth with his great army and set his mind upon the slaying of his foe, advanced joyfully upon Lanka.
hindi: तदनन्तर महामना महात्मा श्रीराम अपनी विशाल सेना के द्वारा वहाँ की सारी पृथ्वी को आच्छादित करके शत्रुवध का निश्चय किये बड़े हर्ष और उत्साह से लङ्का की ओर चले

shloka_text: स तु कृत्वा सुवेलस्य मतिमारोहणं प्रति । लक्ष्मणानुगतो रामः सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.38.1।।
translation: लक्ष्मणानुगतः Lakshmana's wellwisher, सःरामः Rama, सुवेलस्य Suvela's, आरोहणंप्रति climbing, मतिम् in his mind, कृत्वा made up, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, धर्मज्ञम् righteous, अनुरक्तम् very affectionate, निशाचरम् night ranger, मन्त्रज्ञम् thinkercounsellor, विधिज्ञम् knower of right action, विभीषणंच and Vibheeshana, श्लक्क्ष्णया knower of facts (of Lanka), परया enemy, गिरा respectable, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Rama, the well wisher of Lakshmana climbing up the Suvela mountain thought in his mind and thus spoke to Sugriva and the righteous, affectionate Vibheeshana, a counsellor, knower of right action and facts of Lanka, and a respectable enemy.
comments: Sri Rama climbs up to Suvela mountain along with Lakshmana, Sugriva, Vibheeshana and surveys the city of Lanka from there. The Vanaras roar at the top of their voice and all of them spend the night on top of the Suvela mountain.
hindi: सुवेल पर्वत पर चढ़ने का विचार करके जिनके पीछे लक्ष्मणजी चल रहे थे, वे भगवान् श्रीराम सुग्रीव से और धर्म के ज्ञाता, मन्त्रवेत्ता, विधिज्ञ एवं अनुरागी निशाचर विभीषण से भी उत्तम एवं मधुर वाणी में बोले

shloka_text: विभीषणं च धर्मज्ञमनुरक्तं निशाचरम् । मन्त्रज्ञं च विधिज्ञं च श्लक्क्ष्णया परया गिरा ।।6.38.2।।
translation: लक्ष्मणानुगतः Lakshmana's wellwisher, सःरामः Rama, सुवेलस्य Suvela's, आरोहणंप्रति climbing, मतिम् in his mind, कृत्वा made up, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, धर्मज्ञम् righteous, अनुरक्तम् very affectionate, निशाचरम् night ranger, मन्त्रज्ञम् thinkercounsellor, विधिज्ञम् knower of right action, विभीषणंच and Vibheeshana, श्लक्क्ष्णया knower of facts (of Lanka), परया enemy, गिरा respectable, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Rama, the well wisher of Lakshmana climbing up the Suvela mountain thought in his mind and thus spoke to Sugriva and the righteous, affectionate Vibheeshana, a counsellor, knower of right action and facts of Lanka, and a respectable enemy.
comments: Sri Rama climbs up to Suvela mountain along with Lakshmana, Sugriva, Vibheeshana and surveys the city of Lanka from there. The Vanaras roar at the top of their voice and all of them spend the night on top of the Suvela mountain.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 38.1 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: सुवेलं साधु शैलेन्द्रमिमं धातुशतैश्चितम् । अध्यारोहामहे सर्वे वत्स्यामोऽत्र निशामिमाम् ।।6.38.3।।
translation: धातुशतैः hundreds of minerals, चितम् captivating, इमम् this, सुवेलंशैलेन्द्रम् Suvela mountain, साधु together, अध्यारोहामहे climb up, सर्वे all, इमाम् this, निशाम् night, अत्र there, वत्स्यामहे shall remain
explanation: "We shall all climb up this Suvela mountain captivating with hundreds of minerals and remain there tonight."
hindi: ‘मित्रो! यह पर्वतराज सुवेल सैकड़ों धातुओं से भलीभाँति भरा हुआ है। हम सब लोग इसपर चढ़ें और आज की इस रात में यहीं निवास करें

shloka_text: लङ्कां चालोकयिष्यामो निलयं तस्य रक्षसः । येन मे मरणान्ताय हृता भार्या दुरात्मना ।।6.38.4।।
translation: दुरात्मना evil minded, येन by whom, मरणान्ताय to end with death, मे I, भार्या wife, हृता stolen, येन by whom, धर्मः righteous duty, नविज्ञातः not know, वृत्तम् turned round, न not, तथा similarly, कुलम् race, न not, येन by whom, नीचया lowly, राक्षस्याबुध्या Rakshasa mentality, गर्हितम् immoral, तत् him, कृतम् done, तस्यरक्षसः his Rakshasa, निलयम् abode, लङ्काम् Lanka, आलोकयिष्यामःच and also see.
explanation: "We shall see Lanka the abode of Rakshasa by whom, who is evil minded as he is to face death, has stolen my consort not knowing, who turned away from righteous duty not knowing the race with lowly Rakshasa mentality, who is immoral."
hindi: ‘यहाँ से हमलोग उस राक्षस की निवासभूत लङ्कापुरी का भी अवलोकन करेंगे, जिस दुरात्मा ने अपनी मृत्यु के लिये ही मेरी भार्या का अपहरण किया है

shloka_text: येन धर्मो न विज्ञातो न तद्वृत्तं न कुलं तथा । राक्षस्या नीचया बुद् ध्या येन तद्गर्हितं कृतम् ।।6.38.5।।
translation: दुरात्मना evil minded, येन by whom, मरणान्ताय to end with death, मे I, भार्या wife, हृता stolen, येन by whom, धर्मः righteous duty, नविज्ञातः not know, वृत्तम् turned round, न not, तथा similarly, कुलम् race, न not, येन by whom, नीचया lowly, राक्षस्याबुध्या Rakshasa mentality, गर्हितम् immoral, तत् him, कृतम् done, तस्यरक्षसः his Rakshasa, निलयम् abode, लङ्काम् Lanka, आलोकयिष्यामःच and also see.
explanation: "We shall see Lanka the abode of Rakshasa by whom, who is evil minded as he is to face death, has stolen my consort not knowing, who turned away from righteous duty not knowing the race with lowly Rakshasa mentality, who is immoral."
hindi: ‘जिसने न तो धर्म को जाना है, न सदाचार को ही कुछ समझा है और न कुल का ही विचार किया है; केवल राक्षसोचित नीच बुद्धि के कारण ही वह निन्दित कर्म किया है

shloka_text: तस्मिन्मे वर्तते रोषः कीर्तिते राक्षसाधमे । यस्यापराधाननीचस्य वधं द्रक्ष्यामि रक्षसाम् ।।6.38.6।।
translation: नीचस्य mean, यस्य his, अपराधात् mistakes, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वधम् terminate, द्रक्ष्यामि perceive, तस्मिन् his, राक्षसाधमे lowly Rakshasa, कीर्तितेसति mention of name, मे my, रोषः wrath, वर्तते aroused.
explanation: "My wrath is aroused by the mention of the name of lowly Rakshasa. Because of his mistakes all Rakshasas are to be exterminated now."
hindi: ‘उस नीच राक्षस का नाम लेते ही उस पर मेरा रोष जाग उठता है। केवल उसी अधम निशाचर के अपराध से मैं समस्त राक्षसों का वध देलूँगा

shloka_text: एको हि कुरुते पापं कालपाशवशं गतः । नीचेनात्मापचारेण कुलं तेन विनश्यति ।।6.38.7।।
translation: एकः one alone, कालपाशवशम् fallen into the noose of death, गतः gone, पापम् sin, कुरुतेहि has done also, नीचेन meanly, तेन because of that, आत्मापचारेण because of his own mistake, कुलम् race, विनश्यति will perish.
explanation: "Only one has done that sin and fallen into the noose of death. Because of one Rakshasa's mistake the race will perish."
hindi: ‘काल के पाश में बँधा हुआ एक ही पुरुष पाप करता है, किंतु उस नीच के अपने ही दोष से सारा कुल नष्ट हो जाता है’

shloka_text: एवं सम्मन्त्रयन्नेव सक्रोधो रावणं प्रति । रामः सुवेल मासाद्य चित्रसानुमुपारुहत् ।।6.38.8।।
translation: रावणंप्रति about Ravana, सक्रोधः anger, रामः Rama, एवम् in that manner, सम्मन्त्रयन्नेन talking about, चित्रसानुम् captivating slopes, सुवेलम् of Suvela, आसाद्य climbed, उपारुहत् to rest there.
explanation: Talking about Ravana in that manner, Rama climbed the captivating slopes of Suvela to rest there.
hindi: इस प्रकार चिन्तन करते हुए ही श्रीराम रावण के प्रति कुपित हो विचित्र शिखरवाले सुवेल पर्वत पर निवास करने के लिये चढ़ गये

shloka_text: पृष्ठतो लक्ष्मणश्चैवमन्वगच्छत्समाहितः । सशरं चापमुद्यम्य सुमहद्विक्रमे रतः ।।6.38.9।। अन्वारोहत्सुग्रीवस्सामात्यस्सविभीषणः ।
translation: विक्रमे heroic, रतः showing, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana too, समाहितः reached, सशरम् , सुमहत् great, चापम् bow, उद्यम्य holding, एवम् likewise, पृष्ठतः alert, अन्वगच्छत् followed, सामात्यः his ministers, सविभीषणः and Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तम् and, अन्वारोहत् followed.
explanation: Heroic and alert Lakshmana also holding his great bow, followed. His ministers and Vibheeshana and Sugriva also followed him up.
hindi: उनके पीछे लक्ष्मण भी महान् पराक्रम में तत्पर एवं एकाग्रचित्त हो धनुष-बाण लिये हुए उस पर्वत पर आरूढ़ हो गये

shloka_text: हनुमानङ्गदो नीलो मैन्दो द्विविद एव च ।।6.38.10।।
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, अङ्गदः Angada, नीलः Neela, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविद Dwivida, एव so also, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पनसः Panasa, कुमुदश्चैव and Kumuda, हरः Hara, यूथपः heroes, रम्भश्च Rambhu, जाम्बवांश्च Jambhavan, सुषेणश्च Sushena, महामतिः intelligent, ऋषभश्च and Rshabha, महातेजाः highly energetic, दुर्मुखश्च Durmukha, कपिः monkeys, शतवलिः Satavali, एतेच and more, शीघ्रगामिनः swift footed, गिरिचारिणः mountain rangers, वायुवेगप्रवणाः who can move at wind speed, ते all of them, वानराः Vanaras, शतशः in hundreds, राघवः Raghava, यत्र there, तम् that, सुवेलंगिरिम् Suvela mountain, अध्यारोहन्त ascended.
explanation: Hanuman, Angada, Neela, Mainda, Dwivida, Gandhamadana, Panasa, Kumuda, Hara. Rambhu, Jambhavan, Sushena, intelligent Rshaba, highly energetic Durmukha and Satavali and similarly swift footed Vanaras, mountain rangers and those who can move at wind speed, all of them in hundreds ascended the Suvela mountain following Rama.
hindi: तत्पश्चात् सुग्रीव, मन्त्रियोंसहित विभीषण, हनुमान्, अङ्गद, नील, मैन्द, द्विविद, गज, गवाक्ष, गवय, शरभ, गन्धमादन, पनस, कुमुद, हर, यूथपति रम्भ, जाम्बवान्, सुषेण, महामति ऋषभ, महातेजस्वी दुर्मुख तथा कपिवर शतवलि—ये और दूसरे भी बहुत-से शीघ्रगामी वानर जो वायु के समान वेग से चलने वाले तथा पर्वतों पर ही विचरने वाले थे, उस सुवेलगिरि पर चढ़ गये

shloka_text: गजो गवाक्षो गवयश्शरभो गन्धमादनः । पनसः कुमुदश्चैव हरो रम्भश्च यूथपः ।।6.38.11।।
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, अङ्गदः Angada, नीलः Neela, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविद Dwivida, एव so also, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पनसः Panasa, कुमुदश्चैव and Kumuda, हरः Hara, यूथपः heroes, रम्भश्च Rambhu, जाम्बवांश्च Jambhavan, सुषेणश्च Sushena, महामतिः intelligent, ऋषभश्च and Rshabha, महातेजाः highly energetic, दुर्मुखश्च Durmukha, कपिः monkeys, शतवलिः Satavali, एतेच and more, शीघ्रगामिनः swift footed, गिरिचारिणः mountain rangers, वायुवेगप्रवणाः who can move at wind speed, ते all of them, वानराः Vanaras, शतशः in hundreds, राघवः Raghava, यत्र there, तम् that, सुवेलंगिरिम् Suvela mountain, अध्यारोहन्त ascended.
explanation: Hanuman, Angada, Neela, Mainda, Dwivida, Gandhamadana, Panasa, Kumuda, Hara. Rambhu, Jambhavan, Sushena, intelligent Rshaba, highly energetic Durmukha and Satavali and similarly swift footed Vanaras, mountain rangers and those who can move at wind speed, all of them in hundreds ascended the Suvela mountain following Rama.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 38.10 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: जाम्बवांश्च सुषेणश्च ऋषभश्च महामतिः । दुर्मुखश्च महातेजास्तथा शतवलिः कपिः ।।6.38.12।।
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, अङ्गदः Angada, नीलः Neela, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविद Dwivida, एव so also, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पनसः Panasa, कुमुदश्चैव and Kumuda, हरः Hara, यूथपः heroes, रम्भश्च Rambhu, जाम्बवांश्च Jambhavan, सुषेणश्च Sushena, महामतिः intelligent, ऋषभश्च and Rshabha, महातेजाः highly energetic, दुर्मुखश्च Durmukha, कपिः monkeys, शतवलिः Satavali, एतेच and more, शीघ्रगामिनः swift footed, गिरिचारिणः mountain rangers, वायुवेगप्रवणाः who can move at wind speed, ते all of them, वानराः Vanaras, शतशः in hundreds, राघवः Raghava, यत्र there, तम् that, सुवेलंगिरिम् Suvela mountain, अध्यारोहन्त ascended.
explanation: Hanuman, Angada, Neela, Mainda, Dwivida, Gandhamadana, Panasa, Kumuda, Hara. Rambhu, Jambhavan, Sushena, intelligent Rshaba, highly energetic Durmukha and Satavali and similarly swift footed Vanaras, mountain rangers and those who can move at wind speed, all of them in hundreds ascended the Suvela mountain following Rama.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 38.10 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: एते चान्ये च बहवो वानराश शीघ्रगामिनः । ते वायुवेगप्रवणास्तं गिरि गिरिचारिणः ।।6.38.13।।
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, अङ्गदः Angada, नीलः Neela, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविद Dwivida, एव so also, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पनसः Panasa, कुमुदश्चैव and Kumuda, हरः Hara, यूथपः heroes, रम्भश्च Rambhu, जाम्बवांश्च Jambhavan, सुषेणश्च Sushena, महामतिः intelligent, ऋषभश्च and Rshabha, महातेजाः highly energetic, दुर्मुखश्च Durmukha, कपिः monkeys, शतवलिः Satavali, एतेच and more, शीघ्रगामिनः swift footed, गिरिचारिणः mountain rangers, वायुवेगप्रवणाः who can move at wind speed, ते all of them, वानराः Vanaras, शतशः in hundreds, राघवः Raghava, यत्र there, तम् that, सुवेलंगिरिम् Suvela mountain, अध्यारोहन्त ascended.
explanation: Hanuman, Angada, Neela, Mainda, Dwivida, Gandhamadana, Panasa, Kumuda, Hara. Rambhu, Jambhavan, Sushena, intelligent Rshaba, highly energetic Durmukha and Satavali and similarly swift footed Vanaras, mountain rangers and those who can move at wind speed, all of them in hundreds ascended the Suvela mountain following Rama.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 38.10 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: ते त्वदीर्घेण कालेन गिरिमारुह्य सर्वतः ।।6.38.14।। ददृशुश शिखरे तस्य विषक्तामिव खे पुरीम् ।
translation: तेतु and they, अदीर्घेण short, कालेन time, सर्वतः all, गिरिम् mountain, आरुह्य ascended, तस्य its, शिखरे peak, खे sky, विषक्तामिव like a closely clinging, पुरीम् city, ददृशुः saw.
explanation: All of them in no time ascended the mountain peak and saw the city of Lanka which was as if clinging closely to the sky and hanging.
hindi: सुवेल पर्वत पर जहाँ श्रीरघुनाथजी विराजमान थे, वे सैकड़ों वानर थोड़ी ही देर में चढ़ गये और चढ़कर सब ओर विचरने लगे

shloka_text: तां शुभां प्रवरद्वारां प्राकारपरिशोभिताम् ।।6.38.15।। लङ्कां राक्षससम्पूर्णां ददृशुर्हरियूथपाः ।
translation: हरियूथपाः Vanara heroes, प्रवरद्वाराम् beautiful gateways, प्राकारपरिशोभिताम् captivating boundaries, राक्षससम्पूर्णाम् filled with Rakshasas, शुभाम् auspicious, तांलङ्काम् that Lanka, ददृशुः witnessed.
explanation: The vanara heroes witnessed beautiful gateways, captivating boundaries of auspicious Lanka filled all over with rakshasas.
hindi: उन वानर-यूथपतियों ने सुवेलपर्वत के शिखर पर खड़े हो उस सुन्दर लङ्कापुरी का निरीक्षण किया, जो आकाश में ही बनी हुई-सी जान पड़ती थी। उसके फाटक बड़े मनोहर थे। उत्तम परकोटे उस नगरी की शोभा बढ़ाते थे तथा वह पुरी राक्षसों से भरी-पूरी थी

shloka_text: प्राकारवरसंस्थैश्च तथा नीलैश्च राक्षसैः ।।6.38.16।। ददृशुस्ते हरिश्रेष्ठाः प्राकारमपरं कृतम् ।
translation: प्राकारवरसंस्थैः stood like boundary, तथा like that, नीलैश्च dark, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, कृतम् formed, अपरम् another, प्राकारम् boundary, ते they, हरिश्रेष्ठाः best of Vanaras, ददृशुः saw.
explanation: The best of vanaras saw dark coloured rakshasas who stood like another boundary in a row.
hindi: उत्तम परकोटों पर खड़े हुए नीलवर्ण के राक्षस ऐसे जान पड़ते थे, मानो उन परकोटों पर दूसरा परकोटा बना दिया गया हो। उन श्रेष्ठ वानरों ने वह सब कुछ देखा

shloka_text: ते दृष्टवा वानराः सर्वे राक्षसान् युद्धकाङ् क्षिणः ।।6.38.17।। मुमुचुर्विविधान्नादांतत्र रामस्य पश्यतः ।
translation: सर्वे all, तेवानराः the Vanaras, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः eager for war, राक्षसान् दृष्टवा seeing the Rakshasas, तस्य them, रामस्य Rama, पश्यतः saw, विविधान् many, नादान् clamours, मुमुचुः stood looking.
explanation: All the vanaras saw the rakshasas eager for war, and as Rama stood looking at them many kinds of clamours were heard.
hindi: युद्ध की इच्छा रखने वाले राक्षसों को देखकर वे सब वानर श्रीराम के देखते-देखते नाना प्रकार से सिंहनाद करने लगे

shloka_text: ततोऽस्तमगमत्पूर्यः सन्ध्यया प्रतिरञ्जितः ।।6.38.18।। पूर्णचन्द्रप्रदीप्ता च क्षपा समभिवर्तते ।
translation: ततः thereafter, सूर्यः sun, सन्ध्यया twilight, प्रतिरञ्जितः reddened, अस्तम् sun set, आगमत् had set in, पूर्णचन्द्रप्रदीप्ता full moon shining, क्षपाच dazzling, समभिवर्तते night set in duly.
explanation: Thereafter the Sun had set in, and twilight reddened. Full moon started shining as night had set in.
hindi: तदनन्तर संध्या की लाली से रंगे हुए सूर्यदेव अस्ताचल को चले गये और पूर्णचन्द्रमा से प्रकाशित उजेली रात वहाँ सब ओर छा गयी

shloka_text: ततस्स रामो हरिवाहिनीपतिर्विभीषणेन प्रतिनन्द्य सत्कृतः । सलक्ष्मणो यूथपयूथसम्वृतस्सुवेलपृष्ठे न्यवसद्यथासुखम् ।।6.38.19।।
translation: ततः then, सलक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सः he, रामः Rama, यूथपयूथसम्वृतः surrounded by Vanara heroes, हरिवाहिनीपतिः leader of ocean of monkey troops, विभीषणेन to Vibheeshana, प्रतिनन्द्य offered prayers, सत्कृतः having, सुवेलपृष्ठे Suvela peak, यथासुखम् happily, न्यवसत् rested.
explanation: Thereafter, Rama, the leader of Vanara troops happily rested on Suvela peak after Vibheeshana and Lakshmana duly offered their prayers. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टात्रिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
hindi: तत्पश्चात् विभीषण द्वारा सादर सम्मानित हो वानरसेना के स्वामी श्रीराम ने अपने भाई लक्ष्मण और यूथपतियों के समुदाय के साथ सुवेल पर्वत के पृष्ठभाग पर सुखपूर्वक निवास किया

shloka_text: तां रात्रिमुषितास्तत्र सुवेले हरिपुङ्गवाः । लङ्कायां ददृशुर्वीरा वनान्युपवनानि च ।।6.39.1।।
translation: वीराः heroic, हरिपुङ्गवाः leader of monkeys, तत्र there, सुवेले on the Suvela, ताम् on that, रात्रिम् night, उषिताः kept awake, लङ्कायाम् Lanka, वनानि forests, उपवनानिच and gardens, ददृशः saw.
explanation: The heroic leader of the monkeys kept awake that night on the Suvela and saw forests and gardens there in Lanka.
comments: Sri Rama keeps awake with others and observes the forests, beautiful gardens, parks, and palaces of Lanka from the top of Suvela mountain.
hindi: वानर-यूथपतियों ने वह रात उस सुवेल पर्वत पर ही बितायी और वहाँ से उन वीरों ने लङ्का के वन और उपवन भी देखे

shloka_text: समसौम्यानि रम्याणि विशालान्यायतानि च । दृष्टिरम्याणि ते दृष्टवा बभूवुर्जातविस्मयाः ।।6.39.2।।
translation: ते they, समसौम्यानि even terrain with, रम्याणि beautiful, विशालानि expansive, आयतानिच long and continuous sanctuary, दृष्टिरम्याणि feast to the eyes, दृष्टवा on seeing, जातविस्मयाः lovely to look at, बभूवुः amazed.
explanation: They were amazed to see the even terrain, beautiful and expansive, long, and continuous sanctuary lovely to look at being a feast to the eyes.
hindi: वे बड़े ही चौरस, शान्त, सुन्दर, विशाल और विस्तृत थे तथा देखने में अत्यन्त रमणीय जान पड़ते थे। उन्हें देखकर उन सब वानरों को बड़ा विस्मय हुआ

shloka_text: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला । तमालवनसञ्छन्ना नागमालासमावृता ।।6.39.3।।
translation: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला Champaka Asoka Punnaga Sala Tala Samala trees, तमालवनसञ्छन्ना Tamala forest concealed, नागमालासमावृता surrounded with Nagamala trees, लङ्काम् in Lanka, समन्ततः all over, हिन्तालैः Hintala, अर्जुनैः Arjuna, नीपैः Neepa, सुपुष्पितैः in full bloom, सप्तपर्णैः Saptaparni, तिलकैः Tilaka, कर्णिकारैश्च karnakara, पाटलैः Patala, पुष्पिताग्रैः crests laden with flowers, लतापरिगतद्रुमैः intertwined with creepers, विचित्रकुसुमोपेतैः wonderful variety of flowers, रक्तकोमलपल्लवैः clothed with red tender leaves, दिव्यैः wonderful, बहुविधैः of diverse kind, तथा similarly, नीलैः Neela, शाद्वलैः sadala, चित्राभिः colourful, वनराजिभिः king of forest, इन्द्रस्य Indra's capital, अमरावतीइव like Amaravathi, शुशुभे shining.
explanation: Thickly covered with trees like Champaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Sala, Tala, Samala and Tamala trees concealing the woods, surrounded with Nagamala trees all over  and Hintala, Arjuna and Neepa in full bloom, Saptaparni, Tilaka, Karnakara and Patala trees with crests laden with flowers, intertwined with creepers and wonderful variety of flowers trees with tender red leaves as if clothe d in red, flowers of diverse kind and similarly colourful Neela and Sadala as king of forest, it was shining like Amaravathi, capital of Indra.
hindi: चम्पा, अशोक, बकुल, शाल और ताल-वृक्षों से व्याप्त, तमाल-वन से आच्छादित और नागकेसरों से आवृत लङ्कापुरी हिंताल, अर्जुन, नीप (कदम्ब), खिले हुए छितवन, तिलक,कनेर तथा पाटल आदि नाना प्रकार के दिव्य वृक्षों से जिनके अग्रभाग फूलों के भार से लदे थे तथा जिनपर लताबल्लरियाँ फैली हुई थीं, इन्द्र की अमरावती के समान शोभा पाती थी

shloka_text: हिन्तालैरर्जुनैर्नीपैस्सप्तपर्णै श्चपुष्पितैः । तिलकैः कर्णिकारैश्च पाटलैश्च समन्ततः ।।6.39.4।।
translation: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला Champaka Asoka Punnaga Sala Tala Samala trees, तमालवनसञ्छन्ना Tamala forest concealed, नागमालासमावृता surrounded with Nagamala trees, लङ्काम् in Lanka, समन्ततः all over, हिन्तालैः Hintala, अर्जुनैः Arjuna, नीपैः Neepa, सुपुष्पितैः in full bloom, सप्तपर्णैः Saptaparni, तिलकैः Tilaka, कर्णिकारैश्च karnakara, पाटलैः Patala, पुष्पिताग्रैः crests laden with flowers, लतापरिगतद्रुमैः intertwined with creepers, विचित्रकुसुमोपेतैः wonderful variety of flowers, रक्तकोमलपल्लवैः clothed with red tender leaves, दिव्यैः wonderful, बहुविधैः of diverse kind, तथा similarly, नीलैः Neela, शाद्वलैः sadala, चित्राभिः colourful, वनराजिभिः king of forest, इन्द्रस्य Indra's capital, अमरावतीइव like Amaravathi, शुशुभे shining.
explanation: Thickly covered with trees like Champaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Sala, Tala, Samala and Tamala trees concealing the woods, surrounded with Nagamala trees all over  and Hintala, Arjuna and Neepa in full bloom, Saptaparni, Tilaka, Karnakara and Patala trees with crests laden with flowers, intertwined with creepers and wonderful variety of flowers trees with tender red leaves as if clothe d in red, flowers of diverse kind and similarly colourful Neela and Sadala as king of forest, it was shining like Amaravathi, capital of Indra.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 39.3 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: शुशुभे पुष्पिताग्रैश्च लतापरिगतैर्द्रुमैः । लङ्का बहुविधैर्दिव्यैर्यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती ।।6.39.5।।
translation: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला Champaka Asoka Punnaga Sala Tala Samala trees, तमालवनसञ्छन्ना Tamala forest concealed, नागमालासमावृता surrounded with Nagamala trees, लङ्काम् in Lanka, समन्ततः all over, हिन्तालैः Hintala, अर्जुनैः Arjuna, नीपैः Neepa, सुपुष्पितैः in full bloom, सप्तपर्णैः Saptaparni, तिलकैः Tilaka, कर्णिकारैश्च karnakara, पाटलैः Patala, पुष्पिताग्रैः crests laden with flowers, लतापरिगतद्रुमैः intertwined with creepers, विचित्रकुसुमोपेतैः wonderful variety of flowers, रक्तकोमलपल्लवैः clothed with red tender leaves, दिव्यैः wonderful, बहुविधैः of diverse kind, तथा similarly, नीलैः Neela, शाद्वलैः sadala, चित्राभिः colourful, वनराजिभिः king of forest, इन्द्रस्य Indra's capital, अमरावतीइव like Amaravathi, शुशुभे shining.
explanation: Thickly covered with trees like Champaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Sala, Tala, Samala and Tamala trees concealing the woods, surrounded with Nagamala trees all over  and Hintala, Arjuna and Neepa in full bloom, Saptaparni, Tilaka, Karnakara and Patala trees with crests laden with flowers, intertwined with creepers and wonderful variety of flowers trees with tender red leaves as if clothe d in red, flowers of diverse kind and similarly colourful Neela and Sadala as king of forest, it was shining like Amaravathi, capital of Indra.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 39.3 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: विचित्रकुसुमोपेतै रक्तकोमलपल्लवैः । शाद्वलैश्च तथा नीपैश्चित्राभिर्वनराजिभिः ।।6.39.6।।
translation: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला Champaka Asoka Punnaga Sala Tala Samala trees, तमालवनसञ्छन्ना Tamala forest concealed, नागमालासमावृता surrounded with Nagamala trees, लङ्काम् in Lanka, समन्ततः all over, हिन्तालैः Hintala, अर्जुनैः Arjuna, नीपैः Neepa, सुपुष्पितैः in full bloom, सप्तपर्णैः Saptaparni, तिलकैः Tilaka, कर्णिकारैश्च karnakara, पाटलैः Patala, पुष्पिताग्रैः crests laden with flowers, लतापरिगतद्रुमैः intertwined with creepers, विचित्रकुसुमोपेतैः wonderful variety of flowers, रक्तकोमलपल्लवैः clothed with red tender leaves, दिव्यैः wonderful, बहुविधैः of diverse kind, तथा similarly, नीलैः Neela, शाद्वलैः sadala, चित्राभिः colourful, वनराजिभिः king of forest, इन्द्रस्य Indra's capital, अमरावतीइव like Amaravathi, शुशुभे shining.
explanation: Thickly covered with trees like Champaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Sala, Tala, Samala and Tamala trees concealing the woods, surrounded with Nagamala trees all over  and Hintala, Arjuna and Neepa in full bloom, Saptaparni, Tilaka, Karnakara and Patala trees with crests laden with flowers, intertwined with creepers and wonderful variety of flowers trees with tender red leaves as if clothe d in red, flowers of diverse kind and similarly colourful Neela and Sadala as king of forest, it was shining like Amaravathi, capital of Indra.
hindi: विचित्र फूलों से युक्त लाल कोमल पल्लवों, हरी हरी घासों तथा विचित्र वनश्रेणियों से भी उस पुरी की बड़ी शोभा हो रही थी

shloka_text: गन्धाढ्यान्यभिरम्याणि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च । धारयन्त्यगमास्तत्र भूषणानीव मानवाः ।।6.39.7।।
translation: तत्र there, अगमाः having reached, गन्धाढ्यानि bore fragrance, अभिरम्याणि very beautiful, पुष्पाणिच flowers, फलानिच and fruits, मानवाः humans, भूषणानीव ornaments, धारयतनि as though wearing.
explanation: Having reached there where trees bore fragrance, very beautiful flowers and fruits seemed as though humans were wearing ornaments.
hindi: जैसे मनुष्य आभूषण धारण करते हैं, उसी प्रकार वहाँ के वृक्ष सुगन्धित फूल और अत्यन्त रमणीय फल धारण करते थे

shloka_text: तच्चैत्ररथसङ्काशं मनोज्ञं नन्दनोपमम् । वनं सर्वरर्तुकं रम्यं शुशुभे षटपदायुतम् ।।6.39.8।।
translation: चैत्ररथसङ्काशम् with chaitra chariot, मनोज्ञम् delightful to the mind, नन्दनोपमम् like Nandana garden of Indra, सर्वर्तुकम् green in all seasons, षटपदायुतम् filled with bees, तत् that, वनम् garden, शुशुभे very wonderful.
explanation: Appearing like the chaitra chariot of Kubera, Nandana garden of Indra, green in all seasons filled with bees, the garden was a wonderful delight.
hindi: चैत्ररथ और नन्दनवन के समान वहाँ का मनोहर वन सभी ऋतुओं में भ्रमरों से व्याप्त हो रमणीय शोभा धारण करता था

shloka_text: नत्यूहकोयष्टिमकैर्नृत्यमानैश्च बर्हिभि । रुतं परभृतानां च शुश्रुवुर्वन्निर्झरे ।।6.39.9।।
translation: वन्निर्झरे abounding in cascades, नात्यूहकोयष्टिभकैः gallinules lapwings herons, नृत्यमानैः dancing, बर्हिणैः peacocks, परभृतानाम् cuckoos, रुतम् च and singing, शुश्रुवे heard.
explanation: The Vanaras heard the singing of cuckoos, dancing of peacocks, crying of gallinules, lapwings and herons from the gardens abounding in cascades.
hindi: दात्यूह, कोयष्टि, बक और नाचते हुए मोर उस वन को सुशोभित करते थे। वन में झरनों के आसपास कोकिल की कूक सुनायी पड़ती थी

shloka_text: नित्यमत्तविहङ्गानि भ्रमराचरितानि च । कोकिलाकुलषण्डानि विहगाभिरुतानि च ।।6.39.10।।
translation: ततः thereafter, ते they, हृष्टाः joyful, प्रमुदिताः happily, वीराः heroes, कामरूपिणः who can change form at will, हरयः monkeys, नित्यमत्तविहङ्गानि inhabited by birds ever heated with emotion, भ्रमराचरितानिच wandering bees, कोकिराकुलखण्डानि clusters of trees covered with cuckoos, विहङ्गाभिरुतानिच rendered noisy by birds singing, भृङ्गराजाधिगीतानि resounded with the singing of large black bees, भ्रमरैस्सेवितानिच bees clinging, कोणालकविघुष्टानि mingled sound of various birds, सारसाभिरुतानि noise of cries of cranes, तानि all that, वनानि woods, उपवनानिच and gardens, विविशुः entered.
explanation: There after the rejoiced heroic Vanaras who can change their form at will happily entered the woods and gardens inhabited by birds in heat full of emotion, trees covered with cuckoos, and wandering bees, rendered noisy by birds, resounded with the singing of large black bees and bees going around clinging to trees, mingled with sounds of various birds and noise of cries of cranes.
hindi: लङ्का के वन और उपवन नित्य मतवाले विहङ्गमों से विभूषित थे। वहाँ वृक्षों की डालियों पर भौरे मँडराते रहते थे। उनके प्रत्येक खण्ड में कोकिलाएँ कुहू कुहू बोला करती थीं। पक्षी चहचहाते रहते थे। भृङ्गराज के गीत मुखरित होते थे। कुरर के शब्द गूंजा करते थे। कोणालक के कलरव होते रहते थे तथा सारसों की स्वरलहरी सब ओर छायी रहती थी। कुछ वानरवीर उन वनों और उपवनों में घुस गये

shloka_text: भृङ्गराजाभिगीतानि भ्रमरैस्सेवितानि च । कोणालकविघुष्टानि सारसाभिरुतानि च ।।6.39.11।।
translation: ततः thereafter, ते they, हृष्टाः joyful, प्रमुदिताः happily, वीराः heroes, कामरूपिणः who can change form at will, हरयः monkeys, नित्यमत्तविहङ्गानि inhabited by birds ever heated with emotion, भ्रमराचरितानिच wandering bees, कोकिराकुलखण्डानि clusters of trees covered with cuckoos, विहङ्गाभिरुतानिच rendered noisy by birds singing, भृङ्गराजाधिगीतानि resounded with the singing of large black bees, भ्रमरैस्सेवितानिच bees clinging, कोणालकविघुष्टानि mingled sound of various birds, सारसाभिरुतानि noise of cries of cranes, तानि all that, वनानि woods, उपवनानिच and gardens, विविशुः entered.
explanation: There after the rejoiced heroic Vanaras who can change their form at will happily entered the woods and gardens inhabited by birds in heat full of emotion, trees covered with cuckoos, and wandering bees, rendered noisy by birds, resounded with the singing of large black bees and bees going around clinging to trees, mingled with sounds of various birds and noise of cries of cranes.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 39.10 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: विविशुस्ते ततस्तानि वनान्युपवनानि च । हृष्टाः प्रमुदिता वीरा हरयः कामरूपिणः ।।6.39.12।।
translation: ततः thereafter, ते they, हृष्टाः joyful, प्रमुदिताः happily, वीराः heroes, कामरूपिणः who can change form at will, हरयः monkeys, नित्यमत्तविहङ्गानि inhabited by birds ever heated with emotion, भ्रमराचरितानिच wandering bees, कोकिराकुलखण्डानि clusters of trees covered with cuckoos, विहङ्गाभिरुतानिच rendered noisy by birds singing, भृङ्गराजाधिगीतानि resounded with the singing of large black bees, भ्रमरैस्सेवितानिच bees clinging, कोणालकविघुष्टानि mingled sound of various birds, सारसाभिरुतानि noise of cries of cranes, तानि all that, वनानि woods, उपवनानिच and gardens, विविशुः entered.
explanation: There after the rejoiced heroic Vanaras who can change their form at will happily entered the woods and gardens inhabited by birds in heat full of emotion, trees covered with cuckoos, and wandering bees, rendered noisy by birds, resounded with the singing of large black bees and bees going around clinging to trees, mingled with sounds of various birds and noise of cries of cranes.
hindi: वे सभी वीर वानर इच्छानुसार रूप धारण करने वाले, उत्साही और आनन्दमग्न थे। उन महातेजस्वी वानरों के वहाँ प्रवेश करते ही फूलों के संसर्ग से सुगन्धित तथा घ्राणेन्द्रिय को सुख देने वाली मन्द वायु चलने लगी। दूसरे बहुत-से यूथपति उन वानरवीरों के समूह से निकलकर सुग्रीव की आज्ञा ले ध्वजा-पताकाओं से अलंकृत लङ्कापुरी में गये

shloka_text: तेषां प्रविशतां तत्र वानराणां महौजसाम् । पुष्पसंसर्गसुरभिर्ववौ घ्राणसुखोऽनिलः ।।6.39.13।।
translation: महौजसाम् of extraordinary energy, तेषाम् all of them, वानराणाम् the Vanaras, तत्र then, प्रविशताम् as they were entering, पुष्पसंसर्गसुरभिः breeze redolent with the fragrance of flowers, घ्राणसुखः enjoying the fragrance, अनिलः wind, ववौ blew
explanation: Then the Vanaras of extraordinary energy, were enjoying the breeze redolent with the fragrance of flowers as they were entering, and the wind blew.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 39.12 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: अन्ये तु हरिवीराणां यूथान्निष्क्रम्य यूथपाः । सुग्रीवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता लङ्कां जग्मुः पताकिनीम् ।।6.39.14।।
translation: अन्ये others, यूथपाःतु heroes too, हरिवीराणाम् monkey heroes, यूथात् troops, निष्क्रम्य left, सुग्रीवेण to Sugriva, अभ्यनुज्ञाताः permitted by, पताकिनीम् decorated with flags, लङ्काम् Lanka, जग्मुः went.
explanation: Some other monkey heroes permitted by Sugriva went to Lanka decorated with flags.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 39.12 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: वित्रासयन्तो विहगांस्त्रासयन्तो मृगद्विपान् । कम्पयन्तश्च तां लङ्कां नादैस्तेनदतां वराः ।।6.39.15।।
translation: नदताम् capable of roaring, वराः best, विहगां birds, वित्रासयन्तः spreading, मृगद्विपान् dispiriting the deer and elephants, नादैः by the sound, ते they, लङ्काम् into Lanka, कम्पयन्तश्च terrifying.
explanation: Other monkeys capable of roaring went into Lanka, spreading out terrifying the birds, dispiriting the deer and elephants by noise.
hindi: गर्जने वाले लोगों में से श्रेष्ठ वे वानरवीर अपने सिंहनाद से पक्षियों को डराते, मृगों और हाथियों के हर्ष छीनते तथा लङ्का को कम्पित करते हुए आगे बढ़ रहे थे

shloka_text: कुर्वन्तस्ते महावेगा महीं चरणपीडिताम् । रजश्च सहसैवोर्थ्वं जगाम चरणोत्थितम् ।।6.39.16।।
translation: महावेगाः capable of speed, ते they, महीम् great force, चरणपीडिताम् trampling down with feet, कुर्वन्तः doing, चरणोत्थितम् under feet, रजश्च dust, सहसैव in a second, ऊर्थ्वम् up to the sky, जगाम wentrose.
explanation: Those Vanaras endowed with speed went trampling down on the ground with force, the dust under their feet rose to the sky in a fraction of a second.
hindi: वे महान् वेगशाली वानर पृथ्वी को जब चरणों से दबाते थे, उस समय उनके पैरों से उठी हुई धूल सहसा ऊपर को उड़ जाती थी

shloka_text: ऋक्षास्सिंहावराहाश्च महिषा वारणामृगाः । तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता जग्मुर्भीता दिशो दश ।।6.39.17।।
translation: तेन by that, शब्देन sound, ऋक्षाः Bears, सिंहावराहश्च lions and pigs, महिषाः buffaloes, वारणामृगाः elephants, वित्रस्ताः alarmed, भीताः frightened, दश ten, दिशः directions, जग्मुः went.
explanation: Alarmed by that sound the Bears, lions, pigs, elephants, buffaloes were frightened and went in all the ten directions.
hindi: वानरों के उस सिंहनाद से त्रस्त एवं भयभीत हुए रीछ, सिंह, भैंसे, हाथी, मृग और पक्षी दसों दिशाओं की ओर भाग गये

shloka_text: शिखरं तत्त्रिकूटस्य प्रांशु चैकं दिविस्पृशम् । समन्तात्पुष्पसंञ्छन्नं महारजतसन्निभम् ।।6.39.18।।
translation: समन्तात् all over, पुष्पसञ्छन्नम् covered with flowers, महारजतसन्निभम् sparkled with gold, शतयोजनविस्तीर्णम् spread over a hundred yojanas, विमलम् whitepure, चारुदर्शनम् beautiful to look, श्लक्ष्णम् smooth, श्रीमत् splendid, महच्छैव sages, शकुनैरपि even for birds, दुष्प्रापम् not possible to reach, जनैः people, मनसापि in thought, दुरारोहम् difficult to access, कर्मणा by physical action, किंपुनः why again, प्रांशु praise worthy, दिविस्पृशम् touching the sky, एकम् alone, त्रिकूटस्यशिखरम् peak of Trikuta.
explanation: Trikuta peak was fully covered with flowers, sparkled with gold, spread over a hundred yojanas, beautiful to look at, splendid and smooth. It is difficult even for birds to reach, for sages even in thought and difficult to access by any physical action. It is praiseworthy as if touching the sky alone.
hindi: त्रिकूट पर्वत का एक शिखर बहुत ऊँचा था। वह ऐसा जान पड़ता था, मानो स्वर्गलोक को छू रहा हो। उसपर सब ओर पीले रंग के फूल खिले हुए थे, जिनसे वह सोने का-सा जान पड़ता था

shloka_text: शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं विमलं चारुदर्शनम् । श्लक्ष्णं श्रीमन्महच्छैव दुष्प्रापं शकुनैरपि ।।6.39.19।।
translation: समन्तात् all over, पुष्पसञ्छन्नम् covered with flowers, महारजतसन्निभम् sparkled with gold, शतयोजनविस्तीर्णम् spread over a hundred yojanas, विमलम् whitepure, चारुदर्शनम् beautiful to look, श्लक्ष्णम् smooth, श्रीमत् splendid, महच्छैव sages, शकुनैरपि even for birds, दुष्प्रापम् not possible to reach, जनैः people, मनसापि in thought, दुरारोहम् difficult to access, कर्मणा by physical action, किंपुनः why again, प्रांशु praise worthy, दिविस्पृशम् touching the sky, एकम् alone, त्रिकूटस्यशिखरम् peak of Trikuta.
explanation: Trikuta peak was fully covered with flowers, sparkled with gold, spread over a hundred yojanas, beautiful to look at, splendid and smooth. It is difficult even for birds to reach, for sages even in thought and difficult to access by any physical action. It is praiseworthy as if touching the sky alone.
hindi: उस शिखर का विस्तार सौ योजन था। वह देखने में बड़ा ही सुन्दर, स्वच्छ, स्निग्ध, कान्तिमान् और विशाल था। पक्षियों के लिये भी उसकी चोटी तक पहुँचना कठिन होता था

shloka_text: निविष्टा तत्र शिखरे लङ्का रावणपालिता ।।6.39.20।। शतयोजनविस्तीर्णा त्रिंशद्योजनमायता ।
translation: तत्र there, शिखरे on top of the peak, रावणपालिता ruled by Ravana, शतयोजनविस्तीर्णा a hundred yojanas in breadth, त्रिंशद्योजनम् thirty yojanas, आयता long, लङ्का Lanka, निविष्टा experienced.
explanation: Lanka ruled by Ravana was a hundred yojanas in breadth and thirty yojanas in length was seen.
hindi: लोग त्रिकूट के उस शिखर पर मन के द्वारा चढ़ने की कल्पना भी नहीं कर सकते थे। फिर क्रियाद्वारा उस पर आरूढ़ होने की तो बात ही क्या है? रावण द्वारा पालित लङ्का त्रिकूट के उसी शिखर पर बसी हुई थी

shloka_text: सा पुरी गोपुरैरुच्चैः पाण्डुराम्बुदसन्निभैः । काञ्चनेन च शालेन राजतेन च शोभते ।।6.39.21।।
translation: सा that, पुरी city, उच्चैः tall, पाण्डुराम्बुदसन्निभैः like white cluster of clouds, गोपुरैः towers, काञ्चनेन with gold, राजतेनच and silver, शालेन fortified, शोभते charming.
explanation: The city of Lanka looked charming with tall towers resembling white cluster of clouds fortified with gold and silver.
hindi: वह पुरी दस योजन चौड़ी और बीस योजन लंबी थी। सफेद बादलों के समान ऊँचे-ऊँचे गोपुर तथा सोने और चाँदी के परकोटे उसकी शोभा बढ़ाते थे

shloka_text: प्रासादैश्च विमानैश्च लङ्का परमभूषिता । घनैरिवाऽतपापाये मध्यमं वैष्णवं पदम् ।।6.39.22।।
translation: प्रासादैश्च even the buildings, विमानैश्च resembled air planes, परमभूषिता decorated beautifully, लङ्का Lanka, आतपापापये exposed to the sun, घनैः rainy clouds, मध्यमम् in the centre, वैष्णवंपदम् इव resembling the abode of Vishnu.
explanation: The tall buildings decorated beautifully resembled air planes and were shining like heavy rainy clouds exposed to the sun. The building in the centre resembled the abode of Vishnu.
hindi: जैसे ग्रीष्म के अन्तकाल वर्षा ऋतु में घनीभूत बादल आकाश की शोभा बढ़ाते हैं, उसी प्रकार प्रासादों और विमानों से लङ्कापुरी अत्यन्त सुशोभित हो रही थी

shloka_text: यस्यां स्तम्भसहस्रेण प्रासादस्समलङ्कृतः । कैलासशिखराकारो दृश्यते खमिवोललिखन् ।।6.39.23।।
translation: यस्याम् in that city, यः that which is, नित्यम् always, रक्षसाम् protected, समग्रेण fully, शतेन hundred, रक्ष्यते graced, स्तम्बसहस्रेण thousand pillars, समलङ्कङ्कृतः ornament, कैलासशिखराकारः peak of mount Kailasa, प्रासादः palace, खम् sky, उललिखन्निव as if scraping, दृश्यते appeared, सः that, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa Lord's, पुरभूषणम् ornament of city, बभूव looked.
explanation: In that city, which was always protected fully by a hundred Rakshasas, there was a palace with thousand pillars, which looked like peak of mount Kailas, and was as though it was scraping the sky and it as like an ornament of Lanka, the city of Rakshasa's Lord.
hindi: उस पुरी में सहस्र खम्भों से अलंकृत एक चैत्यप्रासाद था, जो कैलास-शिखर के समान दिखायी देता था। वह आकाश को मापता हुआ-सा जान पड़ता था

shloka_text: चैत्यस्स राक्षसेन्द्रस्य बभूव पुरभूषणम् । शतेन रक्षसां नित्यं यस्समग्रेण रक्ष्यते ।।6.39.24।।
translation: यस्याम् in that city, यः that which is, नित्यम् always, रक्षसाम् protected, समग्रेण fully, शतेन hundred, रक्ष्यते graced, स्तम्बसहस्रेण thousand pillars, समलङ्कङ्कृतः ornament, कैलासशिखराकारः peak of mount Kailasa, प्रासादः palace, खम् sky, उललिखन्निव as if scraping, दृश्यते appeared, सः that, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa Lord's, पुरभूषणम् ornament of city, बभूव looked.
explanation: In that city, which was always protected fully by a hundred Rakshasas, there was a palace with thousand pillars, which looked like peak of mount Kailas, and was as though it was scraping the sky and it as like an ornament of Lanka, the city of Rakshasa's Lord.
hindi: राक्षसराज रावण का वह चैत्यप्रासाद लङ्कापुरी का आभूषण था। कई सौ राक्षस रक्षा के सभी साधनों से सम्पन्न होकर प्रतिदिन उसकी रक्षा करते थे

shloka_text: मनोज्ञां काननवतीं पर्वतैरुपशोभिताम् । नानाधातुविचित्रैश्च उद्यानैरुपशोभिताम् ।।6.39.25।।
translation: लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's brother, रामः Rama, मनोज्ञाम् delightfully, काननवतीम् different kinds of forests, नानाधातुविचित्रैः different kinds of minerals, पर्वतैः mountains, उपशोभिताम् very charming, उद्यानैः gardens, उपशोभिताम् very delightful, नानाविहङ्गसङ्घुष्टाम् variety of birds singing happily, नानामृगनिषेविताम् frequented by different kinds of deer, नानाकुसुमसञ्छन्नाम् endowed with different varieties of flowers, नानाराक्षससेविताम् attended by many Rakshasas, समृद्धाम् blooming, समृद्धार्थाम् prosperous, ताम् that city, पुरीम् city, वानरैःसह along with Vanaras, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Prosperous Rama, brother of Lakshmana along with Vanaras saw different kinds of forests, mountains filled with different kinds of minerals, delightful gardens endowed with different varieties of flowers, charming birds singing happily, frequented by a variety of deer, attended by Rakshasas. The city was blooming with prosperity.
hindi: इस प्रकार वह पुरी बड़ी ही मनोहर, सुवर्णमयी, अनेकानेक पर्वतों से अलंकृत, नाना प्रकार की विचित्र धातुओं से चित्रित और अनेक उद्यानों से सुशोभित थी

shloka_text: नानाविहङ्गासङ्घुष्टां नानामृगनिषेविताम् । नानाकुसुमसञ्छन्नां नानाराक्षससेविताम् ।।6.39.26।।
translation: लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's brother, रामः Rama, मनोज्ञाम् delightfully, काननवतीम् different kinds of forests, नानाधातुविचित्रैः different kinds of minerals, पर्वतैः mountains, उपशोभिताम् very charming, उद्यानैः gardens, उपशोभिताम् very delightful, नानाविहङ्गसङ्घुष्टाम् variety of birds singing happily, नानामृगनिषेविताम् frequented by different kinds of deer, नानाकुसुमसञ्छन्नाम् endowed with different varieties of flowers, नानाराक्षससेविताम् attended by many Rakshasas, समृद्धाम् blooming, समृद्धार्थाम् prosperous, ताम् that city, पुरीम् city, वानरैःसह along with Vanaras, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Prosperous Rama, brother of Lakshmana along with Vanaras saw different kinds of forests, mountains filled with different kinds of minerals, delightful gardens endowed with different varieties of flowers, charming birds singing happily, frequented by a variety of deer, attended by Rakshasas. The city was blooming with prosperity.
hindi: भाँति-भाँति के विहङ्गम वहाँ अपनी मधुर बोली बोल रहे थे। नाना प्रकार के मृग आदि पशु उसका सेवन करते थे। अनेक प्रकार के फूलों की सम्पत्ति से वह सम्पन्न थी और विविध प्रकार के आकार वाले राक्षस वहाँ निवास करते थे

shloka_text: तां समृद्धां समृद्धार्धां लक्ष्मीनान्लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । रावणस्य पुरीं रामो ददर्श सह वानरैः ।।6.39.27।।
translation: लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's brother, रामः Rama, मनोज्ञाम् delightfully, काननवतीम् different kinds of forests, नानाधातुविचित्रैः different kinds of minerals, पर्वतैः mountains, उपशोभिताम् very charming, उद्यानैः gardens, उपशोभिताम् very delightful, नानाविहङ्गसङ्घुष्टाम् variety of birds singing happily, नानामृगनिषेविताम् frequented by different kinds of deer, नानाकुसुमसञ्छन्नाम् endowed with different varieties of flowers, नानाराक्षससेविताम् attended by many Rakshasas, समृद्धाम् blooming, समृद्धार्थाम् prosperous, ताम् that city, पुरीम् city, वानरैःसह along with Vanaras, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Prosperous Rama, brother of Lakshmana along with Vanaras saw different kinds of forests, mountains filled with different kinds of minerals, delightful gardens endowed with different varieties of flowers, charming birds singing happily, frequented by a variety of deer, attended by Rakshasas. The city was blooming with prosperity.
hindi: धन-धान्य से सम्पन्न तथा सम्पूर्ण मनोवाञ्छित वस्तुओं से भरी-पूरी उस रावण-पुरी को लक्ष्मण के बड़े भाई लक्ष्मीवान् श्रीराम ने वानरों के साथ देखा

shloka_text: तां महागृहसम्बाधां दृष्टवा लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः । नगरी ममरप्रख्यो विस्मयं प्राप्यवीर्यवान् ।।6.39.28।।
translation: वीर्यवान् valiant, लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः brother of Lakshmana, महागृहसम्बाधाम् filled with great palaces, अमरप्रख्यः distinct like Lord do Devatas, ताम् that, नगरीम् city, दृष्टवा on seeing, विस्मयम् wondered, प्राप्य became
explanation: Valiant brother of Lakshmana wondered seeing the city filled with great palaces, distinct like Lord Indra's city.
hindi: बड़े-बड़े महलों से सघन बसी हुई उस स्वर्गतुल्य नगरी को देखकर पराक्रमी श्रीराम बड़े विस्मित हुए

shloka_text: तां रत्नपूर्णां बहुसंविधानां प्रासादमालाभिरलङ्कृतां च । पुरीं महायन्त्रकवाटमुख्यां ददर्श रामो महता बलेन ।।6.39.29।।
translation: महता huge, बलेन army, रामः Rama, रत्नपूर्णम् jewelsgems, बहुसंविधानाम् accompanied by Vanaras, प्रासादमालाभिः garland s of buildings, अलङ्कृतांच adorned with, महायन्त्रकवाटमुख्याम् gates fitted with huge machines for war, महता large, बलेन by army, ताम् that, पुरीम् city, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Accompanied by huge Vanara army, Rama saw in the city of Lanka rows of buildingspalaces, adorned with gems, gates fitted with huge machines for war and large army of Ravana. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
hindi: इस प्रकार अपनी विशाल सेना के साथ श्रीरघुनाथजी ने अनेक प्रकार के रत्नों से पूर्ण, तरहतरह की रचनाओं से सुसज्जित, ऊँचे-ऊँचे महलों की पंक्ति से अलंकृत और बड़े-बड़े यन्त्रों से युक्त मजबूत किवाड़ोंवाली वह अद्भुत पुरी देखी

shloka_text: ततो रामस्सुवेलाग्रं योजनद्वयमण्डलम् । अरुरोह ससुग्रीवो हरियूधपसम्वृतः ।।6.40.1।।
translation: ततः there upon, ससुग्रीवः Sugriva, हरियूथपः Vanara troop, सम्वृतः surrounded by, रामः Rama, योजनद्वयमण्डलम् spread over yojanas, सुवेलाग्रम् Suvela peak, उपारोहत् ascended.
explanation: Rama accompanied by Vanara troop and Sugriva, ascended the peak of Suvela mountain spread over yojanas.
comments: Rama catches the sight of Ravana standing on top of the palace. Provoked by anger Sugriva springs from the top of the mountain to Ravana, fights with him and returns back successfully.
hindi: तदनन्तर वानरयूथों से युक्त सुग्रीवसहित श्रीराम सुवेल पर्वत के सबसे ऊँचे शिखर पर चढ़े, जिसका विस्तार दो योजन का था

shloka_text: स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं तत्रैव दिशो दश विलोकयन् । त्रिकूटशिखरे रम्ये निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा ।।6.40.2।। ददर्श लङ्कां सुन्यस्तां रम्यकाननशोभिताम् ।
translation: मुहूर्तम् for a short while, तत्रैव there itself, स्थित्वा remaining, दश ten, दिशः directions, विलोयन् observing, रम्ये charming, त्रिकूटशिखरे peak of Trikuta, विश्वकर्मणा by Vishwakarma, निर्मिताम् constructed, सुन्यस्ताम् strongly, रम्यकाननशोभिताम् with delightful groves, लङ्काम् Lanka, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Remaining there for a short while, Rama observed the view of Lanka in all directions. He saw Lanka built on the charming peak of Trikuta strongly by Vishwakarma, endowed with delightful groves.
hindi: वहाँ दो घड़ी ठहरकर दसों दिशाओं की ओर दृष्टिपात करते हुए श्रीराम ने त्रिकूट पर्वत के रमणीय शिखर पर सुन्दर ढंग से बसी हुई विश्वकर्मा द्वारा निर्मित लङ्कापुरी को देखा, जो मनोहर काननों से सुशोभित थी

shloka_text: तस्यांगोपुरशृङ्गस्थं राक्षसेन्द्रं दुरासदम् ।।6.40.3।।
translation: तस्याम् from that, गोपुरशृङ्गस्थम् peak of the tower, दुरासदम् difficult to approach, श्वेतचामरपर्यन्तम् fanned by white whisks on both sides, विजयच्छत्रशोभितम् graced with triumphal parasol, रत्नचन्दनसंलिप्तम् decorated with red sandal paste, रक्ताभरणभूषितम् adorned in red coloured ornaments, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशम् resembling dark clouds, हेमसञ्छादिताम्बरम् attired in red embroidered with golden colour thread, विषाणाग्रैः by the indentations made by the tusks of Airavata elephant of Indra earlier, उत्कृष्टकिणवक्षसम् with scars on chest, शशलोहितरागेण colour of hare's blood, रक्तवाससा by the red coloured attire, संवीतम् सन्ध्यातपेन covered like sun shine at sun set, सञ्छन्नम् , अम्बरे sky, मेघराशिम् इव mass of clouds, राक्षसेन्द्रम् rakshasa king.
explanation: From there Rama saw on the peak of the tower the Rakshasa king, who is difficult to approach. He was fanned by white whisks on both sides, graced with triumphal parasol, decorated his body with red sandal paste, adorned in redcoloured ornaments, resembling dark clouds, attired in red like the hare's blood, embroidered with golden thread, with scars on his chest caused by indentations made by the tusks of Airavata the elephant of Indra, looked like a mass of cloud covered by sunshine at dusk.
hindi: उस नगर के गोपुर की छत पर उन्हें दुर्जय राक्षसराज रावण बैठा दिखायी दिया, जिसके दोनों ओर श्वेत चँवर डुलाये जा रहे थे, सिर पर विजय-छत्र शोभा दे रहा था। रावण का सारा शरीर रक्तचन्दन से चर्चित था। उसके अङ्ग लाल रंग के आभूषणों से विभूषित थे

shloka_text: श्वेतचामरपर्यन्तं विजयच्छत्रशोभितम् । रक्तचन्दनसंलिप्तं रत्नाभरणभूषितम् ।।6.40.4।।
translation: तस्याम् from that, गोपुरशृङ्गस्थम् peak of the tower, दुरासदम् difficult to approach, श्वेतचामरपर्यन्तम् fanned by white whisks on both sides, विजयच्छत्रशोभितम् graced with triumphal parasol, रत्नचन्दनसंलिप्तम् decorated with red sandal paste, रक्ताभरणभूषितम् adorned in red coloured ornaments, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशम् resembling dark clouds, हेमसञ्छादिताम्बरम् attired in red embroidered with golden colour thread, विषाणाग्रैः by the indentations made by the tusks of Airavata elephant of Indra earlier, उत्कृष्टकिणवक्षसम् with scars on chest, शशलोहितरागेण colour of hare's blood, रक्तवाससा by the red coloured attire, संवीतम् सन्ध्यातपेन covered like sun shine at sun set, सञ्छन्नम् , अम्बरे sky, मेघराशिम् इव mass of clouds, राक्षसेन्द्रम् rakshasa king.
explanation: From there Rama saw on the peak of the tower the Rakshasa king, who is difficult to approach. He was fanned by white whisks on both sides, graced with triumphal parasol, decorated his body with red sandal paste, adorned in redcoloured ornaments, resembling dark clouds, attired in red like the hare's blood, embroidered with golden thread, with scars on his chest caused by indentations made by the tusks of Airavata the elephant of Indra, looked like a mass of cloud covered by sunshine at dusk.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 40.3 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: नीलजीमूतसङ्काशं हेमसञ्छादिताम्बरम् । ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैरुत्कृष्टकिणवक्षसम् ।।6.40.5।।
translation: तस्याम् from that, गोपुरशृङ्गस्थम् peak of the tower, दुरासदम् difficult to approach, श्वेतचामरपर्यन्तम् fanned by white whisks on both sides, विजयच्छत्रशोभितम् graced with triumphal parasol, रत्नचन्दनसंलिप्तम् decorated with red sandal paste, रक्ताभरणभूषितम् adorned in red coloured ornaments, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशम् resembling dark clouds, हेमसञ्छादिताम्बरम् attired in red embroidered with golden colour thread, विषाणाग्रैः by the indentations made by the tusks of Airavata elephant of Indra earlier, उत्कृष्टकिणवक्षसम् with scars on chest, शशलोहितरागेण colour of hare's blood, रक्तवाससा by the red coloured attire, संवीतम् सन्ध्यातपेन covered like sun shine at sun set, सञ्छन्नम् , अम्बरे sky, मेघराशिम् इव mass of clouds, राक्षसेन्द्रम् rakshasa king.
explanation: From there Rama saw on the peak of the tower the Rakshasa king, who is difficult to approach. He was fanned by white whisks on both sides, graced with triumphal parasol, decorated his body with red sandal paste, adorned in redcoloured ornaments, resembling dark clouds, attired in red like the hare's blood, embroidered with golden thread, with scars on his chest caused by indentations made by the tusks of Airavata the elephant of Indra, looked like a mass of cloud covered by sunshine at dusk.
hindi: वह काले मेघ के समान जान पड़ता था। उसके वस्त्रों पर सोने के काम किये गये थे। ऐरावत हाथी के दाँतों के अग्रभाग से आहत होने के कारण उसके वक्षःस्थल में आघातचिह्न बन गया था

shloka_text: शशलोहितरागेण संवीतं रक्तवाससा । सन्ध्यातपेन संवीतं मेघराशिमिवाम्बरे ।।6.40.6।।
translation: तस्याम् from that, गोपुरशृङ्गस्थम् peak of the tower, दुरासदम् difficult to approach, श्वेतचामरपर्यन्तम् fanned by white whisks on both sides, विजयच्छत्रशोभितम् graced with triumphal parasol, रत्नचन्दनसंलिप्तम् decorated with red sandal paste, रक्ताभरणभूषितम् adorned in red coloured ornaments, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशम् resembling dark clouds, हेमसञ्छादिताम्बरम् attired in red embroidered with golden colour thread, विषाणाग्रैः by the indentations made by the tusks of Airavata elephant of Indra earlier, उत्कृष्टकिणवक्षसम् with scars on chest, शशलोहितरागेण colour of hare's blood, रक्तवाससा by the red coloured attire, संवीतम् सन्ध्यातपेन covered like sun shine at sun set, सञ्छन्नम् , अम्बरे sky, मेघराशिम् इव mass of clouds, राक्षसेन्द्रम् rakshasa king.
explanation: From there Rama saw on the peak of the tower the Rakshasa king, who is difficult to approach. He was fanned by white whisks on both sides, graced with triumphal parasol, decorated his body with red sandal paste, adorned in redcoloured ornaments, resembling dark clouds, attired in red like the hare's blood, embroidered with golden thread, with scars on his chest caused by indentations made by the tusks of Airavata the elephant of Indra, looked like a mass of cloud covered by sunshine at dusk.
hindi: खरगोश के रक्त के समान लाल रंग से रँगे हुए वस्त्र से आच्छादित होकर वह आकाश में संध्याकाल की धूप से ढकी हुई मेघमाला के समान दिखायी देता था

shloka_text: पश्यतां वानरेन्द्राणां राघवस्यापि पश्यतः । दर्शनाद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सुग्रीवस्सहसोत्थितः ।।6.40.7।।
translation: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa king, दर्शनात् sight of looking, वानरेन्द्राणाम् by the king of Vanaras, पश्यताम् seeing, राघवस्यापि at Raghava, पश्यतः seeing, सहसा rashly, उत्थितः got up.
explanation: Looking at the sight of Raghava seeing Rakshasa king, Sugriva the king of Vanaras got up instantly rashly.
hindi: मुख्य-मुख्य वानरों तथा श्रीरघुनाथजी के सामने ही राक्षसराज रावण पर दृष्टि पड़ते ही सुग्रीव सहसा खड़े हो गये

shloka_text: क्रोधवेगेन संयुक्तस्सत्त्वेन च बलेन च । अचलाग्रादथोत्थाय पुप्लुवे गोपुरस्थले ।।6.40.8।।
translation: क्रोथवेगेन provoked by anger, सत्त्वेनच courageous, बलेनच and strong, संयुक्तः impetuous, अथ then, अचलाग्रात् the top of the peak, उत्थाय rose up, गोपुरस्थले peak of the tower, पुप्लुवे flew.
explanation: Provoked by anger, courageous and strong Sugriva rose up impelled by impetuosity and flew to the peak of the tower.
hindi: वे क्रोध के वेग से युक्त और शारीरिक एवं मानसिक बल से प्रेरित हो सुवेल के शिखर से उठकर उस गोपुर की छत पर कूद पड़े

shloka_text: स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य निर्भयेनान्तरात्मना । तृणीकृत्य च तद्रक्षस्सोऽब्रवीत्परुषं वचः ।।6.40.9।।
translation: सः he, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, स्थित्वा stood, सम्प्रेक्ष्य looking at, निर्भयेन fearlessly, अन्तरात्मना internally, तत् that, रक्षः ogre, तृणीकृत्यः treating like a straw, परुषम् harsh, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: For a moment he stood looking at the ogre fearlessly in his mind and treating him like straw spoke harsh words.
hindi: वहाँ खड़े होकर वे कुछ देर तो रावण को देखते रहे। फिर निर्भय चित्त से उस राक्षस को तिनके के समान समझकर वे कठोर वाणी में बोले-

shloka_text: लोकनाथस्य रामस्य सखा दासोऽस्मि राक्षस । न मया मोक्ष्यसेऽद्य त्वं पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तेजसा ।।6.40.10।।
translation: राक्षस Rakshasa, लोकनाथस्य ruler of the world, रामस्य at Rama, सखा friend, दासः servant, अस्मि I am, त्वम् your, अद्य his, पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य best of kings, तेजसा power, मया by me, नमोक्ष्यसे will not leave you.
explanation: "O Rakshasa! I am a friend and servant of the king of kings, ruler of the world. By his power I will not leave you!", Sugriva said.
hindi: ‘राक्षस! मैं लोकनाथ भगवान् श्रीराम का सखा और दास हूँ। महाराज श्रीराम के तेज से आज तू मेरे हाथ से छूट नहीं सकेगा’

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा सहसोत्पत्य पुप्लुवे तस्य चोपरि । आकृष्य मुकुटं चित्रं पातयित्वाऽप तद्भुवि ।।6.40.11।।
translation: इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, सहसा speedily, उत्पत्य got up, तस्य his, उपरि top, पुप्लुवे flying, चित्रम् wonderful, मुकुटम् diadem, आकृष्य held, तत् then, भुवि on the ground, पातयित्वा fell.
explanation: Having spoken thus, Sugriva got up speedily and flew to the top of the tower (here Ravana was located) held the diadem and pushed it on the ground.
hindi: ऐसा कहकर वे अकस्मात् उछलकर रावण के ऊपर जा कूदे और उसके विचित्र मुकुटों को खींचकर उन्होंने पृथ्वी पर गिरा दिया

shloka_text: समीक्ष्य तूर्णमायान्तम बभाषे निशाचरः । सुग्रीवस्त्व परोक्षम्मे हीनग्रीवो भविष्यसि ।।6.40.12।।
translation: निशाचरः night ranger, तूर्णम् quickly, आयान्तम् coming towards, तम् him, समीक्ष्य observing, बभाषे announced, त्वम् you, मे my, परोक्षम् without being seen by me, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, हीनग्रीवः without neck, भविष्यसि will make.
explanation: Observing Sugriva coming towards him, Ravana said, "When you were not seen by me you had a neck. I will make you neckless."
hindi: उन्हें इस प्रकार तीव्र गति से अपने ऊपर आक्रमण करते देख रावण ने कहा—’अरे! जबतक तू मेरे सामने नहीं आया था, तभी तक सुग्रीव (सुन्दर कण्ठ से युक्त) था। अब तो तू अपनी इस ग्रीवा से रहित हो जायगा’

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वोत्थाय तं क्षिप्रं बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपत्तले । कन्तुवत्तं समुत्थाय बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपद्धरि ।।6.40.13।।
translation: इति like that, उक्त्वा said, उत्थाय getting up, बाहुभ्याम् hand s, तम् his, क्षिप्रम् instantly, तले head, आक्षिपत् dashed, सः he, हरिः Vanara, कन्तुवत् like a ball, समुत्थाय getting up, बाहुभ्याम् with both hand s, आक्षिपत् pushed down
explanation: Telling like that that Ravana got up and threw Sugriva by his hand s to the ground. Then Sugriva getting up like a ball fallen pushed Ravana down.
hindi: ऐसा कहकर रावण ने अपनी दो भुजाओं द्वारा उन्हें शीघ्र ही उठाकर उस छत की फर्श पर दे मारा। फिर वानरराज सुग्रीव ने भी गेंद की तरह उछलकर रावण को दोनों भुजाओं से उठा लिया और उसी फर्शपर जोर से पटक दिया

shloka_text: परस्परं स्वेदविदग्धगात्रौ परस्परं शोणितदिग्धदेहौ । परस्परं लशिष्टनिरुद्धचेष्टौ परस्परं शाल्मलिकिंशुकौयधा ।।6.40.14।।
translation: परस्परम् one against the other, स्वेदद्विग्धगात्रौ sweating all over the body, परस्परम् one against the other, शोणितरक्तदेहौ bodies coloured red with blood, परस्परम् each one the other, लशिष्टनिरुद्धचेष्टौ clinging to each other bodies interlocked stood motionless, परस्परम् one another, शाल्मलिकिंशुकानिव like the red silkcotton trees, महाबलौ strong, तौ both, राक्षसवानरेन्द्रौ Rakshasa and Vanara kings, मुष्टिप्रहारैश्च fighting with their fists, तलप्रहारैः slaps with palms, अरत्निघातैःच and blows of forearms, कराग्रघातैः hurting with nails, असह्यरूपम् युद्धम् unbearable forms of war, चक्रतुः carried out.
explanation: Sugriva and Ravana, their bodies sweating all over, bodies coloured red with blood looking like red silk cotton trees, their bodies clinging together interlocked with each other stood motionless. They were fighting with their fists, palms and blows of forearms, hurting each other with nails and carrying out unbearable forms of war.
hindi: फिर तो वे दोनों आपस में गुंथ गये। दोनों के ही शरीर पसीने से तर और खून से लथपथ हो गये तथा दोनों ही एक-दूसरे की पकड़ में आने के कारण निश्चेष्ट होकर खिले हुए सेमल और पलाश नामक वृक्षों के समान दिखायी देने लगे

shloka_text: मुष्टिप्रहारैश्च तलप्रहारैररत्निघातैश्च कराग्रघातैः । तौ चक्रतुर्युद्धमसह्यरूपं महाबलौ राक्षसवानरेन्द्रौ ।।6.40.15।।
translation: परस्परम् one against the other, स्वेदद्विग्धगात्रौ sweating all over the body, परस्परम् one against the other, शोणितरक्तदेहौ bodies coloured red with blood, परस्परम् each one the other, लशिष्टनिरुद्धचेष्टौ clinging to each other bodies interlocked stood motionless, परस्परम् one another, शाल्मलिकिंशुकानिव like the red silkcotton trees, महाबलौ strong, तौ both, राक्षसवानरेन्द्रौ Rakshasa and Vanara kings, मुष्टिप्रहारैश्च fighting with their fists, तलप्रहारैः slaps with palms, अरत्निघातैःच and blows of forearms, कराग्रघातैः hurting with nails, असह्यरूपम् युद्धम् unbearable forms of war, चक्रतुः carried out.
explanation: Sugriva and Ravana, their bodies sweating all over, bodies coloured red with blood looking like red silk cotton trees, their bodies clinging together interlocked with each other stood motionless. They were fighting with their fists, palms and blows of forearms, hurting each other with nails and carrying out unbearable forms of war.
hindi: राक्षसराज रावण और वानरराज सुग्रीव दोनों ही बड़े बलवान् थे, अतः दोनों चूंसे, थप्पड़, कोहनी और पंजों की मार के साथ बड़ा असह्य युद्ध करने लगे

shloka_text: कृत्वा नियुद्धं भृशमुग्रवेगौ कालं चिर, गोपुरवेदिमध्ये । उत्क्षिप्य चोत्क्षिप्य विनम्य देहौ पादक्रमाद्गोपुरवेदिलग्नौ ।।6.40.16।।
translation: भृशम् violently, उग्रवेग्रौ with aggressive terrible combat, चिरंकालम् for long, गोपुरवेदिमध्ये in the middle of the flat portion of the tower, नियुद्धम् , कृत्वा having done, देहौ body, उत्क्षिप्यउत्क्षिप्य throwing each other repeatedly, विनम्य bending, पादक्रमात् by moving their feet in a direction, गोपुरवेदिलग्नौ stood on the tower.
explanation: Violently fighting like that aggressively for long, throwing each other down repeatedly, bending and moving their feet in a direction, stood on the fl at area of the peak in the middle portion.
hindi: गोपुर के चबूतरे पर बहुत देर तक भारी मल्लयुद्ध करके वे भयानक वेगवाले दोनों वीर बार-बार एक-दूसरे को उछालते और झुकाते हुए पैरों को विशेष दाँव-पेंच के साथ चलाते-चलाते उस चबूतरे से जा लगे

shloka_text: अन्योन्यमाविध्य वेदिलग्नौ तौ पेततुस्सालनिखातमध्ये । उत्पेततुर्भूतलम स्पृशन्तौ स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं त्वभिनिश्श्वसन्तौ ।।6.40.17।।
translation: तौ both, अन्योन्यम् one another, विध्य squeezed, वेदिलग्नौ defensive walls, सालनिखातमध्ये between the boundary and the moat, निपेततुः dropped down, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, अभिनिःश्वसन्तौ gasping heavily, स्थित्वा remaining, स्पृशन्तौ clinging their bodies, भूमितलम् on the ground, उत्पेततुः jumping.
explanation: Squeezing their bodies of each other they dropped down between the boundary of the peak and the moat. They were gasping heavily for a moment and clung their body to each other jumping.
hindi: एक-दूसरे को दबाकर परस्पर सटे हुए शरीरवाले वे दोनों योद्धा किले के परकोटे और खाईं के बीच में गिर गये। वहाँ हाँफते हुए दो घड़ी तक पृथ्वी का आलिङ्गन किये पड़े रहे। तत्पश्चात् उछलकर खड़े हो गये

shloka_text: आलिङ् ग्य चालिङ् ग्य च बाहुयोक्स्रैस्संयोजयामासतुराहवे तौ । सम्रम्भशिक्षाबलसम्प्रयुक्तौ संचेरतुस्सम्प्रति युद्धमार्गैः ।।6.40.18।।
translation: तौ they, बाहुयोक्स्रै pressing their bosoms, आलिङ् ग्यच clung to each other, आलिङ् ग्यच and fastened to each other in embrace, आहवे in combat, संयोजयामासतुः having received similar training, सम्रम्भशिक्षाबलसम्प्रयुक्तौ endowed with might, सम्प्रति at this time, युद्धमार्गैः war methods, सुचेरतुः went on.
explanation: Both pressing their bosom to each other, clung to each other, and fastened themselves in embrace in the comb at having received similar training in war and both endowed with might. At this time, they went on in comb at using several war methods.
hindi: फिर वे एक-दूसरे का बार-बार आलिङ्गन करके उसे बाहुपाश में जकड़ने लगे। दोनों ही क्रोध, शिक्षा (मल्लयुद्ध-विषयक अभ्यास) तथा शारीरिक बल से सम्पन्न थे; अतः उस युद्धस्थल में कुश्ती के अनेक दाँव-पेंच दिखाते हुए भ्रमण करने लगे

shloka_text: शार्दूरसिंहाविव जातदर्पौ गजेन्द्रपोताविव सम्प्रयुक्तौ । संहत्य चापीड्य च तावुरोभ्यां नि पेततुर्वै युगपद्धरण्याम् ।।6.40.19।।
translation: तौ both, जातदर्पौ affected by pride, शार्दूलसिंहानिव l who resembled tiger and lion, सम्प्रयुक्तौ connecting to each other, गजेन्द्रपोताविव like Lordly elephants, तावुरोभ्याम् through their shoulders, चापीड्य hitting, संवेद्यच and hurting each other, युगपत् simultaneously at once, धरायाम् holding one another, पेततुःवै fell on the ground.
explanation: Both of them resembled a tiger and lion affected by pride, connecting to each other through their shoulders like Lordly elephants, hitting and hurting one another holding one another fell down at once simultaneously.
hindi: जिनके नये-नये दाँत निकले हों, ऐसे बाघ और सिंह के बच्चों तथा परस्पर लड़ते हुए गजराज के छोटे छौनों के समान वे दोनों वीर अपने वक्षःस्थल से एकदूसरे को दबाते और हाथों से परस्पर बल आजमाते हुए एक साथ ही पृथ्वी पर गिर पड़े

shloka_text: उद्यम्य चान्योन्यमधिक्षिपन्तौ सञ्चक्रमाते बहु युद्धमार्गे : । व्यायामशिक्षाबलसम्प्रयुक्तौ क्लमं न तौ जग्मतुराशु वीरौ ।।6.40.20।।
translation: अन्योन्यम् one another, उद्यम्य holding, अधिक्षिपन्तौ snubbing each other, युद्धमार्गै: kinds of war, बहु many, सञ्चक्रमाते gradually, व्यायामशिक्षाबलसम्प्रयुक्तौ well trained in wrestling and fighting, तौ both of them, वीरौ heroes, क्लमम् tiresomeness, नजग्मतुः not felt.
explanation: Both of them were holding one another, snubbing each other gradually following many kinds of combat. As both the heroes were well trained in wrestling and fighting, they did not feel tiresome.
hindi: दोनों ही कसरती जवान थे और युद्ध की शिक्षा तथा बल से सम्पन्न थे। अतः युद्ध जीतने के लिये उद्यमशील हो एक-दूसरे पर आक्षेप करते हुए युद्धमार्ग पर अनेक प्रकार से विचरण करते थे तथापि उन वीरों को जल्दी थकावट नहीं होती थी

shloka_text: बाहूत्तमैर्वारणवारणाभैर्निवारयन्तौ वरवारणाभौ । चिरेण कालेन तुसम्प्रयुक्तौ सञ्चेरतुर्मण्डलमार्गमाशु ।।6.40.21।।
translation: र्वारणवारणाभै Sugriva and Ravana both, वारणवारणाभैः resisting each other, बाहूत्तमैः endowed with mighty arms, निवारयन्तौ keeping away each other, चिरेणकालेन for long time, तु, सम्प्रयुक्तौ engaged in combat, आशु swiftly, मण्डलमार्गम् going round and round, संचेरतुः remained moving.
explanation: Both Ravana and Sugriva endowed with mighty arms, were resisting each other, and keeping away one another engaging in comb at for a long time. They kept on moving, going around each other swiftly.
hindi: मतवाले हाथियों के समान सुग्रीव और रावण गजराज के शुण्ड-दण्ड की भाँति मोटे एवं बलिष्ठ बाहुदण्डों द्वारा एक-दूसरे के दाँव को रोकते हुए बहुत देर तक बड़े आवेश के साथ युद्ध करते और शीघ्रतापूर्वक पैंतरे बदलते रहे

shloka_text: तौ परस्परमासाद्य यत्तावन्योन्यसूदने । मार्जाराविव भक्ष्यार्थेऽवितस्थाते मुहुर्मुहुः ।।6.40.22।।
translation: अन्योन्यसूदने intending to destroy each other, यत्तौ approaching each other, तौ both, परस्परम् one another, आसाद्य to kill, भक्ष्यार्थे for the sake of food, मार्जाराविव like cats, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अवितस्थाते falsely.
explanation: Both of them intent on destroying each other were approaching one another and now and then growling like cats for the sake of food.
hindi: वे परस्पर भिड़कर एक-दूसरे को मार डालने का प्रयत्न कर रहे थे। जैसे दो बिलाव किसी भक्ष्य वस्तु के लिये क्रोधपूर्वक स्थित हो परस्पर दृष्टिपात कर बारंबार गुर्राते रहते हैं, उसी तरह रावण और सुग्रीव भी लड़ रहे थे

shloka_text: मण्डलानि विचित्राणि स्थानानि विविधानि च । मूत्रकाणि चित्राणि गतप्रत्यागतानि च ।।6.40.23।।
