translation: तस्मिन् काले in the meantime, धरणीधरसङ्काशः who resembled mountain, अरिन्दमः tamer of enemies, हनुमान् Hanuman, सुदुरासदम् difficult to overpower, महावृक्षम् huge tree, उद्यम्य taking up, राक्षसानाम् at Rakshasas, तत् those, सैन्यम् army, कालाग्निरिव like fire at dissolution, निर्दहन् created havoc, सःhe, वानरःVanara, युधि in combat, बहुभिः many, वृक्षैः trees, निःसज्ञम् fighting, चकार went about
explanation: In the meantime, Hanuman, who resembled a mountain, a tamer of enemies, who is difficult to overpower, taking up huge trees fighting with Rakshasas created havoc like fire at the time of dissolution and went about.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 86.18 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: विध्वंसन्तंतरसादृष्टवैवपवनात्मजम् । राक्षसानांसहस्राणिहनूमन्तमवाकिरन् ।।6.86.20।।
translation: राक्षसानाम् at Rakshasas, सहस्राणि thousands, तरसा at great speed, विध्वंसयन्तम् destroying, पवनात्मजम् WindGod's son, दृष्टवैव seeing, अवाकिरन् surrounded
explanation: Seeing the wind god's son destroying, thousands of Rakshasas got together surrounding him.
hindi: पवनपुत्र हनुमान् को इस प्रकार वेगपूर्वक विनाश करते देखकर हज़ारों राक्षसों ने उन्हें चारों ओर से घेर लिया

shloka_text: शितशूलधराश्शूलैरसिभिश्चासिपाणयः । शक्तिहस्ताश्चभिश्शक्तिपट्टसै: पट्टसायुधाः ।।6.86.21।।
translation: शितशूलधराः holding sharp trident, शूलैः trident, असिपाणयः swords in hand, असिभिः च swords, शक्तिहस्ताः javelins in hand, शक्तीभिः च javelins, पट्टिशायुधाः armed with spears, पट्टिशैः spears, शुभदर्शनैः bright looking, कुन्तै: च glowing, शतशः iron bars, शतघ्नीभिः like fire, आयसैः iron, मुद्गरैरपि axes also, घोरैः dreadful, परशुभिश्चैव hammers, भिदनिपालैश्च Bhindi Palas, वज्रकल्पैः like thunderbolt, मुष्टिभिः fists, अशनिसन्निभैः like lightning, तलैः descended, पर्वतोपमम् like mountain, समन्तात् all over, समासाद्य collected, अभिजघ्नुः skilful, सङ्ग्रुद्धः furious, तेषाम् them, महत् huge, कदनम् war, चकार took place
explanation: Between the skilful Rakshasas armed with sharp tridents, swords, javelins in hand, with spears in hand, bright iron bars glowing like fire, with iron axes, dreadful hammers, Bhindi palas and Hanuman, with thunderbolt like fists that descended like lightning, and slaps which descended like mountains, a huge skillful war took place.
hindi: तीखे शूल लिये राक्षस शूलों से, तलवारधारी तलवारों से, शक्तिधारी शक्तियों से, पट्टिशधारी पट्टिशों से; परिघ, गदा, सुन्दर कुन्त, सैकड़ों शतघ्नियों, लौह-मुद्गरों, भयंकर फरसों तथा भिण्डिपालों से; और वज्र-सम मुक्कों तथा बिजली-सी चोट करने वाली हथेलियों से भी वे राक्षस पर्वत-सम विशालकाय हनुमान् पर चारों ओर से टूट पड़े; किन्तु उन पर भी क्रुद्ध होकर हनुमान् ने महान् संहार कर डाला

shloka_text: परिघैश्चगदाभिश्चकुन्तैश्चशुभदर्शनैः । शतशश्चशतघ्नीभिरायसैरपिमुद्गरैः ।।6.86.22।।
translation: शितशूलधराः holding sharp trident, शूलैः trident, असिपाणयः swords in hand, असिभिः च swords, शक्तिहस्ताः javelins in hand, शक्तीभिः च javelins, पट्टिशायुधाः armed with spears, पट्टिशैः spears, शुभदर्शनैः bright looking, कुन्तै: च glowing, शतशः iron bars, शतघ्नीभिः like fire, आयसैः iron, मुद्गरैरपि axes also, घोरैः dreadful, परशुभिश्चैव hammers, भिदनिपालैश्च Bhindi Palas, वज्रकल्पैः like thunderbolt, मुष्टिभिः fists, अशनिसन्निभैः like lightning, तलैः descended, पर्वतोपमम् like mountain, समन्तात् all over, समासाद्य collected, अभिजघ्नुः skilful, सङ्ग्रुद्धः furious, तेषाम् them, महत् huge, कदनम् war, चकार took place
explanation: Between the skilful Rakshasas armed with sharp tridents, swords, javelins in hand, with spears in hand, bright iron bars glowing like fire, with iron axes, dreadful hammers, Bhindi palas and Hanuman, with thunderbolt like fists that descended like lightning, and slaps which descended like mountains, a huge skillful war took place.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 86.21 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: घोरैःपरशुभिश्चैवभिदनिपालैश्चराक्षसाः । मुष्टिभिर्वज्रकल्पैश्चतलैरशनिसन्निभैः ।।6.86.23।।
translation: शितशूलधराः holding sharp trident, शूलैः trident, असिपाणयः swords in hand, असिभिः च swords, शक्तिहस्ताः javelins in hand, शक्तीभिः च javelins, पट्टिशायुधाः armed with spears, पट्टिशैः spears, शुभदर्शनैः bright looking, कुन्तै: च glowing, शतशः iron bars, शतघ्नीभिः like fire, आयसैः iron, मुद्गरैरपि axes also, घोरैः dreadful, परशुभिश्चैव hammers, भिदनिपालैश्च Bhindi Palas, वज्रकल्पैः like thunderbolt, मुष्टिभिः fists, अशनिसन्निभैः like lightning, तलैः descended, पर्वतोपमम् like mountain, समन्तात् all over, समासाद्य collected, अभिजघ्नुः skilful, सङ्ग्रुद्धः furious, तेषाम् them, महत् huge, कदनम् war, चकार took place
explanation: Between the skilful Rakshasas armed with sharp tridents, swords, javelins in hand, with spears in hand, bright iron bars glowing like fire, with iron axes, dreadful hammers, Bhindi palas and Hanuman, with thunderbolt like fists that descended like lightning, and slaps which descended like mountains, a huge skillful war took place.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 86.21 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: अभिजघ्नुःसमासाद्यसमन्तात्पर्वतोपमम् । तेषामपि च सङ्ग्रुद्धश्चकारकदनंमहत् ।।6.86.24।।
translation: शितशूलधराः holding sharp trident, शूलैः trident, असिपाणयः swords in hand, असिभिः च swords, शक्तिहस्ताः javelins in hand, शक्तीभिः च javelins, पट्टिशायुधाः armed with spears, पट्टिशैः spears, शुभदर्शनैः bright looking, कुन्तै: च glowing, शतशः iron bars, शतघ्नीभिः like fire, आयसैः iron, मुद्गरैरपि axes also, घोरैः dreadful, परशुभिश्चैव hammers, भिदनिपालैश्च Bhindi Palas, वज्रकल्पैः like thunderbolt, मुष्टिभिः fists, अशनिसन्निभैः like lightning, तलैः descended, पर्वतोपमम् like mountain, समन्तात् all over, समासाद्य collected, अभिजघ्नुः skilful, सङ्ग्रुद्धः furious, तेषाम् them, महत् huge, कदनम् war, चकार took place
explanation: Between the skilful Rakshasas armed with sharp tridents, swords, javelins in hand, with spears in hand, bright iron bars glowing like fire, with iron axes, dreadful hammers, Bhindi palas and Hanuman, with thunderbolt like fists that descended like lightning, and slaps which descended like mountains, a huge skillful war took place.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 86.21 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: स ददर्शकपिश्रेष्ठमचलोपममिन्द्रजित् । सूदमानमसन्त्रस्तममित्रान् पवनात्मजम् ।।6.86.25।।
translation: सःइन्द्रजित् that Indrajith, कपिश्रेष्ठम् foremost of monkeys, अचलोपमम् like mountain, असन्त्रस्तम् without weapon, अमित्रान् enemies, सूदमानम् fearless, पवनात्मजम् Hanuman, ददर्श witnessed
explanation: Indrajith witnessed Hanuman, the foremost of Vanaras without weapons, fearlessly fighting.
hindi: इन्द्रजित् ने पर्वत-सम उस वानरश्रेष्ठ, निर्भय पवनपुत्र हनुमान् को शत्रुओं का संहार करते देखा

shloka_text: स सारथिमुवाचेदंयाहियत्रैषवानरः । क्षयमेवहिनःकुर्याद्राक्षसामुपेक्षितः ।।6.86.26।।
translation: सः he, सारथिम् charioteer, इदम् thus, उवाचspoke, एषःin that way, वानरःVanara, यत्र there, याहि if not, उपेक्षितःkeep waiting, नः not, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, क्षयम् reduced, कुर्यादेवहि no doubt destroy
explanation: Thus Indrajith spoke to the charioteer "This Vanara will no doubt reduce the Rakshasa army if we keep waiting."
hindi: उसने अपने सारथी से कहा—‘वहाँ ले चलो, जहाँ यह वानर है; यदि इसकी उपेक्षा की गयी, तो यह अकेला ही हमारे राक्षसों का सर्वनाश कर देगा’

shloka_text: इत्युक्तस्सारथिस्तेनययौयत्र न मारुतिः । वहन् परमदुर्धर्षंस्थितमिन्द्रजितंरथे ।।6.86.27।।
translation: तेन therefore, इति this way, उक्तः spoke, सारथिः charioteer, रथे chariot, स्थितम् seated, परमदुर्धर्षम् highly difficult to encounter, इन्द्रजितम् Indrajith, वहन् to that place, मारुतिःMaruthi, यत्र there, ययौ went
explanation: On hearing Indrajith who is highly difficult to encounter speaking in that way his charioteer drove Indrajith, to that place, where Maruthi was.
hindi: इस प्रकार आज्ञा पाकर सारथी अत्यन्त दुर्धर्ष इन्द्रजित् को रथ में लिये हुए वहाँ ले गया, जहाँ हनुमान् थे

shloka_text: सोऽभ्युपेत्यशरान्खङ्गान्पट्टसासिपरश्वधान् । अभ्यवर्षतदुर्धर्षःकपिमूर्थनिराक्षसः ।।6.86.28।।
translation: दुर्धर्षःdreadful, सःराक्षसः that Rakshasa, अभ्युपेत्य going near, कपिमूर्थनि face of monkey, शरान् arrows, खङ्गान् swords, पट्टसासिपरश्वधान् iron bars, spears, अभ्यवर्षत rained
explanation: Going near Hanuman, that dreadful Rakshasa, rained arrows, spears, swords and iron bars on the face of Hanuman.
hindi: निकट पहुँचकर उस दुर्धर्ष राक्षस इन्द्रजित् ने बाणों, तलवारों, पट्टिशों तथा फरसों की वर्षा हनुमान् के सिर पर कर दी

shloka_text: तानिशस्त्राणिघोराणिप्रतिगृह्य स मारुतिः । रोषेणमहताविष्टोवाक्यंचेदमुवाच ह ।।6.86.29।।
translation: सःमारुतिः he Maruthi, घोराणि frightening, तानिशस्त्राणि those weapons, प्रतिगृह्य receiving, महता great, रोषेण rage, आविष्टः overcome by, इदंवाक्यम् this words, उवाच spoke
explanation: Receiving those frightening weapons, Maruthi spoke these words overcome by anger.
hindi: उन भयंकर शस्त्रों को झेलकर हनुमान् अत्यन्त क्रोध से भर उठे और यह कहा—

shloka_text: युध्यस्वयदिशूरोऽसिरावणात्मजदुर्मते । वायुपुत्रंसमासाद्य न जीवन् प्रतियास्यसि ।।6.86.30।।
translation: दुर्मते evil minded, रावणात्मज Indrajith, शूरः warrior, असियदि such, युध्यस्व fight, वायुपुत्रम् son of WindGod, समासाद्य having met, जीवन् life, न प्रतियास्यसि not return alive
explanation: "Evil minded hero! Fight with me back having met, you shall not return alive."
hindi: ‘हे दुर्बुद्धि रावणपुत्र! यदि तू सचमुच शूरवीर है, तो युद्ध कर; पवनपुत्र के सामने आकर तू जीवित लौट नहीं पायेगा

shloka_text: बाहुभ्यांसम्प्रतियुध्यस्वयदिमेद्वन्द्वमाहवे । वेगंसहस्वदुर्बुद्धेततस्त्वंरक्षसांवरः ।।6.86.31।।
translation: दुर्बुद्धे cruel, मे with me, द्वन्द्वम् duel, यदि if you like, बाहुभ्याम् arms, सम्प्रयुध्यस्व in duel war, आहवे come, वेगम् quickly, सहस्व with stand, ततः then, त्वम् you, रक्षसाम् among Rakshasas, वरःforemost
explanation: "Fight with me for a duel war if you like. Come quickly and with stand, then you will become foremost among Rakshasas.
hindi: यदि तुझमें साहस हो, तो मुझसे केवल भुजाओं से द्वन्द्वयुद्ध कर; हे दुर्बुद्धि, मेरे वेग को सह ले, तभी तू राक्षसों में श्रेष्ठ कहलाने योग्य होगा’

shloka_text: हनूमन्तंजिघांसन्तंसमुद्यतशरासनम् । रावणात्मजमाचष्टे लक्ष्मणाय विभीषण: ।।6.86.32।।
translation: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, समुद्यतशरासनम् having seated, रावणात्मजम् Indrajith, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, जिघांसन्तम् is ready to attack, लक्ष्मणाय Lakshmana, आचष्टे told
explanation: "Vibheeshana told Lakshmana that Indarjith having seated is ready to attack Hanuman."
hindi: धनुष उठाये, हनुमान् का वध करने पर उतारू उस रावणपुत्र को विभीषण ने लक्ष्मण को दिखाते हुए कहा—

shloka_text: यस्सवासवनिर्जेतारावणस्यात्मसम्भवः । स एषरथमास्थायहनूमन्तंजिघांसति ।।6.86.33।।
translation: वासवनिर्जेता conqueror of Indra, सः he, यः that, रावणस्यआत्मसम्भवः Ravana's son, सःएषः in that way, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय reaching, हनूमन्तम् at Hanuman, जिघांसति seeks to kill
explanation: "Ravana's son, the conqueror of Indra, having taken a se at in the chariot seeks to kill Hanuman."
hindi: ‘इन्द्र को जीतने वाला रावण का यह पुत्र—यही अपने रथ पर खड़ा होकर हनुमान् का वध करना चाहता है

shloka_text: तमप्रतिमसंस्थानैश्शरैश्शत्रुनिवारणैः । जीवितान्तकरैर्घोरैःसौमित्रेरावणिंजहि ।।6.86.34।।
translation: सौमित्रे Saumithri, अप्रतिमसंस्थानैः of incomparable craftsmanship, शत्रुनिवारणैः formidable weapons, जीवितान्तकरैः capable of killing enemies, घोरैः dreadful, शरैः arrows, तम् them, रावणिम् Ravana's son, जहि kill him
explanation: "O Saumithri! Kill that son of Ravana with your formidable weapons of incomparable craftsmanship, dreadful arrows capable of killing enemies."
hindi: हे सौमित्र! अनुपम, शत्रु-निवारक, प्राणान्तक भयंकर बाणों से इस रावणि इन्द्रजित् का वध कर डालो’

shloka_text: इति एवम् उक्तः तु तदा महात्मा विभीषणेन अरिविभीषणेन । ददर्श तं पर्वतसंनिकाशं रथस्थितं भीमबलं दुरासदम् ।।6.86.35।।
explanation: Thus addressed by Vibhishana, the terrifier of foes, the great-souled one then beheld that dreadful, mighty and unassailable warrior, huge as a mountain, standing in his chariot.
hindi: शत्रुओं को भयभीत करने वाले उस महात्मा विभीषण के इस प्रकार कहने पर, तब लक्ष्मण ने पर्वत-सम विशालकाय, अत्यन्त बलशाली तथा दुर्जय उस इन्द्रजित् को रथ पर खड़ा देखा

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वातुसौमित्रिंजातहर्षोविभीषणः । धनुष्पाणिंनमादायत्वरमाणोजगामसः ।।6.87.1।।
translation: सः he, विभीषणःVibheeshana, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, जातहर्षः satisfied, धनुष्पाणिम् wielding bow, न him, आदाय taking, त्वरमाणःquickly, जगाम went
explanation: Vibheeshana, having spoken that way, Saumithri was satisfied. Wielding a bow Saumithri went quickly with Vibheeshana.
comments: Vibheeshana tells Lakshmana that Indrajith should be killed before the completion of fire sacrifice started by Indrajith.
hindi: यह कहकर हर्षित विभीषण धनुष हाथ में लिये लक्ष्मण को साथ लेकर शीघ्रता से आगे बढ़ चले

shloka_text: अविदूरंततोगत्वाप्रविश्यतुमहद्वनम् । दर्शमामासतत्कर्मलक्ष्मणातविभीषणः ।।6.87.2।।
translation: विभीषणःVibheeshana, ततः thereafter, अविदूरम् little distance, गत्वा went, महत् great, वनम् forest, प्रविश्य entered, लक्ष्मणाय with Lakshmana, तत् then, कर्म What to do, दर्शयामास showed
explanation: Thereafter Vibheeshana followed Lakshmana for a small distance to the forest and showed him What to do.
hindi: कुछ ही दूर जाकर तथा एक विशाल वन में प्रवेश करके विभीषण ने लक्ष्मण को वह स्थान दिखाया, जहाँ इन्द्रजित् अपना अनुष्ठान कर रहा था

shloka_text: नीलजीमूतसङ्काशंन्यग्रोधंभीमदर्शनम् । तेजस्वीरावणभ्रातालक्ष्मणायन्यवेदयत् ।।6.87.3।।
translation: तेजस्वी brilliant, रावणभ्राता Ravana's brother, लक्ष्मणाय to Lakshmana, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशम् resembling dark clouds, भीमदर्शनम् frightening to look, न्यग्रोधम् a banyan tree, लक्ष्मणायन्यवेदयत् showed to Lakshmana
explanation: Vibheeshana, the brilliant brother of Ravana, showed Lakshmana a banyan tree resembling a dark cloud, frightening to look at.
hindi: तेजस्वी रावण-भ्राता विभीषण ने लक्ष्मण को नीले मेघ-सा काला, भयंकर दिखने वाला वह न्यग्रोध वृक्ष दिखाया

shloka_text: इहोपहारंभूतानांबलवान्रावणात्मजः । उपहृत्यततःपश्चात्सङ्ग्राममभिवर्तते ।।6.87.4।।
translation: बलवान् mighty, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, इह here, भूतानाम् for all beings, उपहारम् oblations, उपहृत्य having offered, पश्चात् after that, सङ्ग्रामम् to battlefield, अभिवर्तते comes
explanation: "Mighty son of Ravana having offered oblations for all beings he comes to the battlefield. (Said Vibheeshana)"
hindi: ‘यहीं वह बलवान् रावणपुत्र भूतों को बलि अर्पित करके, उसके बाद ही युद्ध की ओर प्रवृत्त होता है

shloka_text: अदृश्टस्सर्वभूतानांततोभवतिराक्षसः । निहन्तिसमरेशत्रून् बध्नाति च शरोत्तमैः ।।6.87.5।।
translation: ततः thereafter, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सर्वभूतानाम् for all beings, अदृश्यःinvisible, भवति becomes, समरे battle, शत्रून् enemies, निहन्ति kills, शरोत्तमैः best arrows, बध्नाति binds
explanation: "Thereafter he becomes invisible for all beings and kills his enemies with the best of arrows and binds them."
hindi: उसके बाद वह राक्षस सब प्राणियों के लिये अदृश्य हो जाता है, और युद्ध में अपने उत्तम बाणों से शत्रुओं का वध तथा बन्धन करता है

shloka_text: तमप्रविष्टंन्यग्रोधंबलिनंरावणात्मजम् । विध्वंसयशरैर्दीप्टै: सरथंसाश्वसारथिम् ।।6.87.6।।
translation: न्यग्रोधम् banyan tree, अप्रविष्टम् entering, बलिनम् mighty, सरथम् his chariot, साश्वसारथिम् horses and charioteer, तम् them, रावणात्मजम् Indrajith, दीप्टै: flaming, शरैः arrows, विध्वंसय destroy
explanation: "Before he enters the banyan tree, you destroy Indrajith, with his chariot, horses and charioteer by the flaming arrows"
hindi: इससे पहले कि वह बलवान् रावणपुत्र इस न्यग्रोध वृक्ष में प्रवेश करे, अपने तीखे बाणों से उसे रथ, घोड़ों तथा सारथी-सहित नष्ट कर दो’

shloka_text: तथेत्युक्त्वामहातेजास्सौमित्रिर्मित्रनन्दनः । बभूवावस्थितस्तत्रचित्रंविस्फारयन्? धनुः ।।6.87.7।।
translation: महातेजाः brilliant, मित्रनन्दनः delight of friends, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, तथेति like that, उक्त्वा spoken, चित्रम् wonderful, धनुः bow, विस्फारयन् twanging, तत्र there, अवस्थितः stood, बभूव remained
explanation: Brilliant Saumithri, delighted by his friends, twanging his wonderful bow stood there, after Vibheeshana had spoken to him.
hindi: ‘ऐसा ही होगा’ कहकर मित्रों को आनन्द देने वाले तेजस्वी सौमित्र लक्ष्मण अपना सुन्दर धनुष ताने वहीं डट गये

shloka_text: स रथेनाग्निवर्णेनबलवान्रावणात्मजः । इन्द्रजित्कवचीखङ्गीसध्वजःप्रत्यदृश्यत ।।6.87.8।।
translation: बलवान् endowed with mighty prowess, रावणात्मजःIndrajith, कवची shield, खङ्गी sword, सध्वजःdecorated with post, सःइन्द्रजित् that Indrajith, अग्निवर्णेन glowing like gold, रथेन in the chariot, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared
explanation: Indrajith, who was endowed with mighty prowess, armed with shield and sword, appeared like glowing gold in the chariot decorated with a post.
hindi: तभी वह बलवान् रावणपुत्र इन्द्रजित् अपने अग्नि-वर्ण रथ पर, कवच और तलवार धारण किये, ध्वजा-सहित प्रकट हुआ

shloka_text: तमुवाचमहातेजाःपौलस्त्यमपराजितम् । समह्वयेत्वांसमरेसम्यग्युद्धंप्रयच्छमे ।।6.87.9।।
translation: महातेजाः highly energetic, अपराजितम् who has never been defeated, तम् him, पौलस्त्यम् of Paulastya clan, उवाच said, ताम् to him, समरे in battle, समाह्वये challenging you, सम्यक् encounter, मे me, युद्धम् fight, प्रयच्छ directly
explanation: Lakshmana of extraordinary energy, spoke to Indrajith of the Paulastya clan," I challenge you to fight in battle directly. Fight with me."
hindi: उस तेजस्वी लक्ष्मण ने उस अपराजित पौलस्त्य इन्द्रजित् से कहा—‘मैं तुझे युद्ध के लिये ललकारता हूँ; मुझसे उचित युद्ध कर’

shloka_text: एवमुक्तोमहातेजामनस्वीरावणात्मजः । अब्रवीत्परुषंवाक्यंतत्रदृष्टवाविभीषणम् ।।6.87.10।।
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, महातेजाः highly energetic, मनस्वी minded, रावणात्मजः Indrajith, तत्र there, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, दृष्टवा seeing, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken
explanation: Having spoken that way, highly energetic and strong minded Indrajith seeing Vibheeshana spoke to him harshly as follows.
hindi: यह सुनकर उस तेजस्वी, अभिमानी रावणपुत्र ने वहाँ विभीषण को देखकर कठोर वचन कहे—

shloka_text: इहत्वंजातसम्वृद्धःसाक्षाद्भ्रातापितुर्मम । कथंद्रुह्यसिपुत्रस्यपितृव्योममराक्षस ।।6.87.11।।
translation: राक्षस Rakshasa, त्वम् you, इह here, जातसम्वृद्धःborn and brought up, मम my, पितुः father, साक्षात् real, भ्राता brother, मम my, पितृव्यः father too, पुत्रस्यकथम् with son how, द्रुह्यसि hostile
explanation: "O Rakshasa! You are born here and brought up by my father. You are my father'sbrother also. How can you be hostile to your son?"
hindi: ‘तू यहीं जन्मा और पला, साक्षात् मेरे पिता का भाई है; हे राक्षस, मेरा चाचा होकर भी तू अपने भतीजे के साथ द्रोह कैसे कर रहा है?

shloka_text: न ज्ञातित्वं न सौहार्धं न जातिस्तवदुर्मते । प्रमाणं न च सौदर्यं न धर्मोधर्मदूषण ।।6.87.12।।
translation: दुर्मते evil minded, धर्मदूषण vitiating righteousness, तव your, ज्ञातित्वम् race, न प्रमाणम् not valuing, सौहार्दम् affection, न not, जातिः clan, न not, सौदर्यम् brotherly feeling, न not, धर्मः righteousness, न not
explanation: "Evil minded Vibheeshana! You are vitiating righteousness, have no value to your race, no affection to your clan, no brotherly feeling and have no righteousness."
hindi: हे दुर्बुद्धि! न तुझे कुटुम्ब का ध्यान है, न मैत्री का, न जाति का; हे धर्म को कलंकित करने वाले, न तुझे भाईचारे का प्रमाण है और न ही धर्म का

shloka_text: शोच्यस्त्वमसिदुर्बुद्धेनिन्दनीयश्चसाधुभिः । यस्त्वंस्वजनमुत्सृज्यपरभृत्यत्वमागतः ।।6.87.13।।
translation: दुर्बुद्धे evil minded, त्वम् you, शोच्यः think, साधुभिः pitiable, निन्दनीयश्च blamed, असि also, यःत्वम् your, स्वजनम् your own people, उत्सृज्य sought, परभृत्यत्वम् enemy's protection, आगतः came
explanation: "You are evil minded, think. You are pitiable and to be blamed for you have abandoned your own people and sought the enemy's protection."
hindi: हे दुर्बुद्धि! तू शोचनीय है और सज्जनों द्वारा निन्दा के योग्य है, जो अपने स्वजन को त्यागकर पराये की सेवा में लग गया है

shloka_text: नैतछचिथिलयाबुद्ध्यात्वंवेसतिमहदन्तरम् । क्व च स्वजनसम्वासःक्व च नीचपराश्रयः ।।6.87.14।।
translation: स्वजनसम्वासः living with own people, क्व च is it that, नीचपराश्रयः seeking refuge from strangers, क्वच is it that, एतत् this, महत् great, अन्तरम् understanding, त्वम् you, शिथिलयता slackened, बुद्ध्या intellect, न वेसति not knowing
explanation: "You do not seem to have an understanding of the difference between living with one's own people and seeking refuge from strangers. Your intellect has slackened you are not knowing."
hindi: अपनी शिथिल बुद्धि के कारण तू इस बड़े अन्तर को समझ ही नहीं पाता—कहाँ अपने स्वजनों के साथ रहना, और कहाँ किसी नीच का आश्रय लेना!

shloka_text: गुणवान्वापरजनःस्वजनोनिर्गुणोऽपिवा । निर्गुणःस्वजनःश्रेयान् यःपरःपरएवसः ।।6.87.15।।
translation: परजनः others, गुणवान्वा virtuous, स्वजनः own people, निर्गुणोपिवा not virtuous also, निर्गुणः not virtuous, स्वजनः own people, श्रेयान् welfare, यः that which, परः others, सः he, परएवहि even if he
explanation: "Even if others are virtuous and your own people are not virtuous also one should seek the refuge of one's own people. Strangers are always strangers."
hindi: चाहे पराया गुणवान् हो और अपना स्वजन निर्गुण ही क्यों न हो, फिर भी निर्गुण स्वजन ही श्रेष्ठ है; जो पराया है, वह पराया ही रहता है

shloka_text: यसस्स्वपक्षंपरित्यज्यपरपक्षंनिषेवते । स स्वपक्षेक्ष्यंप्राप्तेपश्चास्त्तैरेवहन्यते ।।6.87.16।।
translation: यः he who, स्वपक्षम् own side, परित्यज्य renouncing, परपक्षम् others side, निषेवते seeks refuge, सःhe, स्वपक्षे own side, क्ष्यम् destruction, प्राप्ते happens, पश्चात् whose refuge was sought, तैरेव by them only, हन्यते destroyed
explanation: "He who renounces his own kind and seeks refuge from others, will be destroyed by others whose refuge he sought when his own people are destroyed."
hindi: जो अपना पक्ष छोड़कर पराये पक्ष की सेवा करता है, अपने पक्ष के नष्ट हो जाने पर वह बाद में उन्हीं के हाथों मारा जाता है

shloka_text: निरनुक्रोशताचेयंयादृशीतेनिशाचर । स्वजनेनत्वयाशक्यंपौरुषंरावणानुज ।।6.87.17।।
translation: रावणानुज Ravana's brother, निशाचर night ranger, ते you, इयम् this, यादृशी way, निरनुक्रोशता ruthlessness, पौरुषम् manliness, स्वजनेन own people, त्वया by you, शक्यम् is possible
explanation: "O Ravana's brother! You have shown ruthlessness this way. O night ranger! Only you could exhibit this kind of manliness."
hindi: हे निशाचर! तेरी यह जो निर्दयता है, हे रावणानुज, ऐसा पौरुष तो तुझे अपने स्वजनों के प्रति ही दिखाना चाहिये था’

shloka_text: इत्युक्तोभ्रातृपुत्रेणप्रत्युवाचविभीषणः । अजानन्निवमछचीलंकिंराक्षसविकत्थसे ।।6.87.18।।
translation: भ्रातृपुत्रेण brother's son, इति thus, उक्तःhaving spoken, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied back, राक्षस Rakshasa, मछचीलम् my disposition, अजानन्निव as though you did not know, किम् why, विकत्थसे speak like this
explanation: Indrajith having spoken like that, Vibheeshana replied," why do you speak like that as though you do not know my disposition?"
hindi: अपने भतीजे की यह बात सुनकर विभीषण ने उत्तर दिया—‘मानो मेरे स्वभाव को न जानते हुए ही, हे राक्षस, तू क्यों इतनी डींगें हाँक रहा है?

shloka_text: राक्षसेन्द्रसुतासाधोपारुष्यंत्यजगौरवात् । कुलेयद्यप्यहंजातोरक्षसांक्रूरकर्मणाम् ।।6.87.19।। गुणोयःप्रथमोनृणंतन्मेशीलमराक्षसम् ।
translation: असाधो impious, राक्षसेन्द्रसुत son of Rakshasa king, गौरवात् respectfully, पारुष्यम् manliness, त्यज renounce, अहम् I, क्रूरकर्मणाम् cruel deeds, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, कुले clan, जातःयद्यपि though born, नृणाम् king, यः he who, प्रथमः primary, गुणः quality, तत् that, मे I, अराक्षसम् not Rakshasa like, शीलम् nature
explanation: "Impious son of Rakshasa king! Though born in the Rakshasa clan I renounced cruel deeds and followed respectfully manliness as my primary quality. My nature is not like that of Rakshasas."
hindi: हे राक्षसराज-पुत्र, हे दुष्ट! सम्मान के कारण अपनी कठोरता त्याग दे। यद्यपि मैं क्रूरकर्मा राक्षसों के कुल में जन्मा हूँ, तथापि मनुष्यों का जो प्रथम गुण है, वही मेरा स्वभाव है—राक्षसों-सा नहीं

shloka_text: न रमेदारुणेनाहं न चाधर्मेणवैरमे ।।6.87.20।। भ्रात्राविषशीलोऽपिकथंभ्रातानिरस्यते ।
translation: अहम् I, दारुणेन cruel, न रमे not revel, अधर्मेण च unrighteousness, न रमेवै not follow, विषमशीलोऽपि of unfavourable disposition, भ्राता a brother, भ्रात्रा by a brother, कथम् how, निरस्यते expelled
explanation: "I do not delight in cruel deeds, nor follow unrighteousness. Or else because of unfavourable disposition how can a brother be expelled by a brother?"
hindi: मुझे न तो क्रूरता में आनन्द आता है, न अधर्म में; भला किसी भाई का स्वभाव विषम होने मात्र से उसे कैसे त्यागा जा सकता है?

shloka_text: धर्मात्प्रच्युतशीलंहिपुरुषंपापनिश्चयम् ।।6.87.21।। त्यक्त्वासुखमवाप्नोतिहस्तादाशीविषंयथा ।
translation: धर्मात् righteous, प्रच्युतशीलम् who has renounced, पापनिश्चयम् of sinful deeds, पुरुषम् man, हस्तात् from hand, आशीविषंयथा venomous serpent, त्यक्त्वा renouncing, सुखम् happiness, अवाप्नोति attains
explanation: "The association of one who has renounced righteousness and is of sinful deeds is left by a righteous man who undoubtedly attains happiness, is like shaking of a venomous serpent from the hand."
hindi: जो पुरुष धर्म से च्युत तथा पाप में दृढ़ हो चुका है, उसे त्यागकर मनुष्य वैसे ही सुख पाता है, जैसे हाथ से विषधर सर्प को छोड़ देने पर

shloka_text: परस्वहरणेयुक्तंपरदाराभिमर्शकम् ।।6.87.22।। त्याज्यमाहुर्दुरात्मानंवेश्मप्रज्वलितंयथा ।
translation: परस्वहरणे seizing property of others, युक्तम् united, परदाराभिमर्शकम् with others wife, दुरात्मानम् evil mindedness, प्रज्वलितम् burning, वेश्मयथा like house, त्याज्यम् getting out, आहुःit is said
explanation: "Seizing the property of others, uniting with others wife, evil mindedness is said to be given up like getting out of a burning house."
hindi: जो दूसरों का धन हड़पने में लगा हो, दूसरों की स्त्रियों पर कुदृष्टि रखता हो, ऐसे दुरात्मा को त्याग देना चाहिये, जैसे जलते हुए घर को त्याग दिया जाता है, ऐसा कहा गया है

shloka_text: परस्वानां च हरणंपरदाराभिमर्शनम् ।।6.87.23।। सुहृदामतिशङ्का च त्रयोदोषाःक्षयावहाः ।
translation: परस्वानाम् others wealth, हरणम् stealing, परदाराभिमर्शनम् possessing others wife, सुहृदाम् friends, अतिशङ्का च distrusting, त्रयःदोषाः three faults, क्षयावहाः will destroy
explanation: "Stealing the wealth of others, possessing others wife, distrusting friends, these three faults will destroy a person."
hindi: दूसरों का धन हड़पना, दूसरों की स्त्रियों पर बुरी दृष्टि रखना, तथा अपने मित्रों पर अत्यधिक सन्देह करना—ये तीन दोष विनाश लाने वाले हैं

shloka_text: महर्षीणां वधः घोरः सर्वदेवैः च विग्रहः । अभिमानः च कोपः च वैरित्वं प्रतिकूलता ।।6.87.24।।
translation: महर्षीणाम् sages, घोरः dreadful, वधः killing, सर्वदेवैः all deities, विग्रहः च haughtiness, अभिमानश्च irascibility, रोषः च anger, वैरित्वं च animosity, प्रतिकूलता refractoriness, जीवितैश्वरनाशनाः put an end to one's life, एते all these, दोषाः faults, मम my, भ्रातुः brother's, गुणान् qualities, तोयदाः rainy clouds, पर्वतानिव mountains, प्रच्छादयामासुः put an end to future
explanation: "Dreadful killing of sages, haughtiness towards deities, irascibility, anger, animosity, refractorinessall these faults will put an end to one's life. These faults have obscured my brother's future just as rainy clouds veil the mountain."
hindi: महर्षियों का भयंकर वध, समस्त देवताओं से वैर, अभिमान, क्रोध, शत्रुता तथा प्रतिकूलता—ये सब दोष मेरे भाई रावण के जीवन और ऐश्वर्य का नाश करने वाले हैं, और इन्होंने उसके गुणों को वैसे ही ढँक दिया है, जैसे बादल पर्वतों को ढँक देते हैं

shloka_text: एते दोषाः मम भ्रातुः जीवितैश्वर्यनाशनाः । गुणान् प्रच्छादयामासुः पर्वतान् इव तोयदाः ।।6.87.25।।
translation: महर्षीणाम् sages, घोरः dreadful, वधः killing, सर्वदेवैः all deities, विग्रहः च haughtiness, अभिमानश्च irascibility, रोषः च anger, वैरित्वं च animosity, प्रतिकूलता refractoriness, जीवितैश्वरनाशनाः put an end to one's life, एते all these, दोषाः faults, मम my, भ्रातुः brother's, गुणान् qualities, तोयदाः rainy clouds, पर्वतानिव mountains, प्रच्छादयामासुः put an end to future
explanation: "Dreadful killing of sages, haughtiness towards deities, irascibility, anger, animosity, refractorinessall these faults will put an end to one's life. These faults have obscured my brother's future just as rainy clouds veil the mountain."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 87.24 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: दोषैरेतैःपरित्यक्तोमयाभ्रातापितातव ।।6.87.26।। नेयमस्तिपुरीलङ्का न च त्वं न च तेपिता ।
translation: तव your, पिता father, भ्राता brother, एतैःदोषैः these faults, मया by me, परित्यक्तःaband oned, इयम् this, लङ्कापुरी Lanka city, न अस्ति not be there, त्वम् च you too, न not, ते to you, पिता च father, न not
explanation: "Because of these faults your father and my brother has been abandoned by me from this Lanka. This Lanka will not be there, nor your father and you too."
hindi: इन्हीं दोषों के कारण मैंने अपने भाई, तेरे पिता को त्याग दिया है; अब न तो यह लंकापुरी मेरी है, न तू मेरा है, और न ही तेरा पिता

shloka_text: अतिमाननी च बालश्चदुर्विनीतश्चराक्षस । बद्धस्त्वंकालपाशेनब्रूहिमांयद्यदिच्छसि ।।6.87.27।।
translation: राक्षस Rakshasa, अतिमानी च mean, बालश्च proud of might, दुर्विनीतश्च immoral, कालपाशेन by noose of death, बद्धः bound, त्वम् your, माम् my, यत् यत् Whatever, इच्छसि wish to say, ब्रूहि say
explanation: "O Rakshasa! You are mean, proud of might, immoral and bound by the noose of death. Whatever you wish to say you may say."
hindi: हे राक्षस! तू अत्यन्त अभिमानी, बालक-सा अपरिपक्व तथा उद्दण्ड है; तू काल के पाश में बँध चुका है—अब जो चाहे मुझसे कह ले

shloka_text: अद्यतेव्यसनंप्राप्तंकिंमांत्वामिहवक्ष्यसि । प्रवेष्टुं न त्वयाशक्यंन्यग्रोधंराक्षसाधम ।।6.87.28।।
translation: राक्षसाधम lowly among Rakshasas, किं why, त्वम् your, वक्ष्यसि to you, अद्य today, इह here, व्यसनम् worry, प्राप्तम्? come, त्वया by you, न्यग्रोधम् banyan tree, प्रवेष्टुम् entering, न शक्यम् not possible
explanation: "O Lowly Rakshasa! This worry has come to you today. Entering the banyan tree is not possible for you today."
hindi: आज तुझ पर विपत्ति आ पड़ी है; अब यहाँ और क्या कहेगा? हे राक्षसाधम, अब तू उस न्यग्रोध वृक्ष में प्रवेश नहीं कर पायेगा

shloka_text: धर्षयित्वा च काकुत्स्थं न शक्यंजीवितुंत्वया । युध्यस्वनरदेवेनलक्ष्मणेनरणेसह ।।6.87.29।। हतस्त्वंदेवताकार्यंकरिष्यसियमक्षये ।
translation: काकुत्स्थम् Kakuthsa, धर्षयित्वा clashing, त्वया by you, जीवितुम् life, न शक्यम् not possible, रणए in combat, नरदेवेन god of retribution, लक्ष्मणेनसहस with Lakshmana, युध्यस्व waging war, त्वम् you, हतः killed, यमक्षये abode of yama, देवताकार्यम् tasks of Devatas, करिष्यसि will be doing
explanation: "Clashing with Lakshmana of Kakuthsa clan is not possible for you. By waging war with Lakshmana, you will be killed and reaching the abode of the Lord of death. You will be doing tasks of deities of Devatas."
hindi: काकुत्स्थों पर आक्रमण करके तू जीवित नहीं रह सकता; अब नरदेव लक्ष्मण से युद्ध कर। मारा जाने पर तू यमलोक में जाकर देवताओं का कार्य सिद्ध करेगा’

shloka_text: निदर्शयस्व आत्मबलं समुद्यतं । कुरुष्व सर्वायुधसायकव्ययम् । न लक्ष्मणस्य एत्य हि बाणगोचरं । त्वम् अद्य जीवन् सबलो गमिष्यसि ।।6.87.30।।
explanation: 'Display your uplifted strength; expend all your weapons and shafts. For once come within the range of Lakshmana's arrows, you shall not this day go back alive with your army.'
hindi: अपना समस्त बल प्रकट कर दे, अपने सभी शस्त्र-अस्त्र चला डाल। क्योंकि एक बार लक्ष्मण के बाणों की सीमा में आ जाने पर, तू आज अपनी सेना-सहित जीवित नहीं लौट पायेगा’

shloka_text: विभीषणवच्श्रुत्वारावणिःक्रोधमूर्छितः । अब्रवीत्परुषंवाक्यंवेगेनाभ्युत्पपात च ।।6.88.1।।
translation: विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, रावणिः Indrajith, क्रोधमूर्छितः deluded with fury, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, वेगेन swiftly, अभ्युत्पपात च advanced.
explanation: Hearing Vibheeshana's words, Indrajith was deluded with fury, spoke harshly and advanced.
comments: Fierce combat takes place between Lakshmana and Indrajith challenging one another.

shloka_text: उद्यतायुधनिस्त्रिंशः रथे सुसमलङ्कृते । कालाश्वयुक्ते महति स्थितः कालान्तकोपमः ।।6.88.2।।
translation: उद्यतायुधनिस्त्रिंशः lifting the strong bow, सुसमलङ्कृते well decorated, कालाश्वयुक्ते yoked to black horses महति greatरथे chariot, स्थितःseated, कालान्तकोपमः like god of death, महाप्रमाणम् long, विपुलम् huge, वेगवत् endowed with great speed भीमम् terrific, धनुः bow, उद्यम्य holding अमित्रनाशनान् for the destruction of enemies, शरांश्च arrows also, परामृश्य drawing
explanation: Lifting his long, strong huge, great terrific bow endowed with high speed and holding it drawing arrows seated in a chariot well decorated, drawn by black horses, Indrajith looked like God of Death.

shloka_text: महाप्रमाणम् उद्यम्य विपुलं वेगवद्दृढम् । धनुः भीमं परामृश्य शरान् च अमित्रनाशनान् ।।6.88.3।।
translation: उद्यतायुधनिस्त्रिंशः lifting the strong bow, सुसमलङ्कृते well decorated, कालाश्वयुक्ते yoked to black horses महति greatरथे chariot, स्थितःseated, कालान्तकोपमः like god of death, महाप्रमाणम् long, विपुलम् huge, वेगवत् endowed with great speed भीमम् terrific, धनुः bow, उद्यम्य holding अमित्रनाशनान् for the destruction of enemies, शरांश्च arrows also, परामृश्य drawing
explanation: Lifting his long, strong huge, great terrific bow endowed with high speed and holding it drawing arrows seated in a chariot well decorated, drawn by black horses, Indrajith looked like God of Death.

shloka_text: तंददर्शमहेष्वासोरथस्थस्समलङ्कृतः । अलङ्कृतममित्रघ्नोराघवस्यानुजंबली ।।6.88.4।।
translation: महेष्वासः wielder of bow, रथे chariot, समलङ्कृतः decorated well, अमित्रघ्नः one who is capable of destroying enemies, बली strong, अलङ्कृतम् decorated, तम् him, राघवस्य Raghava's, अनुजम् brother, ददर्श saw
explanation: Wielding a bow, seated in a well decorated chariot, mighty destroyer of enemies (Indrajith) saw Raghava's brother.

shloka_text: हनुमत्पृष्ठरूढमुदस्थरविप्रभम् । उवाचैनंसमारब्ध: सौमित्रिंसविभीषणम् ।।6.88.5।। तांश्चवानरशार्दूलान् पश्यध्वंमेपराक्रमम् ।
translation: हनुमत्पृष्ठम् on the back of Hanuman, आरूढम् mounted, उदयस्थरविप्रभम् like the sun on eastern mountain, सविभीषणम् that Vibheeshana, एनंसौमित्रिम् Saumithri, तान् his, वानरशार्दूलान् च tiger among Vanaras, समारब्धः mounted, उवाच spoke, मे my, पराक्रमम् valour, पश्यध्वम् saw
explanation: Lakshmana was like the Sun on the eastern mountain mounted on the back of Hanuman, the tiger among Vanaras. He saw Vibheeshana and spoke.

shloka_text: अद्यमत्कार्मुकोत्सृष्टंशरवर्षंदुरासदम् ।।6.88.6।। मुक्तंवर्षमिवाकाशेवारयिष्यथसंयुगे ।
translation: अद्य and then, संयुगे in war, मत्कार्मुकोत्सृष्टम् see my valour and prowess, दुरासदम् difficult counter, आकाशे sky, मुक्तम् released, वर्षम् इव like rain, शरवर्षम् shower of arrows, वारयिष्यथ will not able to stop.
explanation: "See my valour and prowess now. I will release shower of arrows from the sky like rain and it will be difficult for others to counter."

shloka_text: अद्यवोमामकाबाणामहाकार्मुनिस्सृताः ।।6.88.7।। विधमिष्यन्तिगात्राणितूलराशिमिवानलः ।
translation: अद्य and then, महाकार्मुलनिःसृताः having been delivered from the great bow, मामकाः mine, बाणाः arrows, वः your, गात्राणि limbs, अनलः fire, तूलराशिमिव like bundle of cotton, विधमिष्यन्ति will pierce
explanation: "Then my arrows delivered from the great bow will pierce the limbs and burn like a bundle of cotton by fire."

shloka_text: तीक्षणसायकनिर्भन्नान्शूलशक्त्यृष्टितोमरैः ।।6.88.8।। अद्यवोगमयिष्यामिसर्वानेनयमक्षयम् ।
translation: अद्य and now, तीक्षणसायकनिर्भिन्नान् with sharp arrows, tridents, शूलशक्त्यृष्टितोमरैःशूल pikes, spears, lances, वः, सर्वानेव all, यमक्षयम् to the abode of Yama, गमयिष्यामि will send
explanation: "Now I will send you to the abode of Yama with sharp arrows, tridents, pikes, spears and lances."

shloka_text: क्षिपतश्शरवर्षाणिक्षिप्रहस्तस्यसम्युगे ।।6.88.9।। जीमूतस्येननदतःकःस्थास्यतिममाग्रतः ।
translation: क्षिप्रहस्तस्य swift hand, सम्युगे in battle, शरवर्षाणि rain of arrows, क्षिपत: release, जीमूतस्येव like rain cloud, नदतः roar, मम my, अग्रतः front, कः who, स्थास्यति can stand ?
explanation: "Who can stand in front of me if I release rain of arrows with my swift hand in the battle roaring like a rain cloud?"

shloka_text: रात्रियुद्धेमयापूर्वंवज्राशनिसमैःशरैः ।।6.88.10।। शायितौस्थोमयाभूमौविसंज्ञौसपुरस्सरौ ।
translation: पूर्वम् earlier, मया by me, रात्रियुद्धे in night war, सपुरस्सरौ you and your accomplice, वज्राशनिसमैःresembling thunderbolt, शरैः arrows, विसंज्ञौ released, भूमौ earth, शायितौ lay unconscious, स्थः laid low
explanation: "Earlier in the war at night, by the thunderbolt like arrows released by me on the Earth, you and your accomplice were made unconscious and laid low."

shloka_text: स्मृतिर्नतेऽस्तिवामन्येव्यक्तंवायमसादनम् ।।6.88.11।। आशीविषमिवक्रुद्धंयन्मांयोद्धुव्यवत्थित: ।
translation: ते you, स्मृतिः lost memory, नास्ति वा is it lost, आशीविषमिव like poisonous serpent, क्रुद्धम् enraged, माम् I am, योद्धुम् to fight, यत् that way, व्यवत्थितः stood here, व्यक्तम् said, यमक्षयम् Yama's abode, वा or else, मन्ये I think
explanation: "I am like a poisonous serpent, enraged. Is it that you have lost memory, or you stood here on the way to Yama's abode, I think."

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वाराक्षसेन्द्रस्यगर्जितंलक्ष्मणस्तदा ।।6.88.12।। अभीतवदनःक्रुद्धोरावणिंवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
translation: तदा then, लक्ष्मण: Lakshmana, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Indrajith's words, तत् that, गर्जितम् roaring, श्रुत्वा hearing, अभीतवदनः fearless countenance, क्रुद्धः angry, रावणिम् Indrajith, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoken
explanation: On hearing Indrajith's words, Lakshmana spoke these words in anger with fearless countenance.

shloka_text: उक्तश्चदुर्गमःपारःकार्याणांराक्षसत्वया ।।6.88.13।। कार्याणांकर्मणांपारंयोगच्छति स बुद्धिमान् ।
translation: राक्षस Rakshasa, त्यया your, कार्याणाम् undertakings, दुर्गमः difficult, पारः proclaimed, उक्तश्च have spoken, यः that which, कार्याणा undertakings, कर्मणाम् tasks, पारम् to the abode of Yama, गच्छति will go, सः he who is, बुद्धिमान् intelligent one
explanation: "Rakshasa! You have proclaimed that you will send me to Yama's abode and about the success in your undertakings even though it is not possible. He who is intelligent will succeed in his tasks (not in words alone).

shloka_text: सत्वमर्थस्यहीनार्थोदुरवासस्यकेनचित् ।।6.88.14।। वाचाव्याहृत्यजानीषेकृतार्थोऽस्मीतिदुर्मते ।
translation: दुर्मते evil minded, हीनार्थः meaningless, सःत्वम् you are, केनचित् for any one, दुरवापस्य difficult to do, अर्धस्य capacity to do, वाचा by words, व्याहृत्य talking, कृतार्थः succeeded, अस्मि I am, इति thus, जानीषे thinking
explanation: "O evil minded one! Your claim, in words that you have the capacity to do which is difficult for others is meaningless. Though you lack the capacity to succeed you are only thinking that you have succeeded."

shloka_text: अन्तर्धानगतेनाजौयस्त्वयाचरितस्तदा ।।6.88.15।। तस्कराचरितोमार्गःनैषवीरनिषेवितः ।
translation: तदा then, आजौ in the battle, अन्तर्धानगतेन remaining invisible, त्वया by you, यः that which, चरितः moving, मार्गः path, तस्कराचरितः is a cheat's move, एषः in that way, वीरनिषेवितः not chosen by warriors, न not
explanation: "Remaining invisible and moving in the battle then is the path of a thief which is not chosen by warriors."

shloka_text: यथाबाणपथंप्राप्यस्थितोऽहंतवराक्षस ।।6.88.16।। दर्शयस्वाद्यतत्तेजोवाचात्वंकिंविकत्थसे ।
translation: राक्षस Rakshasa, तव your, बाणपथम् range of arrows, प्राप्य reaching, यथा there, स्थितः stood, अस्मि me, तत् that, तेजः power, अद्य now, दर्शयस्व show, त्वम् you, वाचा spoke, किम् why, विकत्थसे boasting
explanation: "Rakshasa! I have reached your range of arrows and stand before you. Show that power now about which you boasted."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तोधनुर्भीमंपरामृश्यमहाबलः ।।6.88.17।। ससर्जनिशितान्बाणानिंद्रजित्समितिञ्जयः ।
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, महाबलः endowed with mighty prowess, समितिञ्जयः victorious, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, भीमम् terrific, धनुः bow, परामृश्य seizing, निशितान् pointed, शरान् arrows, ससर्ज released
explanation: After Lakshmana had spoken that way, Indrajith, endowed with mighty prowess, and victorious in combat seized a terrific bow and released pointed arrows.

shloka_text: तेनिसृष्टामहावेगाःशराःसर्पविषोपमाः ।।6.88.18।। सम्प्राप्यलक्ष्मणंपेतुःश्वसन्तइवपन्नगाः ।
translation: ते न, निसृष्टाः, महावेगाः great speed, सर्पविषोपमाः deadly like serpent, शराः shafts, लक्ष्मणम् at Lakshmana, सम्प्राप्य reached, शसन्तःhissing, पन्नगाःइव like serpents, पेतुःfell
explanation: The shafts like deadly poisonous serpents reached Lakshmana at great speed hissing and fell on Lakshmana.

shloka_text: रैरतिमहावेगैर्वेगवान्रावणात्मजः ।।6.88.19।। सौमित्रिमिन्द्रजिद्युद्धेविव्याधशुभलक्षणम् ।
translation: वेगवान् endowed with speed, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, युद्धे in war, अतिमहावेगैः at a much higher velocity, शरैः shafts, शुभलक्षणम् endowed with auspicious marks, सौमित्रिम् on Saumithri, विव्याध pained
explanation: Ravana's son Indrajith, who was endowed with great speed in war, pierced Lakshmana with shafts released at a much higher velocity.

shloka_text: सशरैरतिविद्धाङ्गोरुधिरेणसमुक्षितः ।।6.88.20।। शुशुभेलक्ष्मणःश्रीमान्विधूमइवपावकः ।
translation: शरैः shafts, अतिविद्धाङ्गः pierced all over, रुधिरेण by blood, समुक्षितः bathed, श्रीमान् glorious, सःलक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, विधूमः smokeless, पावकःइव like fire, शुशुभे seemed
explanation: With shafts pierced all over, glorious Lakshmana was bathed in blood and shone like smokeless fire.

shloka_text: इन्द्रजित्त्वात्मनःकर्मप्रसमीक्ष्याधिगम्य च ।।6.88.21।। विनद्यसुमहानादमिदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।
translation: इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, त्त्वात्मनः his own, स्रमपीक्ष्य observing, अधिगम्य approaching, सुमहानादम् exceedingly loud cry, विनद्य emitting, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Indrajith observing his own action, approaching Lakshmana, emitted a loud cry and spoke these words.

shloka_text: पत्रिणःशितधारास्तेकरामत्कार्मुकच्युताः ।।6.88.22।। आदास्यन्तेऽद्यसौमित्रेजीवितंजीवितान्तकाः ।
translation: सौमित्रे Saumithri, पत्रिणः with feathers, शितधाराः sharp pointed arrows, मत्कार्मुकच्युताः released by me, जीवितान्तकराः which can destroy life, शराः arrows, अद्य now, तेजीवितम् your life, आद्यास्यस्ते putting down
explanation: "Saumithri, these sharp pointed arrows fixed to feathers, which can destroy life, released by me now will put an end to your life."

shloka_text: अद्यगोमायुसङ्घाश्चश्येनसङ्घाश्चलक्ष्मण ।।6.88.23।। गृध्राश्चनिपतन्तुत्वांगतासुंनिहतंमया ।
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अद्य today, मया by me, निहतम् struck down, गतासुम् ceased of life, त्वाम् you, गोमायुसङ्घाश्च jackals descend, श्येनसङ्घाश्च hawks descend, गृध्राश्च and vultures, निपतन्तु fallen dead
explanation: "Lakshmana! Today let the jackals, hawks and vultures descend on your bodystruck down by me and ceased of life fallen dead."

shloka_text: क्षत्रबन्धुंसदानार्यंरामःपरमदुर्मतिः ।।6.88.24।। भक्तम्भ्रातरमद्यैवत्वांद्रक्ष्यतिहतंमया ।
translation: परमदुर्मतिः highly stupid, रामः Rama, क्षत्रबन्धुम् Kshatriya, सदा ever, अनार्यम् ignoble, भक्तम् devotee, भ्रातरम् brother, अद्यैव so also, निहतम् killed, त्वाम् you, द्रक्ष्यति will see
explanation: "Highly stupid Rama will see you, a devoted brother, a true kshatriya ever ignoble, killed by me today."

shloka_text: विशस्तकवचंभूमौव्यपविद्धशराससनम् ।।6.88.25।। हृतोत्तमाङ्गंसौमित्रत्वामद्यनिहतंमया ।
translation: सौमित्रे Saumithri, मया by me, अद्य now, निहतम् struck down, विशस्तकवचम् shield broken and fallen, भूमौ on ground, व्यपविद्धशरासनम् bow thrown down, हृतोत्तमाङ्गं trunk with head severed, त्वाम् your
explanation: "Saumithri, he (Rama) will see you struck by me fallen on the ground, shield broken and fallen down, bow thrown down and trunk with severed head."

shloka_text: इतिब्रुवाणंसङ्कृद्ध: परुषंरावणात्मजम् ।।6.88.26।। हेतुमद्वाक्यमत्यर्थंलक्ष्मणःप्रत्युवाच ह ।
translation: इति thus, परुषम् harsh, ब्रुवाणम् spoken, सङ्कृद्ध: enraged, रावणात्मजम् Ravana's son, अत्यर्थं meaningful, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, हेतुमत् with reason, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युवाच ह replied
explanation: When Indrajith was speaking harshly, enraged Lakshmana replied in a meaningful way with reason.

shloka_text: वाग्बलंत्यजदुर्बुद्धेक्रूरकर्मासिराक्षस ।।6.88.27।। अथकस्माद्वदस्येतत्सम्पादयसुकर्मणा ।
translation: दुर्बुद्धेevil minded, राक्षस Rakshasa, वाग्बलम् power of speech, त्यज give up, क्रूरकर्मा cruel action, अथ now, एतत् all this, तस्मात् What use by that, वदसि talk, सुकर्मणा good deeds, सम्पादय do good action
explanation: "Evil minded Rakshasa! Give up that wasteful power of speech. You are cruel in action. What is the use of all this now? Show by good deeds and not by talk."

shloka_text: कृत्वाकत्थसेकर्मकिमर्थमिहराक्षस ।।6.88.28।। कुरुतत्कर्मयेनाहंश्रद्धध्यांतवकत्थनम् ।
translation: राक्षस Rakshasa, कर्म action, अकृत्वा without performing, किमर्थम् What is the use, कत्थसे praising yourself, येन by that, अहम् I, तव your, कत्थनम् by praising, श्रद्धध्याम् create trust, तत् that, कर्म action, कुरु show that
explanation: Rakshasa! What is the use of praising without performing action? Show by action and create trust that you can perform.

shloka_text: अनुक्त्वापरुषंवाक्यंकिञ्चिदप्यनवक्षिपन् ।।6.88.29।। अविकत्थन्वधिष्यामित्वांपश्यपुरुषाधम ।
translation: पुरुषाधम lowly person, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, किञ्चिदपि indeed, अनुक्त्वा without commenting, अनवक्षिपन् without interrupting, अविकत्थन् without boasting, त्वाम् you, वधिष्यामि will assail you, पश्य see
explanation: "Lowly Rakshasa! without any harsh words, indeed without boasting, commenting, interrupting I will assail you. You may see."

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वापञ्चनाराचानाकर्णापूरितान् शितान् ।।6.88.30।। निजघानमहावेगाल्लक्ष्मणोराक्षसोरसि ।
translation: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, आकर्णम् till the ear, पूरितान् stretching, पञ्चनाराचान् five sharp, शितान् pointed, महावेगात् of high speed, राक्षसोरसि on the chest of Rakshasa, निजघान fixed
explanation: Having spoken like that, Lakshmana stretching his arrows till the ear fixed five sharp arrows of high speed on the chest of Rakshasa.

shloka_text: सुपत्रवाजिताबाणाज्वलिताइवपन्नगाः ।।6.88.31।। नैरृतोरस्यभासन्तसवितूरश्मयोयथा ।
translation: ज्वलिताः glowing, पन्नगाःइव like serpents, सुपत्रवाजिताः tied to good feathers, बाणाः arrows, नैरृतोरसि on the chest of Rakshasa, सवितुः sun, रश्मयःयथा like the rays, अभासन्त glowed
explanation: The arrows being tied to good feathers glowing like serpents shone on the chest of Rakshasa like the rays of Sun.

shloka_text: सःशरैराहतस्तेनसरोषोरावणात्मजः ।।6.88.32।। सुप्रयुक्तैस्त्रिभिर्भाणैःप्रतिविव्याधलक्ष्मणम् ।
translation: तेन by that, शरैः arrows, आहतः struck, सः he, रावणात्मजः Indrajith, सरोषः furiously, सुप्रयुक्तै: well aimed, त्रिभिः three, बाणैः arrows, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, प्रतिविव्याध in return
explanation: Struck by the arrows, Indrajith in return furiously released three well aimed arrows at Lakshmana.

shloka_text: सःबभूवमहाभीमोनरराक्षससिंहयोः ।।6.88.33।। विमर्दस्तुमुलोयुद्धेपरस्परजयैषिणोः ।
translation: युद्धे in combat, परस्परजयैषिणोः to win in fight over each other, नरराक्षससिंहयोः Lakshmana and Indrajith, महाभीमः very frightening, सः he, विमर्द: pounding each other, तुमलः very, बभूव appeared
explanation: In that combat both Lakshmana and Indrajith pounding to win against each other was frightening.

shloka_text: उभौहिबलसम्पन्नावुभौविक्रमशालिनौ ।।6.88.34।। उभौपरमदुर्ज्ञेयावतुल्यबलतेजसौ ।
translation: उभौ both, बलसम्पन्नौ richly endowed with prowess, उभौ both, विक्रमशालिनौ courageous, उभौ both, परमदुर्ज्ञेयौ exceedingly difficult to conquer, अतुल्यबलतेजसौ peerless in might
explanation: Both were richly endowed with prowess, both were courageous, exceedingly difficult to conquer and peerless in might.

shloka_text: युयुधातेतदावीरौग्रहाविवनभोगतौ ।।6.88.35।। बलवृत्राविवाभीतौयुधितौदुष्प्रधर्षणौ ।
translation: युधि in combat, दुष्प्रधर्षणौ clashed displaying, तौवीरौ both heroes, तदा then, नभोगतौ shining in heaven, ग्रहाविव like planets, बलवृत्राविव like Indra and Vrta fought, अभीतौ difficult to overcome, युयुधाते fought
explanation: In the combat both the heroes fought displaying their might, shone like two planets in the heaven and fought like Indra and Vrta and were difficult to overcome.

shloka_text: युयुधातेमहात्मानौतदाकेसरिणाविव ।।6.88.36।। बहूनवसृजन्तौहिमार्गणौघानवस्थितौ । नरराक्षससिम्होतौप्रहृष्टावभ्ययुध्यताम् ।।6.88.37।।
translation: तदा then, अवस्थितौ stayed resting, महात्मानौ great souls, बहून् many, मार्गणौघान् seeking and looking out, अवसृजन्तौ dropping and falling, केसरिणाविव like lions, युयुधाते fought, तौ they, नरराक्षससिम्हो lions among humans and Rakshasas, प्रहृष्टौ joyful, अभ्ययुध्यताम् one over the other
explanation: Then both the great warriors Lakshmana and Indrajith fought discharging many arrows, like lions among humans and Rakshasas respectively, looking out and seeking, dropping, and falling one over the other and stayed joyful. ।। इत्यार्षेवामलीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टाऽशीतितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the eighty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततश्शरान् दाशरथिस्सन्धायामित्रकर्शणः । ससर्जराक्षसेन्द्रायकृद्धस्सर्पइवश्वसन् ।।6.89.1।।
translation: ततः then, अमित्रकर्शणः tamer of enemies, दाशरथिः Dasharatha's son, शरान् arrows, सन्धाय fixing, क्रुद्धः angry, सर्पःइव like serpent, श्वसन् sighing, राक्षसेन्द्राय on Rakshasa king, ससर्ज discharged
explanation: Then Lakshmana, the tamer of enemies, sighs in anger like a serpent, fixing his arrows discharged on Rakshasa king.
comments: Dreadful and tumultuous fight takes place between Lakshmana and Indrajith with an exchange of a volley of arrows.

shloka_text: तस्यज्यातलनिर्घोषं स श्रुत्वाराक्षसाधिपः । विवर्णवदनोभूत्वालक्ष्मणंसमुदैक्षत ।।6.89.2।।
translation: सः he, राक्षसाधिपः Lord of Rakshasas, तस्य his, ज्यातलनिर्घोषम् the sound of bow string, श्रुत्वा hearing, विवर्णवदनः pale faced, भूत्वा, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, समुदैक्षत looked at
explanation: On hearing the sound of the bow string of Laksmana the Lord of Rakshasa became pale in face and looked at Lakshmana.

shloka_text: विषण्णवदनंदृष्टवाराक्षसंरावणात्मजे । सौमित्रिंयुद्धसंयुक्तंप्रत्युवाचविभीषणः ।।6.89.3।।
translation: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, विषण्णवदनम् pale faced, रावणात्मजे Ravana's son, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, दृष्टवा seeing, युद्धसंयुक्तम् ready for combat, सौमित्रिम् to Saumithri, प्रत्युवाच replied
explanation: Seeing Ravana's son, pale faced, Vibheeshana replied as follows to Saumithri who was ready for combat.

shloka_text: निमित्तान्युपपश्यामियान्यस्मिन् रावणात्मजे । त्वरतेनमहाबाहोभग्नएष न संशयः ।।6.89.4।।
translation: महाबाहो broadshouldered, अस्मिन् him, रावणात्मने Ravana's son, यानि on the basis of, निमित्तानि indications, उपपश्यामि having seen, तेन his, एषः in that way, भग्नः broken, संशयः no doubt, न not, त्वर is clear
explanation: "On the basis of the indications of the pale face of Ravana's son, it is clear that he is broken at heart. No doubt about it."

shloka_text: ततस्सन्धायसौमित्रिश्शरानग्निशिखोपमान् । मुमोचनिशितांस्तस्मिन् सर्पानिवमहाविषान् ।।6.89.5।।
translation: ततः then, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, अग्निशिखोपमान् like tongues of fire, निशितान् shining, शरान् arrows, सन्धाय fitted, महाविषान् venomous, सर्पानिव like snakes, तस्मिन् his, मुमोच discharged
explanation: Then Saumithri fitted his bow with shining arrows that were like tongues of fire, which resembled venomous serpents and discharged.

shloka_text: शक्राशनिसमस्पर्शैर्लक्ष्मणेनाहतश्शरैः । मुहूर्तमभवन्मूक्षःसर्वसंक्षुभितेन्द्रियः ।।6.89.6।।
translation: लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, शक्राशनिसमस्पर्शैः struck by Indra's thunderbolt like, शरैः arrows, आहतः attacked, सर्वसंक्षुभितेन्द्रियः all sense organs, मुहूर्तम् for a short while, मूढः excited, अभवत् remained
explanation: Struck by Indra's thunderbolt like arrows of Lakshmana, all sense organs of Indrajith remained excited for a short while.

shloka_text: उपलभ्यमुहूर्तेनसंज्ञांप्रत्यागतेन्द्रियः । ददर्शावस्थितंवीरंवीरोदशरथात्मजम् ।।6.89.7।।
translation: मुहूर्तेन in a short while, संज्ञाम् gaining consciousness, उपलभ्य getting up, प्रत्यागतेन्द्रियः returned to normalcy, वीरो heroic, अवस्थितम् stood, वीरम् heroic, दशरथात्मजम् Dasharatha's son, ददर्श saw
explanation: Heroic son of Ravana gained consciousness in a short while and returning to normalcy saw the heroic son of Dasharatha.

shloka_text: सोऽभिचक्रामसौमित्रिंरोषात्संरक्तलोचनः । अब्रवीच्चैनमासाद्यपुनस्सपरुषंवचः ।।6.89.8।।
translation: सः he, रोषात् enraged, संरक्तलोचनः eyes turned red, सौमित्रिम् at Saumithri, अभिचक्राम advanced towards, सः he, एनम् in this way, आसाद्य approaching, परुषम् harsh, वचःwords, पुनःagain, अब्रवीत् च spoke
explanation: He (Indrajith), enraged and eyes turned red, advancing towards Lakshmana, and approaching him again spoke in this way harshly.

shloka_text: किं न स्मरसितद्युद्धेप्रथमेमत्पराक्रमम् । निबद्धस्त्वंसहभ्रात्रायदाभुविविचेष्टसे ।।6.89.9।।
translation: त्वम् your, भ्रात्रास brother, निबद्धः bound, यदा that time, भुवि ground, विचेष्टसे fallen, प्रथमे first, युद्धे combat, तत् that, मत्पराक्रमम् my valour, न स्मरसि not rememberकिम् why
explanation: "Do you not remember that in the first combat your brother bound by me had fallen on the ground. Why do you not remember my valour?"

shloka_text: युवांखलुमहायुद्धेशक्रानिसमैश्शरैः । शायितौप्रथमंभूमौविसंज्ञौसपुरस्सरौ ।।6.89.10।।
translation: सपुरःसरौ formerly in the course of battle, युवाम् you two, प्रथमम् first, महायुद्धे great combat, शक्राशनिसमैः like Indra's thunderbolt and Asani, शरैः arrows, विसंज्ञौ lost senses, भूमौ, ground शायितौ lay down
explanation: "Formerly in the course of the first battle, the great combat, you two were laid down on ground having lost senses struck by my thunderbolt like arrows and Asani of Indra."

shloka_text: स्मृतिर्वानास्तितेमन्येव्यक्तंवायमसादनम् । गन्तुमिच्छसियस्मात्त्वमंधर्षयितुमिच्छसि ।।6.89.11।।
translation: त्त्वमं you both, माम् my, अधर्षयितुम् knowing my valour, यस्मात् this way, इच्छसि desire, ते you, स्मृतिः memory, नास्तिवा has lost is it, व्यक्तम् tell me, यमसादनम् Yama's abode, गन्तुम् will send, इच्छसिवा you like to go, मन्ये think
explanation: "Knowing my valour, you have come. Have you lost memory or do you desire to go to Yama's abode? Tell me."

shloka_text: यदितेप्रथमेयुद्धे न दृष्टोमत्पराक्रमः । अद्यतेदर्शयिष्यामितिष्ठेदानींव्यवस्थितः ।।6.89.12।।
translation: प्रथमे first, युद्धे combat, ते to you, मत्पराक्रमः my courage, न दृष्टःयदि if not seen, अद्य now, ते to you, दर्शयिष्यामि will exhibit, इदानीम् this time, व्यवस्थितः stand, तिष्ठ fight
explanation: "If you have not seen my courage in the first combat, now I will exhibit. Stand and fight now."

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वासप्तभिर्भाणैरभिविव्याथलक्ष्मणम् । दशभिस्तुहनूमन्तंतीक्ष्णधाश्शरोत्तमैः ।।6.89.13।।
translation: इति thus, उक्त्वा spoken, सप्तभिःseven, बाणैःshafts, लक्ष्मणम् at Lakshmana, विव्याथ pierced, तीक्ष्णधारैः pointed shafts, दशभिः ten, शरोत्तमैः best of shafts, हनूमन्तम् at Hanuman
explanation: Having spoken that way, Indrajith pierced Lakshmana with seven pointed shafts and Hanuman with ten best of shafts.

shloka_text: ततःशरशतेनैवसुप्रयुक्तेनवीर्यवान् । क्रोथाव्दिगुणसम्रब्धोनिर्बिभेदविभीषणम् ।।6.89.14।।
translation: ततः then, वीर्यवान् valiant, क्रोधात् in anger, द्विगुणसम्रब्धःdoubly angry, सुप्रयुक्तेन well targeted, शरशतेनैव a hundred arrows, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, निर्भिभेद pierced
explanation: Then valiant Rakshasa, doubly angry pierced well targeted hundred arrows at Vibheeshana.

shloka_text: तत् दृष्ट्वा इन्द्रजिता कर्म कृतं रामानुजः तदा । अचिन्तयित्वा प्रहसन् न एतत् किञ्चित् इति ब्रुवन् ।।6.89.15।।
translation: तदा then, रामानुजः Rama's brother, नरपुङ्गवः best of men, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, युधि in war, इन्द्रजिता Indrajith, कृतम् sake, तत् that, कर्म action, दृष्टवा seeing, अचिन्तयित्वा not minding, प्रहसन् laughing, किञ्चित् a little, न not, इति this, ब्रुवन् said, अभीतवदनः fearless face, क्रुद्धः angry, रावणिम् Indrajith, घोरान् dreadful, शरान् arrow, सम्गृह्य taking, मुमोच discharged
explanation: Then Lakshmana, the foremost among men, seeing Indrajith not minding his action even a little, laughing said," these arrows are not causing even a little pain." Then fearless Lakshmana discharged a dreadful arrow at Indrajith.

shloka_text: मुमोच च शरान् घोरान् सङ्गृह्य नरपुङ्गवः । अभीतवदनः क्रुद्धः रावणिं लक्ष्मणः युधि ।।6.89.16।।
translation: तदा then, रामानुजः Rama's brother, नरपुङ्गवः best of men, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, युधि in war, इन्द्रजिता Indrajith, कृतम् sake, तत् that, कर्म action, दृष्टवा seeing, अचिन्तयित्वा not minding, प्रहसन् laughing, किञ्चित् a little, न not, इति this, ब्रुवन् said, अभीतवदनः fearless face, क्रुद्धः angry, रावणिम् Indrajith, घोरान् dreadful, शरान् arrow, सम्गृह्य taking, मुमोच discharged
explanation: Then Lakshmana, the foremost among men, seeing Indrajith not minding his action even a little, laughing said," these arrows are not causing even a little pain." Then fearless Lakshmana discharged a dreadful arrow at Indrajith.

shloka_text: नैवंरणगताःशूराःप्रहरन्तिनिशाचर । लघवश्चाल्पवीर्याश्चशरासुखास्तवहीमे ।।6.89.17।।
translation: निशाचर night ranger, रणगताः coming for war, शूराः heroes, एवम् this way, प्रहरन्ति strike, तव your, इमेशराः these arrows, लघवश्च weak, अल्पवीर्याश्च less painful, सुखाःहि conducive
explanation: "O Night ranger! Heroes coming for war do not strike this way. These arrows are weak, so not painful but conducive."

shloka_text: नैवंशूरास्तुयुध्यन्तेसमरेजयकाङ्क्षिणः । इत्येवंतंब्रुवाणस्तुधन्वीशरैरभिववर्ष ह ।।6.89.18।।
translation: समरे in war, जयकाङ्क्षिणः seeking victory, शूराः heroes, एवम् in that way, न युध्यन्ते not fight, इत्येवम् this way, ब्रुवाणस्तु speaking, धन्वी bow, शरैः arrows, अभिववर्ष ह rained arrows
explanation: "Heroes seeking victory in that way do not fight". Thus speaking, Lakshmana rained arrows.

shloka_text: स्यबाणैस्सुविध्वस्तंकवचंकाञ्चनंमहत् । व्यशीर्यतरथोपस्थेताराजालमिव्बारात् ।।6.89.19।।
translation: तस्य his, बाणैः arrows, सुविधस्तम् shattered by, काञ्चनम् with gold, महत्, कवचम् shield, अम्बरात् from the sky, ताराजालमिव like a cluster of stars, रथोपस्थे on the chariot, व्यशीर्यत dropped
explanation: Shattered by the arrows, the shield of Indrajith covered with gold dropped in the chariot like a mass of stars from the sky.

shloka_text: विधूतवर्मानाराचैर्भभूव स कृतव्रणः । इन्द्रजित्समरेवीरःप्रत्यूषेभानुमानिव ।।6.89.20।।
translation: नाराचैः iron arrows, विधूतवर्मा shattered shield, कृतव्रणः injured, वीरः hero, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, समरे in combat, प्रत्यूषे, भानुमानिव like the morning sun, बभूव appeared
explanation: Indrajith's shield shattered by the iron arrows, (of Lakshmana) in the combat, he seemed (bathed in blood) like the morning Sun.

shloka_text: ततःशरसहस्रेणसङ्क्रुद्धोरावणात्मजः । बिभेदसमरेवीरोलक्ष्मणंभीमविक्रमः ।।6.89.21।।
translation: ततः then, वीरः hero, भीमविक्रमः of terrific valour, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, सङ्क्रुद्धः enraged, समरे in war, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, शरसहस्रेण with thousand arrows, बिभे pierced
explanation: Then enraged Ravana's son endowed with terrific valour pierced Lakshmana with a thousand arrows.

shloka_text: व्यशीर्यतमहद्धिव्यंकवचंलक्ष्मणस्य च । कृतप्रतिकृतान्योन्यंबभूवतुरभिद्रुतौ ।।6.89.22।।
translation: लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, महत् mighty, दिव्यम् wonderful, च कवचम् that shield, व्यशीर्यत shattered, कृतप्रतिकृतान्योन्यम् took offensive as well as retaliated each other, अभिद्रुतौ swiftly, बभूवतुः moving
explanation: Lakshmana's mighty and wonderful shield also got shattered. Both took offense as well as retaliated each other moving swiftly.

shloka_text: अभीक्ष्णंनिश्श्वसन्तौतौयुध्येतांतुमुलंयुधि । शरसङ्कृत्तसर्वाङ्गौसर्वतोरुधिरोक्षितौ ।।6.89.23।।
translation: युधि in war, शरसङ्कृत्तसर्वाङ्गौ limbs wounded by arrows, सर्वतः allover, रुधिरोक्षितौ bathed in blood, तौ both, अभीक्ष्णम् again and again, निश्श्वसन्तौ breathing heavily, तुमुलम् vehemently, युध्येताम् fought
explanation: Wounded all over the body in war and bathed in blood, breathing heavily again and again both of them fought vehemently.

shloka_text: सुदीर्घकालंतौवीरावन्योन्यनिशितैःशरैः । ततक्षतुर्महात्मानौरणकर्मविहारदौ ।।6.89.24।।
translation: महात्मानौ great souls, रणकर्मविशारदौ experts in fighting, तौ both, वीरौ heroes, सुदीर्घकालम् for long, अन्योन्यम् one another, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, ततक्षतुःtore
explanation: Both heroes, being experts in fighting, tore each other with sharp arrows for long.

shloka_text: बभूवतुश्चात्मजयेयत्तौभीमपराक्रमौ । तौशरौघैस्तदाकीर्णौनिकृत्तकवचध्वजौ ।।6.89.25।। सृजन्तौरुधिरंचोष्णंजलंप्रस्रवणाविव ।
translation: भीमपराक्रमौ of terrible valour, आत्मजये each of them to win, यत्तौ they both, बभूवतुः moving, शरौघैः arrows of both, तदा then, सङ्कीर्णौ mixed together, निकृत्तकवचध्वजौ armour and standards torn, तौ both, उष्णम् hot, रुधिरम् blood, सृजन्तौ waterfalls, जलम् water, प्रस्रवणाविव gushing
explanation: Both of them of terrible valour, each of them wanting to win, moving together their armour and standards torn, started emitting hot blood from their body like waterfalls gushing out.

shloka_text: शरवर्षं ततः घोरं मुञ्चतोः भीमनिःस्वनम् । सासारयोः इव आकाशे नीलयोः कालमेघयोः ।।6.89.26।।
translation: ततः then, भीमनिःस्वनम् terrific sound, घोरम् dreadful, शरवर्षम् rain of arrows, मुञ्चतोः set free, आकाशे from the sky, सासारयोः having bow, नीलयोः dark, कालमेघयोरिव clouds like at the time dissolution, युध्यमानयोः started fighting, तयोः both of them, अथ now, महान् great, कालःlong, व्यत्ययात् from battlefield, तौ both, युद्धवैमुख्यम् not turned back, श्रमंवापि no fatigue, न उपजग्मुतुः not experienced
explanation: Just as dark clouds rain from the sky at the time of dissolution, the dreadful rain of arrows set free from the bows of both Lakshmana and Indrajith caused terrific sound. Both of them fought for long and did not turn back from the battlefield or experienced any fatigue

shloka_text: तयोः अथ महान् कालः व्यतीयात् युध्यमानयोः । न च तौ युद्धवैमुख्यं श्रमं च अपि उपजग्मतुः ।।6.89.27।।
translation: ततः then, भीमनिःस्वनम् terrific sound, घोरम् dreadful, शरवर्षम् rain of arrows, मुञ्चतोः set free, आकाशे from the sky, सासारयोः having bow, नीलयोः dark, कालमेघयोरिव clouds like at the time dissolution, युध्यमानयोः started fighting, तयोः both of them, अथ now, महान् great, कालःlong, व्यत्ययात् from battlefield, तौ both, युद्धवैमुख्यम् not turned back, श्रमंवापि no fatigue, न उपजग्मुतुः not experienced
explanation: Just as dark clouds rain from the sky at the time of dissolution, the dreadful rain of arrows set free from the bows of both Lakshmana and Indrajith caused terrific sound. Both of them fought for long and did not turn back from the battlefield or experienced any fatigue

shloka_text: अस्त्राण्यस्त्रविदांश्रेष्ठौदर्शयन्तौपुनःपुनः ।।6.89.28।। शरानुच्छावचाकारानन्तरिक्षेबबन्धतुः ।
translation: अस्त्रविदाम् displaying their weapons, श्रेष्ठौ best warriors, पुनःपुनः again and again, अस्त्राणि weapons, दर्शयन्तौ looking at, अन्तरिक्षौ in to the sky, उच्छावचान् covering, शरान् arrows, बबन्धतुः network of arrows
explanation: Both of them, the best warriors, displaying their weapons again and again looking at the sky covered it with a network of arrows.

shloka_text: न्यपेतदोषमस्यन्तौलघुचित्रं च सुष्ठु च ।।6.89.29।। उभौतुतुमुलंघोरंचक्रतुर्नरराक्षसौ ।
translation: नरराक्षसौ human and Rakshasa, उभौ both, न्यपेतदोषम् without wasting single arrow, लघु with agility, चित्रं च wonderful, सुष्ठु च exceedingly, अस्यन्तौ one over the other, तमुलम् frightening, घोरम् dreadful, चक्रतुः
explanation: Both human and Rakshasa warriors fought an exceedingly frightening and dreadful fight over one another with agility without wasting a single arrow.

shloka_text: तयोःपृथक् पृथभगीमश्शुश्रुवेतलनिस्स्वनः ।।6.89.30।। प्रकम्पयन्जनंघोरोनिर्घातइवदारुणः ।
translation: तयोः those two, भीमः fierce, तुमुलः tumultuous, तलनिस्स्वनः sound of palms clapping, पृथक् पृथक्separately, separately, श्शुश्रुवे impact, दारुणः threatening, निर्घातःइव like violent wind, जनम् risen, प्रकम्पयन् shaken
explanation: The fierce and tumultuous impact of the sound produced by their palms (clappings) could be heard separately. It was like a violent wind that had shaken.

shloka_text: सतयोःभ्राजतेशब्दस्तदासमरयत्तयोः ।।6.89.31।। सुघोरयोर्निष्टनतोर्गगनेमेघयोरिव ।
translation: तथा that way, समरयत्तयोः both of them fighting, तयोः both, सःशब्दः that sound, सगगने sky, निष्टनतोः murmur, सुघोरयोः exceedingly frightening, मेघयोरिव like the clouds, भ्राजते was heard
explanation: When both of them were thus fighting, the exceedingly frightening sound that was heard was like the murmur of clouds.

shloka_text: सुवर्णपुङ्खैर्नाराचैर्बलवन्तौकृतव्रणौ ।।6.89.32।। प्रसुस्रुवातेरुधिरंकीर्तिमन्तौजयेधृतौ ।
translation: जये to win, धृतौ determined, कीर्तिमन्तौ glorious heroes, सुवर्णपुङ्खैः gold covered, नाराचैः iron arrows, कृतव्रणौ by the wounds, बलवन्तौ powerful, रुधिरम् blood, प्रसुस्रुवाते profusely bleeding
explanation: Glorious and powerful heroes, determined to win over each other, wounded by the gold covered iron arrows were bleeding profusely.

shloka_text: तेगात्रयोर्निपतितारुक्मपुङ्खाःशरायुधि ।।6.89.33।। असृदगिग्धाविनिष्पेतुर्विविशुर्धरणीतलम् ।
translation: युधि in battle, गात्रयोः limbs, पतिताः fallen, रुक्मपुङ्खाः gold covered arrows, तेशराः those arrows, अस्निदगिग्धाः fallen on their body, विनिष्पेतुः dropped out, धरणीतलम् into the ground, विविशुः penetrated
explanation: In the battle the gold covered arrows fell on their body, dropped out and penetrated into the earth.

shloka_text: अन्येसुनिशितैश्शस्त्रैराकाशेसञ्जघट्टिरे ।।6.89.34।। बभञ्जुश्चिच्छिदुश्चैवतयोर्बाणाःसहस्रशः ।
translation: तयोः both, अन्येबाणाः other arrows, सुनिशितैः pointed, शस्त्रै: weapons, आकाशे sky, सञ्जघट्टिरे clashed, सहस्रशः thousands, बभञ्जुः shattered, चिच्छिदुश्च tore
explanation: The other pointed arrows of both clashed with weapons in the sky in thousands, shattered and tore them.

shloka_text: सबभूवरणेघोरस्तयोर्बाणमयश्चयः ।।6.89.35।। अग्निभ्यामिवदीप्ताभ्यांसत्रेकुशमयश्चयः ।
translation: रणे in battle, तयोः both, घोरः terrific, बाणमयः with arrows, यः they, सत्रे eyes, दीप्ताभ्याम् glowing, अग्निभ्याम् like fire, कुशमयः kusa grass, यः those, बभूव appeared
explanation: In the battle the terrific arrows appeared to the eyes like kusa grass spread by the sacred fire.

shloka_text: तयोःकृतव्रणौदेहौशुशुभातेमहात्मनोः ।।6.89.36।। सुपुष्पाविवनिष्पत्रौवनेशाल्मलिकिंशुकौ ।
translation: तयोः those, महात्मनोः great heroes, कृतव्रणौ wounded, देहौ bodies, वने forest, सुपुष्पा blossoms, निष्पत्रौ sworn off their leaves, शाल्मलिकिंशुकौइव like Kimsuka and cotton, शुशुभाते shone
explanation: The wounded bodies of the great heroes, shone like the Kimsuka and Cotton blossoms in the forest, swore off their leaves.

shloka_text: चक्रतुस्तुमुलंघोरंसन्निपातंमुहुर्मुहुः ।।6.89.37।। इन्द्रजिल्लक्ष्मणश्चैवपरस्परवधैषिणौ ।
translation: इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, लक्ष्मणश्चैव and also Lakshmana, परस्परवधैषिणौ, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, तुमुलम् tumultous, घोरम् dreadful, सन्निपातम् struggle, चक्रतुः carried out
explanation: Indrajith and Lakshmana again and again carried out tumultuous and dreadful struggle.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणोरावणिंयुद्धेरावणिश्चापिलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.89.38।। अन्योन्यंतावभिघ्नन्तौ न श्रमंप्रतिपद्यताम् ।
translation: युद्धे in the battle, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रावणिम् Indrajith, रावणिश्चापि Indrajith, लक्ष्मणंचापि Lakshmana also, तौ both, अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिघ्नन्तौ striking, श्रमम् fatigue, न प्रतिपद्यताम् not experienced
explanation: In the battle Lakshmana and Indrajith striking each other had not experienced fatigue.

shloka_text: बाणजालैश्शरीरस्थैरवगाढैस्तरस्विनौ ।।6.89.39।। शुशुभातेमहावीर्यौप्ररूढाविवपर्वतौ ।
translation: महावीर्यौ great heroes, तरस्विनौ endowed with great speed, अवगाढैः pierced, शरीरस्थैः in the body, बाणजालैः network of arrows, प्ररूढौ overgrown with trees, पर्वतौइव like mountains, शुशुभाते shone
explanation: Great heroes, endowed with speed with a network of arrows pierced on the bodies shone like mountains overgrown with trees.

shloka_text: तयोरुधिरसिक्तानिसम्वृतान्तिशरैर्भृशम् ।।6.89.40।। बभ्राजुःसर्वगात्राणिज्वलन्तइवपावकाः ।
translation: तयो Both, रुधरिसिक्तानि wetted with blood, शरैः arrows, सम्वृतानि covered, सर्वगात्राणि all over the body, ज्वलन्तः glowing, पावकाःइव fire like, भृशम् exceedingly, बभ्राजुः appeared bright
explanation: Both of them, bodies wet with blood and covered with arrows were glowing like fire and appeared bright.

shloka_text: तयोरथमहान् कालोव्यतीयाद्युध्यमानयोः ।।6.89.41।। न च तौयुद्धवैमुख्यंश्रमंवाप्युपजग्मतुः ।
translation: तयो both, रथ Ravana's son and Lakshmana, महान् long, कालो time, व्यतीयाद्युध्य fighting, अन्योः for them, तौ both, युद्धवैमुख्यं neither turned away from battle, श्रमं fatigue, वाप्युपजग्मतुः experienced
explanation: Even though both, Ravana's son, and Lakshmana, fought for a long time they neither turned away from battle or experienced fatigue.

shloka_text: अथ समरपरिश्रमं निहन्तुं । समरमुखेषु अजितस्य लक्ष्मणस्य । प्रियहितम् उपपादयन् महात्मा । समरम् उपेत्य विभीषणः अवतस्थे ।।6.89.42।।
explanation: Then, to dispel the battle-weariness of Lakshmana, unconquered at the battle-fronts, the great-souled Vibhishana, ministering to his good and pleasure, came to the field and took his stand beside him.

shloka_text: युध्यमानौ ततः दृष्ट्वा प्रसक्तौ नरराक्षसौ । प्रभिन्नौ इव मातङ्गौ परस्परजयैषिणौ ।।6.90.1।।
translation: तौ the two, परस्परगतौ overcoming each other, बली powerful, शूरः heroes, सःतु he too, रावणभ्राता Ravana's brother, प्रसक्तौ fond of, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, युध्यमानौ intending to win in fight, प्रभिन्नौ broken to pieces, मातङ्गौइव like elephants, परस्परवधैषिणौ each of them for battle, नरराक्षसौ man and Rakshasa, दृष्टवाseeing, तयोः both, युद्धम् battle, द्रष्टुकामः eager to witness, सङ्ग्राममूर्धनि forefront of the battle, तस्थौ stood
explanation: Lakshmana (man) and Indrajith (Rakshasa) were fond of battle and intending to win in the fight overcoming each other. Each of them were like elephants but were broken into pieces. Vibheeshana, with eagerness to witness the battle stood in the forefront of the battlefield watching the fight.
comments: Vibheeshana encourages Vanaras to fight against Rakshasas. Dreadful fight takes place between Lakshmana and Indrajith both releasing a volley of arrows. Charioteer of Indrajith gets killed by Lakshmana, the horses get killed by the Vanaras. Indrajith walks down desperately.
hindi: तत्पश्चात् उस नर (लक्ष्मण) और राक्षस (इन्द्रजित्) को युद्धरत, एक-दूसरे पर विजय पाने की इच्छा से जुटे हुए, दो मदमस्त हाथियों-सम देखकर, उनके युद्ध को देखने की इच्छा से वह बलवान्, शूरवीर रावणभ्राता विभीषण अपना उत्तम धनुष धारण किये युद्ध के अग्रभाग में जा खड़ा हुआ

shloka_text: तयोः युद्धं द्रष्टुकामः वरचापधरः बली । शूरः स रावणभ्राता तस्थौ सङ्ग्राममूर्धनि ।।6.90.2।।
translation: तौ the two, परस्परगतौ overcoming each other, बली powerful, शूरः heroes, सःतु he too, रावणभ्राता Ravana's brother, प्रसक्तौ fond of, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, युध्यमानौ intending to win in fight, प्रभिन्नौ broken to pieces, मातङ्गौइव like elephants, परस्परवधैषिणौ each of them for battle, नरराक्षसौ man and Rakshasa, दृष्टवाseeing, तयोः both, युद्धम् battle, द्रष्टुकामः eager to witness, सङ्ग्राममूर्धनि forefront of the battle, तस्थौ stood
explanation: Lakshmana (man) and Indrajith (Rakshasa) were fond of battle and intending to win in the fight overcoming each other. Each of them were like elephants but were broken into pieces. Vibheeshana, with eagerness to witness the battle stood in the forefront of the battlefield watching the fight.
comments: Vibheeshana encourages Vanaras to fight against Rakshasas. Dreadful fight takes place between Lakshmana and Indrajith both releasing a volley of arrows. Charioteer of Indrajith gets killed by Lakshmana, the horses get killed by the Vanaras. Indrajith walks down desperately.
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 90.1 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: ततोविष्फारयामासमहद्धनुरवस्थितः । उत्ससर्ज च तीक्ष्णाग्रान् राक्षसेषुमहाशरान् ।।6.90.3।।
translation: ततः then, अवस्थितः stood, महत् great, धनुः bow, विष्फारयामास stretched, राक्षसेषु on Rakshasas, तीक्ष्णाग्रान् sharp pointed, महाशरान् great arrows, उत्ससर्ज च loosened.
explanation: Then Vibheeshana stood with stretched bow and loosened sharp pointed arrows on Rakshasas.
hindi: फिर वहीं खड़े होकर उसने अपना विशाल धनुष खींचा और राक्षसों पर तीखी नोंक वाले महाबाण छोड़ने लगा

shloka_text: तेशराःशिखिसम्पर्शानिपतन्तस्समाहिताः । राक्षसान् दारयामासुर्वज्राणीवमहागिरीन् ।।6.90.4।।
translation: समाहिताः settled, निपतन्तः fallen, शिखिसम्पर्शाः touching, ते those, शराः arrows, वज्राणि thunderbolts, महागिरीन् इव like mountain, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, दारयामासुः split
explanation: Those burning arrows falling on Rakshasas touched the Rakshasas and split them like thunderbolt splitting mountains.
hindi: अग्नि-स्पर्श जैसे वे बाण ठीक निशाने पर गिरते हुए राक्षसों को वैसे ही चीर डालने लगे, जैसे वज्र विशाल पर्वतों को चीर देते हैं

shloka_text: विभीषणस्यानुचरास्तेपिशूलासिपट्टसै: । चिच्छिदुःसमरेवीरान्राक्षसान्राक्षसोत्तमाः ।।6.90.5।।
translation: विभीषणस्य Vibheeshana's, अनुचराः followers, ते those, राक्षसोत्तमाःअपि foremost of Rakshasa also, समरे in battle, वीरान् heroes, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, शूलासिपट्टस : pikes swords and sharp edged spears, चिच्छिदुः shattered
explanation: Followers of Vibheeshana, the foremost of Rakshasa heroes, were shattered by the pikes, swords, and sharpedged spears in the battle.
hindi: विभीषण के अनुचर, वे श्रेष्ठ राक्षस भी त्रिशूल, तलवार तथा पट्टिशों से युद्ध में वीर राक्षसों को काट डालने लगे

shloka_text: राक्षसैस्स्सैःपरिवृतस्सतदातुविभीषणः । बभौमध्येप्रहृष्टानामाकलभानामिवद्विपः ।।6.90.6।।
translation: तदा then, तैः they, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, परिवृतः surrounding, सःविभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रहृष्टानाम् delighted, कलभानाम् young elephants, मध्ये midst, द्विपःइव shone, बभौ remained
explanation: Vibheeshana surrounded by Rakshasas shone like an elephant in the midst of young elephants.
hindi: उन राक्षसों से घिरे हुए विभीषण उस समय ऐसे शोभित हो रहे थे, मानो उद्दण्ड गजशावकों के बीच कोई गजराज खड़ा हो

shloka_text: ततस्स्संञ्चोदयानोवैहरीन्रक्षोरणप्रियान् । उवाचवचनंकालेकालज्ञोरक्षसांवरः ।।6.90.7।।
translation: ततः then, कालज्ञः knower of What was right at What time, रक्षसांवरः Rakshasa, काले time, रक्षोरणप्रियान् who were eager to fight with Rakshasas, हरीन् Vanaras, स्संञ्चोदयामास emboldening, वचनम् words, उवाचवै spoke
explanation: Then Vibheeshana, who is a knower of what is the right time to act spoke to Vanaras to embolden them who were eager to fight with Rakshasas.
hindi: तब राक्षस-वध में आनन्दित होने वाले उन वानरों को प्रेरित करते हुए, समय के ज्ञाता उस राक्षसश्रेष्ठ विभीषण ने उचित अवसर पर यह कहा—

shloka_text: एकोऽयंराक्षसेन्द्रस्यपरायणमवस्थितः । एतच्छेषंबलंतस्यकिंतिष्ठतहरीश्वराः ।।6.90.8।।
translation: हरीश्वराः Vanara leaders, अयम् this, एकः only one, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa's king's, परायणम् gone, अवस्थितः is there, तस्य his, बलम् army, एतच्छेषम् left, किम् why, तिष्ठत stand idle
explanation: "Oh Vanara leaders! He (Indrajith) is the only one who is left in the Rakshasa army. Why do you stand idle?"
hindi: ‘राक्षसराज का यही एकमात्र सहारा शेष रह गया है, इतनी ही सेना उसकी बची है; हे वानरराजो, तुम क्यों खड़े हो?

shloka_text: अस्मिंन्विनिहतेपापेराक्षसेरणमूर्थनि । रावणंवर्जयित्वातुशेषमस्यबलंहतम् ।।6.90.9।।
translation: रणमूर्थनि in the forefront of battle, पापे wicked, अस्मिन् in his, राक्षसे raksasas, विनिहते struck down, रावणम् Ravana, वर्जयित्वा leaving, अस्य his, शेषम् left, बलम् army, हतम् killed
explanation: "If this wicked Rakshasa is struck down, except Ravana all his army is killed."
hindi: इस पापी राक्षस के युद्ध के मोर्चे पर मारे जाते ही, रावण को छोड़कर उसकी शेष समस्त सेना नष्ट हो जायेगी

shloka_text: प्रहस्तो निहतो वीरो निकुम्भश्च महाबलः । कुम्भकर्णश्च कुम्भश्च धूम्राक्षश्च निशाचरः ।।6.90.10।।
translation: प्रहस्तः Prahastha, निहतः killed, वीरः hero, निकुम्भश्च Nikumbha also, महाबलः of great prowess, कुम्भकर्णश्च Kumbhakarna also, कुम्भश्च Kumbha aslo, धूम्राक्षः Dhum raksha, निशाचरः night ranger, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महामाली Mahamali, तीक्ष्णवेगः Teekshnavega, अशनिभ्रः Asanibhra, सुप्तघ्नः Suptagna, यज्ञकोपश्च Yagna kopa, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सम्ह्रादी Samhadri, अरिघ्नः Arigna, विकटः Vikata, तपनः Tapana, दमएव च Dama also, प्रघासः Praghasa, प्रघसIश्चैव Praghasa, प्रजङ्घ Prajangha:, जङञःएव च Jangha also, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च Agniketha also, वीर्यवान् heroes, रश्मिकेतुश्च Rasmikethu, विद्युज्जिह्व Vidyajihva, द्विजिह्वः Dwijihwa, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, अकम्पनः Akampana, सुपार्श्वश्च Suparswa, चक्रमाली Chakramali, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, कम्पनः Kampana, सत्त्ववन्तौ energetic, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka
explanation: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."
hindi: वीर प्रहस्त मारा जा चुका है, महाबली निकुम्भ भी; कुम्भकर्ण, कुम्भ तथा निशाचर धूम्राक्ष भी। जम्बुमाली, महामाली, तीक्ष्णवेग, अशनिप्रभ; सुप्तघ्न, यज्ञकोप तथा राक्षस वज्रदंष्ट्र; सिंहनादी, विकट, अरिघ्न, तपन तथा मन्द भी; प्रघास, प्रघस, प्रजंघ तथा जंघ भी; दुर्धर्ष अग्निकेतु, पराक्रमी रश्मिकेतु; विद्युज्जिह्व, द्विजिह्व तथा राक्षस सूर्यशत्रु; अकम्पन, सुपार्श्व तथा राक्षस चक्रमाली; और वे दोनों बलशाली देवान्तक-नरान्तक, कम्पन-सहित—

shloka_text: जम्बुमाली महामाली तीक्ष्णवेगोऽशनिप्रभः । सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च वज्रदंष्ट्रश्च राक्षसः ।।6.90.11।।
translation: प्रहस्तः Prahastha, निहतः killed, वीरः hero, निकुम्भश्च Nikumbha also, महाबलः of great prowess, कुम्भकर्णश्च Kumbhakarna also, कुम्भश्च Kumbha aslo, धूम्राक्षः Dhum raksha, निशाचरः night ranger, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महामाली Mahamali, तीक्ष्णवेगः Teekshnavega, अशनिभ्रः Asanibhra, सुप्तघ्नः Suptagna, यज्ञकोपश्च Yagna kopa, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सम्ह्रादी Samhadri, अरिघ्नः Arigna, विकटः Vikata, तपनः Tapana, दमएव च Dama also, प्रघासः Praghasa, प्रघसIश्चैव Praghasa, प्रजङ्घ Prajangha:, जङञःएव च Jangha also, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च Agniketha also, वीर्यवान् heroes, रश्मिकेतुश्च Rasmikethu, विद्युज्जिह्व Vidyajihva, द्विजिह्वः Dwijihwa, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, अकम्पनः Akampana, सुपार्श्वश्च Suparswa, चक्रमाली Chakramali, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, कम्पनः Kampana, सत्त्ववन्तौ energetic, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka
explanation: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 90.10 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: सिंहनादी विकटोऽरिघ्नस्तपनो मन्द एव च । प्रघासः प्रघसश्चैव प्रजङ्घो जङ्घ एव च ।।6.90.12।।
translation: प्रहस्तः Prahastha, निहतः killed, वीरः hero, निकुम्भश्च Nikumbha also, महाबलः of great prowess, कुम्भकर्णश्च Kumbhakarna also, कुम्भश्च Kumbha aslo, धूम्राक्षः Dhum raksha, निशाचरः night ranger, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महामाली Mahamali, तीक्ष्णवेगः Teekshnavega, अशनिभ्रः Asanibhra, सुप्तघ्नः Suptagna, यज्ञकोपश्च Yagna kopa, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सम्ह्रादी Samhadri, अरिघ्नः Arigna, विकटः Vikata, तपनः Tapana, दमएव च Dama also, प्रघासः Praghasa, प्रघसIश्चैव Praghasa, प्रजङ्घ Prajangha:, जङञःएव च Jangha also, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च Agniketha also, वीर्यवान् heroes, रश्मिकेतुश्च Rasmikethu, विद्युज्जिह्व Vidyajihva, द्विजिह्वः Dwijihwa, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, अकम्पनः Akampana, सुपार्श्वश्च Suparswa, चक्रमाली Chakramali, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, कम्पनः Kampana, सत्त्ववन्तौ energetic, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka
explanation: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."
hindi: अनुवाद श्लोक 90.10 के साथ दिखाया गया है

shloka_text: अग्निकेतुश्च दुर्धर्षो रश्मिकेतुश्च वीर्यवान् । विद्युज्जिह्वो द्विजिह्वश्च सूर्यशत्रुश्च राक्षसः ।।6.90.13।।
